title: Influencer & Partnership Development Specialist
description:
Influencer & Partnership Development Specialist

(Paid Trial + Performance Incentives)

TYPE OF WORK



Gig / Part-Time



WAGE / SALARY



PHP 3,000 (Paid Trial) + PHP 8,000/month + Performance Incentives



HOURS PER WEEK



Approximately 15 hours



JOB OVERVIEW



We are looking for someone who enjoys research, relationship building, and thoughtful outreach.



This is NOT a Virtual Assistant or administrative role.



Your mission is to identify the right influencers, business partners, and industry professionals, then start meaningful conversations that can lead to long-term partnerships.



This position requires strategic thinking, research, and personalized communication—not mass messaging.



If you rely on copy-and-paste templates or spam outreach, this role is not for you.



RESPONSIBILITIES

Research influencers, creators, brokers, and professionals

Understand each person's audience and positioning

Write personalized outreach messages (Instagram, LinkedIn,
, etc.)

Send one thoughtful follow-up when appropriate

Track conversations using Google Sheets

Continuously improve outreach based on reply quality and results

HOW WE MEASURE SUCCESS



We do NOT measure hours worked.



Instead, we evaluate:



Reply rate

Quality of replies

Meaningful conversations started

Qualified meetings

Professional communication

Continuous improvement

PAID TRIAL



The trial period lasts approximately 1–2 weeks.



Trial Compensation

Fixed payment: PHP 3,000

Performance incentives also apply during the trial



The trial includes:



Research

Personalized outreach

Follow-ups

Progress tracking

Reporting



Successful candidates will be invited to continue working with us long-term.



LONG-TERM COMPENSATION



After successfully completing the paid trial:



Fixed monthly payment: PHP 8,000

Additional performance incentives every month

PERFORMANCE INCENTIVES



In addition to the fixed payment:



JPY 500 for each qualified reply that demonstrates genuine interest in discussing a collaboration.

JPY 3,000 for each completed online meeting.



A qualified reply must show clear interest in learning more about a potential collaboration.



Meeting incentives are paid only when the scheduled online meeting is actually completed.



Outstanding performers may receive additional bonuses and increased responsibilities over time.



PLEASE DO NOT APPLY IF

You use copy-and-paste messages.

You send mass outreach without research.

You cannot explain your outreach strategy.

You dislike researching people before contacting them.

REQUIRED APPLICATION TASK



To apply, complete the following exercise.



Choose ONE of the following:



A US-based real estate influencer

A broker serving international clients



Then submit:



1. Cold DM



Write a personalized outreach message.



2. Follow-up



Write ONE follow-up message.



3. Strategy



Explain:



Why you chose this person

Why your message should receive a reply

What response you hope to achieve

4. Target Link



Provide their Instagram, LinkedIn, or website.



Applications may not be considered if:



Messages are generic

No personalization is shown

No strategy is explained

The selected target is not relevant

LONG-TERM OPPORTUNITY



Successful applicants will have the opportunity to continue working with us long-term.



Compensation and responsibilities will grow based on:



Performance

Reply quality

Meeting quality

Overall contribution



If you enjoy research, strategic communication, and building valuable business relationships, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Senior Transport Operations Officer (Dispatch / Fleet Management / Transport Operations)
description:
Job Description

Company: Priority Haulage Limited

Job Title: Transport Operations Officer

Job Type: Remote / Part-Time 

Job Hours:  ~25 Hours Per Week

Reports to: Operations Manager

Direct Reports: Transport Operations Support

Start Date: June 2026



About Priority Haulage

Priority Haulage is a reputable and reliable heavy machinery and equipment transport business based in Auckland, New Zealand. We specialise in the safe and efficient transportation of a wide range of civil machinery and heavy access equipment. 



Our company motto, “Your Assets, Our Priority”, reflects our commitment to the secure and dependable movement of our clients’ valuable machinery. We take pride in delivering a high level of client satisfaction through trusted service and operational excellence.



Job Summary

Priority Haulage is seeking a capable, high-capacity, and dependable Transport Operations Officer to support day-to-day operations within a fast-paced, high-accountability environment.



The role reports primarily to the Operations Manager and works closely with the Financial Controller on systems, process improvement, and operational coordination initiatives.



This position is central to maintaining operational continuity across fleet dispatch, driver management, compliance coordination, and transport administration within a structured, performance-driven business focused on operational efficiency, accountability, and scalable systems.



Role Overview

This role is suited to an operations professional who can consistently deliver reliable outcomes with minimal supervision in a deadline-driven environment. Performance will be assessed based on operational consistency, responsiveness, task completion, communication quality, and ability to maintain established workflows and standards.



Availability & Working Hours

This role requires consistent coverage aligned with New Zealand business operations, including early morning dispatch coordination and operational responsiveness throughout the day.



Core Operational Coverage (PHT)

5:00 AM – 1:00 PM: Primary operational window covering fleet dispatch, job loading, driver coordination, and daily operational tasks.



2:00 PM – 5:00 PM: Flexible operational coverage period supporting job closing activities, operational follow-up, and preparation/loading for the following operational cycle as required.



The role is workflow and task-driven, with hours and workload fluctuating depending on job volume, fleet activity, and operational requirements. Compensation is based on actual hours worked.



Final working arrangements and compensation structure will be discussed and agreed with the successful candidate based on operational requirements, workflow demands, and demonstrated capability within the role. The position is expected to require approximately ~25 - 30 hours per week, with baseline workload increasing as operational responsibilities expand.



Job Responsibilities

Primary Responsibilities



Fleet Dispatch

• Job Processing

• Job Quality Control



Fleet Management

• Fleet Maintenance Coordination

• EROAD Management

• Fuel Management



Driver Management

• Logbook Compliance

• Leave Management

• Uniform Inventory Management

• Driver Records Management

• Performance Management Support



Operational Support & Administration

• Support cross-functional operational workflows.

• Maintain accurate operational records and documentation.

• Assist with operational coordination and process improvement.

• Support internal communication, task coordination, and workflow follow-up.

• Assist leadership with operational reporting and action tracking where required.



Progressive Responsibilities

The successful candidate will progressively support and coordinate additional operational safety and compliance functions as part of the wider operations role, including:



• Compliance & Risk Support

• Insurance Claims Coordination

• Health & Safety Administration



Required Experience & Capability

Applicants should demonstrate proven experience operating within a structured, deadline-driven transport or logistics environment:

• Minimum 6+ years’ hands-on experience managing high-volume transport dispatch, fleet coordination, and operational workflows.

• Proven experience within transport, logistics, dispatch, or fleet operations environments.

• Strong organisational and commercial judgement, with the ability to manage multiple operational priorities simultaneously.

• Demonstrated experience using Transport Management Systems (TMS), fleet management platforms, dispatch systems, or operational workflow software.

• Ability to operate independently within a remote work environment

• Effective problem-solving capability and operational judgement.

• Intermediate Microsoft Excel capability, including, filtering, sorting, and pivot tables

• A high level of technical proficiency across the Microsoft platform and modern operational business systems, with working familiarity in tools such as:

o Notion

o ChatGPT



Preferred Experience 

• Exposure to New Zealand or Australian transport and logistics environments.

• Exposure to health & safety, driver compliance, and quality control processes.

• Demonstrated ability to improve operational workflows through process optimisation, system improvement, or automation initiatives.

• Exposure to coordinating, supporting, or overseeing operational staff within a structured operations environment.



Personal Attributes

• Highly organised and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple responsibilities reliably.

• Strong communication and interpersonal skills, able to contribute effectively.

• Proactive and improvement-oriented, with the ability to adapt, optimise workflows, and navigate operational change.

• Professional, dependable, and accountable, with strong follow-through and responsiveness.

• Able to remain calm and organised within a fast-paced operational environment.

• Strong ownership mindset with consistent follow-through and responsiveness.



Required Equipment and Setup

• Dedicated Workspace: Quiet, distraction-free home office suitable for video calls and focused work.

• Computer Requirements (Desktop PC or Laptop):

o Processor: Intel Core i5 or better.

o RAM: Minimum 8GB (16GB preferred).

o Operating System: Windows 10/11, compatible with required business software.

o Internet: Stable high-speed connection (minimum 10 Mbps download/upload).

• Monitor Setup: Dual monitors preferred, or a laptop paired with an external monitor.

• Headset: Noise-cancelling for clear communication during virtual meetings.

• Webcam: High-quality external or integrated camera for video calls.

• Power Backup: Uninterruptible Power Supply (UPS) or generator ensuring at least 3 hours of operational uptime during outages.

• Internet Backup: Secondary internet connection (e.g., mobile data or alternative wireless) for uninterrupted connectivity.



Application Requirement

In your application submission, include the word “Motivated!” in the title.

title: Accounting & Marketing Assistant
description:
You have successfully maintained the books and accounting for an Australian business turning over $5 million or more and are now looking for a broader role where you can take on greater responsibility and contribute beyond finance in a key position.



Reporting to the Australian management team, you'll take ownership of the day-to-day bookkeeping and financial administration.  You'll maintain accurate financial records, complete reconciliations, manage accounts payable and receivable, and prepare timely financial information and management reports. You'll also work alongside our external accountant, who manages the BAS and taxation requirements.



Beyond the accounting responsibilities, you'll enjoy a varied role supporting the business in other key areas. This includes coordinating marketing activities with our Australian team to grow Yum Tasmanian’s online presence, assisting with grant applications, and contributing to a range of business initiatives. 



Yum Tasmanian is a proudly Australian, family-owned business that has been supplying premium potatoes throughout Australia for more than 30 years. Beginning as an organic potato producer in 1994, the business has grown into a nationally recognised supplier to major retailers including Coles, Woolworths, IGA, independent retailers and wholesale markets.



Today, the group operates across several businesses within agriculture, fresh produce and related industries. As the business continues to grow, there is a strong focus on building the Yum brand, educating consumers and expanding its online presence through organic marketing.



We want you to be a driver in helping us build Yum into Australia's most recognised online potato brand by growing our organic digital presence to over 1 million Instagram and
 followers through organic marketing.



The role is Monday to Friday, working from an office. In return for your great performance, you’ll be supported with autonomy, rewards and more opportunity for growth over time.



If this sounds like a role you’d enjoy and succeed in, apply now via the link below for more information.

title: **Real Estate CRM + Seller Follow-Up VA | Lead Management, QA & Operations**
description:
Go Platinum Real Estate is looking for a highly organized **CRM / Seller Follow-Up Virtual Assistant** who understands that a valuable lead can be lost simply because somebody forgot to document or follow up.



Our philosophy:



**The CRM is the memory of the company.**



If the notes, status, follow-up date or next action are wrong, the opportunity is at risk.



This position combines **CRM management, seller follow-up and quality control**.



Responsibilities



You may be responsible for:



* Reviewing seller records

* Updating CRM information

* Reviewing caller notes

* Correcting incomplete records

* Scheduling callbacks

* Monitoring overdue follow-ups

* Following up with warm sellers

* Tracking changes in seller motivation

* Updating pipeline statuses

* Identifying HOT opportunities

* Flagging leads requiring management review

* Preventing duplicate records

* Maintaining accurate contact/property information

* Reviewing dispositions

* Maintaining Do-Not-Contact records

* Creating daily pipeline reports



Seller Information You Must Track



* Owner name

* Phone

* Property address

* Property condition

* Occupancy

* Motivation

* Timeline

* Asking price

* Mortgage/payoff if known

* Liens/issues if known

* Last contact

* Status

* Full notes

* Next action

* Follow-up date

* Assigned representative



Nobody should open a lead tomorrow and wonder:



**“What happened yesterday?”**



 Ideal Experience



Strong candidates may have experience with:



* Real estate

* Follow Up Boss

* GoHighLevel

* HubSpot

* Salesforce

* CloudTalk

* Mojo

* Transaction coordination

* Lead management

* Seller follow-up

* Quality assurance

* Data management

* Google Sheets

* Real-estate wholesaling



We Need Someone Who



* Notices missing information

* Is extremely organized

* Writes excellent notes

* Follows instructions

* Understands urgency

* Can communicate professionally with sellers

* Can distinguish HOT, WARM and NURTURE opportunities

* Doesn't allow follow-ups to disappear

* Escalates problems instead of hiding them



### Compensation



Approximately **$6.00–$7.50 USD/hour depending on experience, role and performance.**



Performance bonuses may apply to seller-facing positions.



Advancement opportunities include:



* Senior Seller Follow-Up Specialist

* CRM Administrator

* Quality Assurance Specialist

* Acquisition Support

* Team Lead

* Operations Coordinator

* Department Manager



Hiring Process



Selected applicants receive Go Platinum training followed by a practical certification exercise.



For example, you may receive intentionally incomplete CRM records and be asked to:



**Find the mistakes → correct the records → determine the proper status → create the next action → schedule the appropriate follow-up.**



Strong candidates move into a short **paid controlled-work trial**.



### How to Apply



Start your application with:



**PLATINUM CRM**



Then answer:



1. WhatsApp number

2.

3. Requested hourly rate

4. Full-time or part-time?

5. U.S. real-estate experience

6. CRMs you've used

7. Seller/customer follow-up experience

8. Quality-assurance experience

9. What information should always be included in a good CRM note?

10. When can you begin?



Attach your resume.



---



## I would post them in this order tonight



**Post #1 immediately: Job Application & Career Deployment VA.**



That's the person who can begin producing applications/interviews for you while you build the real-estate operation.



**Post #2 immediately after: Seller Cold Caller.**



This gives you a fresh pool specifically for the revenue-producing calling floor instead of trying to convert every admin VA into a salesperson.



Then post **#3 CRM + Seller Follow-Up**.



One additional change I would make: **don't advertise “we need 100 VAs” or the entire empire in the posting.** Make each applicant believe they're applying to a clearly defined professional department with a real job, real training, clear KPIs and advancement opportunities. That's going to attract much stronger candidates.

-Footing and slab details

title: SEO Link Builder / Outreach Specialist – Video Gaming Niche (Part-Time, Long-Term)
description:
We are looking for a relationship-driven SEO Link Builder / Outreach Specialist to take ownership of backlink acquisition for a growing Australian ecommerce business in the video gaming niche.



This is a part-time (20 hours per week), long-term role on a set weekly roster.



Right now, most of our link acquisition runs through vendors and resellers, which means we pay a markup on nearly every placement. This role exists to bring that work in-house and turn it into a structured, direct process. You will prospect relevant websites yourself, build relationships with publishers and site owners, negotiate placements at direct rates, and manage a monthly placement budget of around 2,000–5,000 USD.



This is not a mass-outreach or link-blasting role. We care more about 5–10 relevant, properly vetted placements than a hundred cheap ones. You should be comfortable walking away from a link that looks good on paper but does not pass a proper quality check.



Responsibilities



Prospecting & Outreach

- Identify relevant, quality websites in the video gaming niche and related verticals for link opportunities, including guest - posts, niche edits, resource pages, and partnerships

- Run personalised outreach and follow-up sequences that generate replies

- Keep a healthy pipeline of prospects moving at all times



Negotiation & Publisher Relationships

- Negotiate placement terms and pricing directly with site owners and publishers

- Build and maintain direct publisher relationships over time, reducing reliance on reseller markups

- Manage our monthly placement budget of around 2,000–5,000 USD and maximise the quality of links secured

- Set up repeat-placement or bulk arrangements with publishers where appropriate



Link Quality Vetting

- Vet every opportunity before committing, including niche relevance, organic traffic, traffic trends, outbound link profile, - dofollow/nofollow/sponsored status, and anchor text

- Identify inflated metrics, suspicious traffic, PBNs, link farms, and low-quality guest post networks

- Verify placements go live as agreed and remain live



Tracking & Reporting

- Keep our backlink tracker fully up to date, including prospect status, outreach progress, cost, anchor, target URL, and - live/lost checks

- Maintain clear records of publisher quotes and agreed placement terms

- Report cost per link and key quality metrics monthly



Community & Organic Mentions

- When time permits, participate naturally in relevant Reddit, gaming forum, and community discussions where our brand or - content genuinely adds value

- This is a minor side responsibility. Direct outreach and placements always come first



Role Scope

- This role is focused on link acquisition, outreach, and link quality. It does not involve on-page SEO, technical SEO, or content - writing beyond outreach
s and brief community replies.

- You will not be reselling links to us through your own vendor network. We are hiring you to prospect and negotiate directly - with publishers on our behalf, with full transparency around placement costs.



Required Experience

- 2+ years of hands-on link building or outreach experience with results you can show

- Strong prospecting skills and the ability to identify relevant websites within a niche

- Confident using Ahrefs or Semrush and spotting inflated or spammy sites

- Able to identify PBNs, link farms, and low-quality guest post networks

- Experience with outreach and prospecting tools such as BuzzStream, Pitchbox, Hunter, Snov, or similar

- Strong written English

- Reliable, organised, and comfortable working independently to a set roster



Strongly Preferred

- Link-building or SEO experience in video gaming, esports, technology, or entertainment

- Familiarity with gaming publications, blogs, forums, and online communities

- Digital PR experience

- Experience negotiating bulk or repeat-placement rates with publishers

- Reddit or forum community experience

- Ecommerce experience

- Experience working with Australian businesses



Hours and Benefits

- Monday to Friday, 4 hours per day at set times agreed in advance

- Paid vacation leave after three months

- Stable, long-term role with a growing Australian company

- A role with real ownership and the opportunity to build our link acquisition process and publisher relationships as the business grows



Application Questions

1. Describe your link-building experience, including the niches you have worked in and the results you achieved.

2. Have you previously worked in video gaming, esports, technology, or entertainment? If so, briefly describe your experience.

3. Share three links you personally secured: the URL, how you found the opportunity, how you secured the placement, and what it cost if paid.

4. A gaming website offers you a guest post for $80. Walk us through how you would d
 whether the placement is worth taking.

5. Describe a time you rejected a placement that initially looked acceptable. What tipped you off?

6. A publisher quotes $150 for a placement you want. How would you approach negotiating a better rate or an ongoing arrangement?

7. Which prospecting and outreach tools have you used, and what did you use each one for?

8. How do you normally track prospects, outreach, negotiations, and completed placements?

9. Please include a link to your LinkedIn profile if you have one.

Please begin your application with MC so we know you have read the full job description.

Amazon Wholesale Catalog & Replenishment VA



We are an established U.S.-based Amazon wholesale business looking for a full-time Virtual Assistant to help analyze supplier catalogs, manage restocks, and build purchase orders.



The goal of this position is simple: make sure we are finding every profitable opportunity available from our existing suppliers and keeping our profitable products in stock.



What You'll Do

Thoroughly analyze supplier catalogs containing hundreds or thousands of products

Identify profitable products that meet our purchasing criteria

Review products we currently or previously sold for restock opportunities

Review products that are low-stock or out of stock in our Amazon account

Re-evaluate products we previously stopped buying to see if they have become profitable again

Monitor changes in pricing, demand, competition, and profitability

Build organized proposed purchase orders for assigned supplier accounts

Maintain accurate spreadsheets and records of your work



Thoroughness is extremely important. We do not want someone who looks at the first 50 products in a catalog, finds three winners, and stops. We want someone who will systematically work through an account and make sure profitable opportunities aren't being missed.



Accuracy is equally important. Every product recommended for purchase must meet our profitability criteria after product cost, Amazon fees, and other applicable costs are considered.

Experience using Keepa

Strong understanding of profit, ROI, Amazon fees, pricing, sales history, and competition

Strong Excel / Google Sheets skills

Excellent attention to detail

Comfortable working through large catalogs and large amounts of product data

Preferred Experience

Amazon wholesale

title: Moodle Specialist
description:
Department: Learning Technology / Information Technology



Reports To: IT Operations Manager / Director of Educational Technology



Role Overview



The Moodle & Content Specialist is responsible for custom module creation, course administration, content management, and technical support within the Moodle Learning Management System (LMS). Working directly with Instructional Designers in Education, this role translates educational content, curriculum frameworks, and instructional assets into fully functional, high-quality Moodle courses and modules using native tools and Moodle APIs.



Key Responsibilities



Educational Content Translation & Course Creation: Collaborate directly with Instructional Designers in Education to convert course outlines, storyboards, and educational materials into structured, interactive Moodle modules and courses.



Custom Module Development: Build, configure, and customize Moodle modules, activities, and course layouts using Moodle APIs and Web Services to meet educational and institutional requirements.



Content Management & Delivery: Upload, format, and manage educational assets; build interactive content using Moodle native tools, H5P, SCORM packages, and interactive gradebooks.



Functional System Administration: Oversee day-to-day LMS operations, including user enrollments, role permissions, course-level backups/restores, and plugin management.



Technical Troubleshooting: Act as the primary escalation point for application errors, display bugs, plugin conflicts, and course-level technical issues.



System Integration & Reporting: Implement and maintain application-level integrations via Moodle APIs (SIS, SSO, external tools) and generate custom tracking and compliance reports.



Documentation & Support: Produce SOPs, user guides, and technical documentation; provide technical support to instructional designers, educators, and learners.



Required Qualifications



Experience: 3+ years of dedicated administration, custom module creation, and LMS course building within Moodle educational environments.



Instructional Collaboration: Proven experience collaborating with Instructional Designers in Education to build, refine, and optimize online learning units.



Technical Proficiency: Strong hands-on experience with PHP, HTML5, CSS, SQL (MySQL or PostgreSQL), and Moodle APIs / Web Services for custom module building and integrations.



Standards & Protocols: Demonstrated expertise in e-learning standards, including SCORM, xAPI, LTI, and REST/SOAP web services.



Communication & Problem-Solving: Excellent collaboration skills to bridge educational design requirements with technical LMS execution.

title: Remote Colorist, Wedding Films
description:
Rolling Canvas is a premium South Asian wedding photography and videography studio based in Sydney, Australia. Our films are known for a natural, editorial aesthetic that prioritises emotion over flash. We are looking for a dedicated colorist to join our post production team remotely.



What you will work on



You will colour grade three types of deliverable. Highlight videos run five to seven minutes. Reels run up to one minute. Feature films run 25 to 35 minutes. All content is wedding footage shot across multiple cameras that needs matching, grading, and a consistent final look.



What we are looking for



You are a trained colorist, not a general video editor who also does colour. You have spent real time learning colour theory, camera matching and grading workflow, and you know DaVinci Resolve well. Premiere Pro experience is a bonus.



You have a portfolio of wedding or film colour work you can show us. You are available for ongoing work, not one-off gigs. You understand that a premium client expects a premium deliverable and you take quality seriously.



The style we work in



Our aesthetic is natural, warm, and desaturated. We do not do heavy stylised looks. Camera matching across multiple angles is a core part of the job. You need to be comfortable working from a style reference and reproducing it consistently across a full wedding day.



What the workflow looks like



You receive edited prores file via Dropbox. You deliver graded files within the agreed turnaround. You communicate via WhatsApp or
. You flag issues early, not after a deadline.



What we pay



We are open to per project rates or a monthly retainer depending on volume. Please include your rate and a link to your portfolio when you apply.



How to apply



Send your portfolio, your rate, and a short note on your colour background. Applications without a portfolio will not be reviewed.

About Rooted by Nyah



Rooted by Nyah is a growing creative e-commerce brand focused on AI-generated artwork, digital prints, printable wall art, and related print-on-demand products.



The brand operates across multiple platforms, including Etsy, Pinterest, Printify, and a direct website, with a strong focus on high-quality presentation, cohesive branding, discoverability, and developing products that appeal to specific customer niches.



We are looking for an organized, creative, and proactive E-Commerce Operations & Brand Coordinator who can help strengthen the systems behind the business while supporting the ongoing creation, publication, promotion, and management of products.



This is not a basic data-entry or task-only virtual assistant position.



The ideal candidate will be able to take ownership of recurring processes, help create organized workflows, recognize opportunities for improvement, and help turn finished artwork into properly presented and marketed products.



Position Objective



The primary purpose of this position is to help build and manage a repeatable e-commerce system that moves products through the following process:



Artwork → Quality Review → Product Development → Mockups → Etsy Listing → SEO → Printify → Pinterest → Website → Promotion → Performance Review

Check links and product pages

Workflow & Systems Development

The Coordinator may help develop and maintain:

Pinterest publishing workflows

Content calendars

Keyword libraries

Reliable

Strong at managing multiple ongoing projects

“How can we create a better system for this?”



What Success Looks Like



A successful Coordinator will help create a business where:



Etsy listings are consistently optimized and maintained

New products are published regularly

Pinterest content is scheduled consistently

Existing products are continuously repurposed into marketing content

Printify products remain organized and updated

The website is completed and maintained

Artwork files are organized and easy to locate

New products follow a clear development process

Recurring tasks have documented workflows

Product performance is regularly reviewed

Strong-performing products are identified and expanded

The owner spends less time managing repetitive operational tasks

Schedule & Compensation



This is a part-time remote position beginning at 15 hours per week.



Compensation: $8 USD per hour



Hours may increase over time depending on performance, business growth, workload, and the candidate's ability to take ownership of additional responsibilities.



This is intended to be a long-term position for the right candidate.



Application Requirements



To apply, please provide answers to the following questions:

Applications that do not answer the requested questions may not be considered.



Selection Process

Small paid skills assessment

Offer and onboarding

Growth Opportunity

title: Senior Full-Stack Developer / Codebase Auditor
description:
Review Existing Applications, Architecture, Security & Code Quality



We are looking for a -highly experienced Senior Full-Stack Developer / Software Architect- to conduct a comprehensive technical review of several existing software projects.



This is not initially a “build from scratch” position.



Our first priority is to bring in an experienced developer who can -carefully inspect the codebases we already have-, understand what has been built, determine what was done correctly, identify problems or technical debt, and provide a clear roadmap for improving the applications before we continue further development.



We want someone who is comfortable opening an unfamiliar repository, understanding a complex application, tracing how the pieces connect, and giving an independent professional assessment.



Your Initial Assignment



You will receive access to our existing repositories and development environments.



Your responsibility will be to perform a -complete technical audit- and answer questions such as:



* What percentage of the application appears properly completed?

* Which parts of the existing architecture are well designed?

* Which parts should remain unchanged?

* Which areas need improvement?

* Which areas should be refactored?

* Is there duplicated, unnecessary, obsolete, or poorly structured code?

* Are there unfinished or partially implemented features?

* Are there features that appear finished in the UI but are not properly connected to the backend?

* Are APIs correctly implemented?

* Is the database architecture appropriate?

* Are authentication and authorization implemented properly?

* Are database permissions and security policies configured correctly?

* Are sensitive API keys and secrets protected?

* Are there security vulnerabilities?

* Are there scalability concerns?

* Are there performance problems?

* Are there broken integrations?

* Are there unnecessary dependencies?

* Are error handling and logging implemented correctly?

* Are automated tests sufficient?

* Is the code maintainable by another development team?

* Is the current architecture suitable for production?

* What should be fixed **before launch**?

* What can safely be improved **after launch**?



Areas You Will Review



The review may include:



Frontend



* React

* TypeScript

* JavaScript

* Component architecture

* State management

* Performance

Backend

* Business logic

* Background processes

* Edge/serverless functions

Database



Experience with *PostgreSQL and Supabase is highly preferred*.



You should be able to review:



* Database schemas

* Tables

* Foreign keys

* Indexes

* Constraints

* Functions

* Triggers

* Migrations

* Row Level Security (RLS)

* Database permissions

* Query performance

Experience with the following is valuable:



* OpenAI API

* LLM integrations

* AI assistants/agents

* RAG

* Vector databases

* Embeddings

* AI routing

* Prompt architecture

* Streaming responses

* Usage/token tracking

* AI security

* Rate limiting

* Cost controls



Infrastructure / DevOps



You should also be able to evaluate:



* GitHub repositories

* Git structure

* Branching strategy

* CI/CD

* Environment variables

* Production vs. development configuration

* Deployment architecture

* Logging

* Monitoring

* Error tracking

* Scalability

* Backups

* Disaster recovery



Security Review



Security is extremely important.



We expect you to review areas including:



* Authentication

* Authorization

* User permissions

* Admin permissions

* RLS policies

* API security

* API key protection

* Secret management

* Database exposure

* Input validation

* SQL injection risks

* XSS risks

* CSRF risks

* Rate limiting

* File-upload security

* Payment-related security

* User data protection



## Required Deliverable



We do not want someone who simply looks at the code and says, “Everything looks good.”



We expect a professional written technical assessment.



For every major system or feature, classify it as:



✅ GOOD



Properly implemented and should remain.



???? NEEDS IMPROVEMENT



Works, but should be optimized or cleaned up.



???? NEEDS REFACTORING



Functional but architecturally weak or difficult to maintain.



???? CRITICAL



Security, reliability, data integrity, or production-launch concern.



⚪ INCOMPLETE



Started but not fully implemented.



⚫ NOT IMPLEMENTED



Expected functionality is missing.



Your final report should include:



1. Executive Technical Summary

2. Overall Code Quality Score

3. Architecture Assessment

4. Frontend Assessment

5. Backend Assessment

6. Database Assessment

7. Security Assessment

8. Performance Assessment

9. API and Integration Assessment

10. AI Integration Assessment, where applicable

11. Testing Assessment

12. Deployment/Infrastructure Assessment

13. List of Broken or Incomplete Features

14. Technical Debt List

15. Security Risks

16. Recommended Improvements

17. Priority Ranking for Every Major Issue

18. Estimated Level of Effort for Major Fixes

19. What Should Be Fixed Before Production

20. What Can Be Improved After Launch



We also want a high-level estimate such as:



Current Production Readiness: ___ / 100 and an approximate breakdown of:



* Properly completed: ___%

* Completed but needs improvement: ___%

* Requires significant rework: ___%

* Incomplete/missing: ___%



These percentages must be based on your technical assessment, not guesses.



Important



Do not rewrite working code simply because you would personally code it differently.



We are looking for someone who understands the difference between:



* code that is different,

* code that could be cleaner,

* code that actually creates technical risk,

* and code that genuinely needs to be rebuilt.



Preserving good existing work is just as important as identifying bad work.



Who We Are Looking For



You should ideally have:



* 5+ years professional software-development experience

* Strong full-stack development experience

* Strong React / Next.js experience

* Strong TypeScript experience

* Strong PostgreSQL knowledge

* Supabase experience

* API architecture experience

* Authentication and authorization experience

* Software architecture experience

* Security knowledge

* Git/GitHub experience

* Production application experience

* Experience inheriting and auditing existing codebases

* Ability to understand code written by other developers

* Ability to explain technical issues clearly to a non-technical founder



Experience with large SaaS platforms, AI applications, marketplaces, mobile/web applications, or multi-role platforms is a major advantage.



Potential Long-Term Opportunity



The initial engagement is a -technical audit and evaluation.



However, if the working relationship is successful, there is significant opportunity for ongoing work.



We are developing multiple technology platforms and expect continued development, optimization, testing, maintenance, security work, AI integration, and new feature development.



We are therefore interested in finding someone who could potentially become a **long-term senior developer or technical lead**, not simply complete one small assignment.



Confidentiality



Because you will be reviewing proprietary software and source code, you must be willing to:



* Sign an NDA

* Keep all source code confidential

* Never copy or reuse proprietary code

* Never share repository access

* Follow appropriate security procedures

* Work through authorized GitHub access



How to Apply



Please begin your application with the words:



CODE AUDIT



This tells us that you actually read the entire posting.



Then answer the following:



1. How many years have you worked professionally as a software developer?

2. What is your strongest technology stack?

3. How strong are you with React and Next.js?

4. How strong are you with TypeScript?

5. What experience do you have with PostgreSQL?

6. What experience do you have with Supabase?

7. Have you worked extensively with Row Level Security?

8. Have you previously audited or inherited another developer's codebase?

9. Have you identified serious architectural or security problems during a previous code audit? Give one example.

10. What experience do you have with OpenAI or other AI APIs?

11. What experience do you have with GitHub and CI/CD?

12. How would you approach reviewing a large unfamiliar codebase?

13. What would you examine first before deciding whether code should be kept, refactored, or rewritten?

14. Can you produce a detailed written technical audit after reviewing the system?

15. Are you comfortable explaining technical problems to a non-technical business owner?

16. Please provide links to GitHub, portfolio, LinkedIn, or projects you have personally worked on.

17. What is your hourly rate or expected compensation?

18. What is your current availability?

19. Are you interested in a longer-term position if the initial audit goes well?



Final Screening Question



Assume you inherit a large application that appears to be -80% complete-.



The interface looks finished, but you don't yet know whether the backend, database security, APIs, and business logic are properly implemented.



Describe, step by step, how you would determine whether the application is truly 80% complete and production-ready.



Please provide a thoughtful technical answer. Generic or AI-generated applications without evidence of relevant experience will not be prioritized.

)! 



If you work at Wonderist, you likely enjoy a challenge, appreciate autonomy, actually care about clients, and are looking for a team that you can enjoy being part of.



JOB DESCRIPTION:



The Social Ads Associate will play a key role in supporting the launch and management of social advertising campaigns, with a strong focus on creative production, launch administration, QA, request management, and ad hoc support tasks that keep campaigns running smoothly.



This is an excellent entry-level opportunity for someone eager to build a career in digital marketing and social media advertising. You’ll gain hands-on experience with Meta Ads, TikTok-style creative, Canva, video editing, and social ad production while being mentored by senior specialists and collaborating with multiple teams across the agency.



ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:



Creative Production & Asset Support



- Assist with social ad creative production, including building static ads in Canva, editing short-form video content, and preparing creative variations for paid social campaigns.

- Support the creation of ad assets for platforms such as Meta and TikTok, including creative concepts, visual layouts, captions, hooks, and basic video edits.

- Resize, format, organize, and prepare creative assets for campaign launches, refreshes, and testing.

- Follow established templates, brand guidelines, and campaign direction to produce clean, polished creative that aligns with client goals.



Launch Administration & QA For New Accounts



- Follow up with internal teams to gather client assets such as
 page access, ad account access, creative assets, brand guidelines, logos, photos, videos, offers, and landing page details.

- Conduct QA for new social ads campaigns, reviewing creative assets, ad copy, campaign setup, links, landing pages, tracking, and platform connections before launch.

- Support social ads launches by coordinating needed materials, organizing deliverables, and ensuring creative and campaign assets are prepared correctly.



Request Board Management



- Manage incoming social ads requests from client success and internal teams through the request board.

- Blend task completion, task routing, and task follow-up to ensure requests are handled efficiently and on time.

- Support strategic pivots such as new campaign launches, creative refreshes, campaign angle changes, and offer updates by coordinating with team members and ensuring deliverables are prepared correctly.



Ad Hoc Requests



- Monitor and troubleshoot basic account, access, creative, or platform-related issues, coordinating with internal teams to resolve them.

- Assist with gathering creative assets, client documentation, campaign notes, or platform access needed to complete social ads work.

- Support ad hoc requests such as slide deck preparation, reporting needs, creative audits, campaign updates, and social ads production tasks.



Additional Responsibilities



- Contribute to cross-team projects, process improvements, and new initiatives as assigned.

- Take on new responsibilities and special projects as business needs evolve, with opportunities to learn and grow.



CORE COMPETENCIES:



Attention to Detail: Catches small errors in creative, copy, links, campaign setup, or reporting before they become bigger issues.



Organizational Skills: Manages multiple tasks, creative requests, assets, and deadlines with clarity and efficiency.



Communication: Shares updates clearly with internal teams and asks thoughtful questions when clarification is needed.



Problem-Solving: Approaches challenges with curiosity and resourcefulness, seeking solutions rather than roadblocks.



Adaptability: Comfortable shifting focus as client or business needs change, and open to taking on new tasks.



Collaboration: Works well across departments, including Client Success, Design, Web, SEO, and Paid Media, to ensure campaigns align with broader client goals.



Initiative: Proactively follows up on tasks, takes ownership of assigned responsibilities, and looks for ways to add value.



Creative Aptitude: Has an eye for clean, effective creative and is willing to learn how to produce social ad assets that are clear, engaging, and aligned with campaign goals.



Technical Aptitude: Willing to learn new platforms and tools quickly, with a foundation in digital marketing and social media concepts.



PERSONALITY MUSTS:



Our perfect fit is someone who is a problem solver who understands the difference between “yes, and…” and “yes, but…”. You should have a hungry, scrappy personality with a positive attitude and aim to deliver. Working in the client service industry can mean going the extra mile, and we need someone who is always willing to rise to the occasion for our clients and put forward beautiful work that exceeds client expectations. Someone who is detailed and organized, driven, displays vigor, and comes ready to play every day. Confidence, self-discipline, and a congenial, curious mind are things we love and admire.



The ideal Social Ads Associate is curious, detail-oriented, creative, and eager to learn. You’re someone who takes initiative, asks questions, and thrives in a fast-paced, collaborative environment. You should be organized, proactive, and ready to roll up your sleeves to support both the team and clients. A positive attitude, hunger to grow, and willingness to take ownership are a must.



MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:



- 0–2 years of experience in digital marketing, social media, paid social, content creation, or a related field. Internships or entry-level agency roles count.

- Proficiency with Google Workspace, including Docs, Sheets, Slides, and Drive, for day-to-day collaboration and reporting.

- Familiarity with creative and editing tools such as Canva, Creatopy, Munch, CapCut, Adobe Express, or similar.

- Basic experience creating or editing short-form video content for platforms like TikTok, Instagram Reels,
, or YouTube Shorts.

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

- Understanding of social media advertising concepts such as creative testing, ad copy, hooks, calls to action, audiences, and budgets.

- Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

- Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, Design, or a related field, or equivalent work experience.



BONUS POINTS FOR APPLICANTS WITH:



-Healthcare or dental marketing experience.

-GoHighLevel, Webflow or CMS platform experience.

-Google Ads / SEO experience.

title: U.S. Rental Property Bookkeeping Assistant – Part Time / Ongoing
description:
U.S. Rental Property Bookkeeping Assistant – Part Time / Ongoing

About the Role



I'm looking for an experienced bookkeeping/accounting assistant to help me organize and maintain the finances for several U.S. rental properties.



My rental-property bookkeeping is currently somewhat disorganized, so the first project will involve cleaning up and organizing historical transactions. Once everything is organized, I would like this person to maintain the books on an ongoing basis.



I'm looking for someone who has experience working with U.S. rental properties and U.S. accounting/bookkeeping.



Initial Project



The first priority will be getting my existing rental-property finances organized.



You would help:



Review historical bank and credit-card transactions

Identify rental-related income and expenses

Separate personal and rental transactions

Categorize expenses appropriately

Organize transactions by individual property

Reconcile accounts

Organize receipts and supporting documentation

Identify missing or unclear transactions for me to review

Create a clean income/expense report for each property

Help identify potential capital improvements vs. normal repairs

Prepare organized records that can be provided to my U.S. tax professional



I don't expect you to make final U.S. tax decisions. When something is unclear from a tax perspective, I want it flagged for review by my U.S. CPA/EA.



Ongoing Responsibilities



Once the historical records are cleaned up:



Maintain monthly bookkeeping

Categorize new transactions

Reconcile bank and credit-card accounts

Track rental income and expenses by property

Maintain organized supporting documentation

Produce monthly/quarterly reports

Keep records organized for tax season

Flag unusual or potentially important transactions

Experience I'm Looking For



Required:



Experience with U.S. bookkeeping

Experience with rental properties/real estate accounting

Strong attention to detail

Excellent written English

Comfortable working with spreadsheets

Able to independently research transactions and identify discrepancies



Preferred:



QuickBooks experience

Experience working with multiple rental properties

Experience preparing books for a U.S. CPA

Knowledge of common U.S. rental-property expenses

Accounting/bookkeeping certification or degree



You do not need to be a U.S. CPA. I'm primarily looking for someone who is excellent at bookkeeping and organizing financial records.



Important



This position will involve access to sensitive financial information, so trustworthiness and confidentiality are extremely important.



I will provide access to the information necessary to perform the work, but I do not expect you to have access to funds or make financial transactions on my behalf.



To Apply



Please answer the following:



How many years of bookkeeping experience do you have?

Have you worked with U.S. rental properties before? Please explain.

What accounting software have you used?

Have you prepared books that were subsequently given to a U.S. CPA or tax preparer?

How would you approach cleaning up several years of disorganized rental transactions?

What is your hourly rate?

Please provide examples of similar work you've done.



I'm looking for someone who can start with a cleanup project and potentially become my long-term bookkeeping/accounting assistant.

title: Growth & Outreach Specialist
description:
Growth & Outreach Specialist — Cloudiphy



Location: Philippines — Remote

Employment: Full-time

Hours: 40 hours per week

Starting salary: US$750/month

Business: Cloudiphy



About Cloudiphy



Cloudiphy is a B2B technology company helping trades and service businesses improve the way they capture, manage and follow up with customers.



We provide business systems including websites, CRM, lead management, automated follow-up, review automation, AI tools and managed business infrastructure.



We are looking for a proactive Growth & Outreach Specialist to take ownership of Cloudiphy’s day-to-day marketing, content and outbound prospecting.



This is not a basic virtual assistant role.



We want someone who can use AI tools intelligently, work independently, take initiative and focus on generating real sales opportunities.



The main goal of this role is simple:



Consistently generate qualified sales opportunities for the Cloudiphy founder.



The founder will handle sales calls, closing, strategy and customer relationships.



Your job is to make sure there are consistently good prospects for him to speak with.



⸻



What You’ll Be Responsible For



1. Social Media Content



You will take responsibility for Cloudiphy’s ongoing social media presence.



This includes:



* Creating social media content using AI tools

* Creating graphics, carousels, short videos and other content

* Using existing Cloudiphy branding and assets

* Writing captions

* Researching and using appropriate hashtags

* Scheduling and publishing posts

* Managing LinkedIn, Instagram and

* Repurposing content across different platforms

* Maintaining a consistent content calendar

* Monitoring engagement

* Identifying content opportunities

* Improving content based on performance



You do not need to be a professional designer. You should be comfortable using tools such as ChatGPT, Canva, CapCut and other AI content tools.



⸻



2.
 Group & Community Outreach



You will identify relevant communities where Cloudiphy’s target customers spend time.



This includes:



* Finding relevant
 groups for trades and service businesses

* Joining appropriate groups

* Monitoring discussions

* Identifying potential customers

* Identifying people asking questions or discussing problems Cloudiphy can solve

* Engaging naturally and professionally

* Starting conversations where appropriate

* Moving suitable prospects into the CRM

* Following up with interested prospects



This is not about spamming groups.



We want someone who understands how to participate naturally, identify genuine opportunities and start useful conversations.



⸻



3. Cold Outreach



You will manage day-to-day written outbound prospecting.



Channels may include:



* Cold

* SMS

*

* Instagram

* LinkedIn

* Other appropriate channels



You will:



* Research businesses

* Identify decision makers

* Find contact information

* Personalise outreach

* Send initial messages

* Follow up with prospects

* Track responses

* Identify interested prospects

* Escalate positive responses to the founder



The goal is not simply to send as many messages as possible.



The goal is to create genuine conversations with businesses that could benefit from Cloudiphy.



⸻



4. Lead Research & Data Management



The founder may provide lead lists, but you will also be expected to find new prospects independently.



For each prospect, you will capture and maintain information such as:



* Business name

* Website

* Contact name

*

* Phone

* Location

* Industry/trade

*

* Instagram

* LinkedIn

* Google Business Profile

* Review count/rating

* Booking system

* CRM or technology where identifiable

* Potential problems/opportunities

* Outreach status

* Responses

* Follow-up dates

* Sales outcome



All relevant information must be kept organised in our CRM and/or spreadsheets.



Accuracy is important.



⸻



5. Identify Opportunities for Cloudiphy



This is an important part of the role.



We don’t just want someone collecting names and sending messages.



You should be able to look at a business and think:



“This company doesn’t have online booking.”



or:



“They have 300 Google reviews but don’t appear to have an automated review system.”



or:



“They don’t appear to have any follow-up after an enquiry.”



or:



“Their website is outdated and they have no obvious lead capture.”



You will use these observations to help create more relevant outreach.



⸻



What We Are Looking For



You should have experience with several of the following:



* Lead generation

* Cold

* Cold outreach

* Social media management

* Social media content creation

*
 outreach

* LinkedIn outreach

*
 marketing

* Copywriting

* Canva

* CapCut

* ChatGPT

* AI content creation

* CRM systems

* Google Sheets

* GoHighLevel or similar CRM/outreach platforms

* Online business research



Most importantly, you should be:



* Proactive

* Self-motivated

* Reliable

* Detail-oriented

* Commercially minded

* Comfortable with repetitive outbound work

* Able to work independently

* Able to learn new software quickly

* Comfortable using AI tools

* Good at written English

* Able to communicate professionally with business owners

* Focused on results rather than simply completing tasks



We want someone who will eventually be able to take ownership of the process rather than needing instructions for every individual task.



⸻



What Success Looks Like



You will not be judged simply on how many posts you make or how many
s you send.



We will track the complete process:



Prospects researched



↓



Outreach completed



↓



Replies



↓



Positive replies



↓



Qualified opportunities



↓



Sales calls booked



↓



Customers generated



The most important outcome is:



How many qualified sales opportunities are you consistently creating for Cloudiphy?



You will have clear targets and regular performance reviews.



⸻



Working With The Founder



The founder will initially handle:



* Sales calls

* Demonstrations

* Closing

* Customer relationships

* Business strategy

* Offer development

* Overall Cloudiphy direction



Your responsibility is to build and operate the marketing and outbound engine that feeds opportunities into the sales process.



As you become more experienced with the business, you will be given more responsibility and independence.



⸻



Tools



You may work with tools including:



* ChatGPT

* Canva

* CapCut

* GoHighLevel

* Google Workspace

* Google Sheets

* LinkedIn

*

* Instagram

*
 outreach tools

* SMS platforms

* Other AI and marketing tools



You do not need to know every tool already.



Being able to learn quickly is more important than knowing a particular piece of software.



⸻



Salary & Opportunity



Starting salary: US$750/month



40 hours per week



This is intended to be a long-term position.



There will be a performance review after the initial period, with the opportunity for salary increases as your responsibilities and results grow.



As Cloudiphy grows, there will be opportunities to take on greater responsibility within the business.



⸻



How To Apply



Please include the following in your application:



1. Introduction



Tell us briefly about yourself and your previous experience.



2. Relevant experience



Tell us about your experience with:



* Lead generation

* Cold outreach

* Social media

* Content creation

* AI tools



3. Tools



List the platforms and tools you are comfortable using.



4. Examples



Provide examples of social media accounts, content or lead-generation campaigns you have previously worked on, if available.



5. Short video



Please record a short video introducing yourself and explaining why you believe you would be a good fit for this role.



6. Practical test



As part of the selection process, we will ask shortlisted applicants to complete a small practical task.



The task will involve finding several potential Cloudiphy prospects, identifying opportunities within those businesses and creating example outreach messages.



We are interested in seeing how you think, not just your previous job titles.



Important



Please start your application with the word:



CLOUD



Applications that do not follow the instructions may not be considered.



⸻



Who We Want



We’re looking for someone who sees this as more than a job where they complete a list of tasks.



If you see a problem, solve it.



If you discover a better way of doing something, tell us.



If an outreach campaign isn’t working, figure out why and suggest a better approach.



If you find a promising prospect, pursue the opportunity.



The goal is to build a long-term working relationship with someone who can eventually take ownership of Cloudiphy’s growth and outbound operations.

title: FULLTIME E-COM VIDEO EDITOR
description:
WHAT WE DO



We build and scale German e-commerce brands. Our products are personalized gifts —

engraved jewelry, name necklaces, photo pieces. We sell through TikTok and Meta ads.

Q4 is our biggest season and we are building our creative output now.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



You will turn raw footage into high-volume ad variations. Not one polished film —

many fast, testable versions.



- Take one raw video and build 8-12 variations from it

- Change hooks, first 3 seconds, text overlays, music, pacing, captions

- Cut vertical 9:16 for TikTok and Meta

- Work from a written brief and reference ads we give you

- Deliver 20-40 finished variations per week



You do not need to invent concepts. We give you the template, the hooks and the

reference ads. You execute them fast and clean.



WHAT WE EXPECT — READ THIS PART



This is a performance role. We measure output, not hours logged.



- 20-40 finished ad variations per week, consistently

- Clean cuts, correct aspect ratio, readable captions, no sloppy exports

- You hit deadlines. If something blocks you, you tell us the same day

- You take feedback and apply it to the next batch without being told twice

- Daily short update on what you finished



If you cannot hold this pace, this job is not for you and we will both waste time.



WHAT WE OFFER



- 4.50 USD per hour, 25 hours per week (112 USD/week)

- PAID WEEKLY, every week, on time. No delays, no excuses

- More hours and a higher rate once you prove your output

- Long term position — we are building for years, not for one campaign

- Clear briefs and reference material. You will never guess what we want

- Direct contact with the owner, no agency layers

- Raises based on output once you prove yourself



We know reliable payment is not a given in this market. Ours is.



WHAT WE NEED FROM YOU



Please do NOT send a generic application. We read every single one and we delete

copy-paste immediately.



To apply, send:



1. Put the word ROSEGOLD as the first word of your application. Applications

   without it are deleted unread.



2. Three links to SHORT-FORM ADS you personally edited.

   TikTok, Reels or Meta ads only. 9:16 vertical.

   Do NOT send wedding videos, YouTube vlogs, corporate films or showreels.

   If you have no ad work, say so honestly and send the closest thing you have.



3. Answer these three questions in your own words:

   - Which editing software do you use daily?

   - How many short-form videos can you realistically finish in one working day?

   - What is your current work situation — do you have other clients right now?



4. Your internet speed and your available working hours in Philippine time.



INTERVIEW



Shortlisted applicants get a short video call with the owner. Camera on.

We want to talk to you, not to a CV.



Start: immediately.

Day to day

You must already have

Worked in at least one of: travel agency, DMC, villa reservations, yacht charter desk, private aviation broker assistant, hotel/restaurant reservations, or luxury concierge/partnerships. You must be used to
ing businesses, not only chatting to customers.

title: Technical Project Manager (WordPress/WooCommerce)
description:
We are looking for an exceptionally organised Technical Project Manager to take ownership of project coordination, tracking, and delivery across the development team of a growing Australian ecommerce business.



This is a full-time, long-term role.



Our development work spans three connected applications: our live ecommerce site, a separate order fulfilment application, and a marketplace platform we are preparing to launch. We work with a distributed team of developers, a QA specialist, and a design team.



Right now, project management sits with our Tech Lead on top of his development responsibilities. This role exists to take that responsibility over and turn it into a structured, reliable process. You will own task management in ClickUp, assign and distribute work, track deadlines, follow up daily, coordinate QA and releases, verify developer work reports, and give management a clear, accurate view of exactly where every project stands.



This is not a tech lead or development role. Our Tech Lead owns all technical and architecture decisions, code review, and the development itself. Your role sits around the development: making sure every task has an owner, every deadline is tracked, every blocker is surfaced and removed, and nothing falls through the cracks.



Your core mission is finding and removing bottlenecks. You should be comfortable chasing down why something is delayed, not just reporting that it is.



Responsibilities:



Task & Project Management

- Own ClickUp end to end: task ownership, priorities, statuses, due dates, dependencies, blockers, defect progress, and release status must always be accurate and up to date

- Log and triage all incoming work, bringing development requests, feature requests, and bug reports into a clean, organised queue ready to be assigned

- Assign and distribute tasks to developers (with technical input from our Tech Lead) and keep an ample backlog ready so no developer is ever waiting for work

- Track deadlines, update timelines when things change, and keep everything on track



Developer Coordination & Accountability

- Follow up on active tasks daily and hold developers and vendors accountable for delivering on time and to our standard

- Review PR turnaround, ensuring pull requests are completed and reviewed in a timely manner

- Review developer hourly summaries against the actual work delivered and perform due diligence on what we are billed

- Continually gather feedback from every developer, surface problems early, and remove bottlenecks before they cost us time



QA & Release Coordination

- Ensure every defect QA identifies has a clear owner, is tracked, followed up on, escalated if delayed, and retested

- Manage the "Ready for QA" handoff so QA testing is never blocked by unfinished work

- Track the weekly go-live and deployment status: is it on track, what is blocking it, and who owns what

- Coordinate work across the live environment, staging, and all three applications



Design Coordination

- When developers need mockups for a new page or flow, ensure the design team delivers them on time so developers are never waiting on creatives



Process & Documentation

- Build and maintain your own systems, SOPs, and checklists to make sure our processes are followed consistently

- Document workflows as you learn them, building a clear project management playbook

- Identify repetitive or inefficient processes that could be improved, standardised, or automated



Role Scope 

You will not make technical or architecture decisions; the Tech Lead owns those. Your input is welcome, and if you have opinions when edge cases or implementation approaches are being discussed, we want to hear them, but the final call always sits with the Tech Lead.



You will not write or review code, and you do not need to be a full-stack developer. Your responsibility is coordination, tracking, follow-up, accountability, and giving management an accurate view of project health at all times.



Required Experience

- 2+ years in project management, delivery management, or a similar coordination role with software/development teams

- Some development background or strong technical understanding, enough to follow technical discussions, understand how the parts of a system connect, and properly manage tickets, priorities, timelines, QA, and communication. You do not need to be able to build it yourself

- Experience with ClickUp, or with Jira/Asana and the ability to master ClickUp quickly

- Exceptional organisation and attention to detail. Your personal tracking must be flawless: every detail, every task, every responsibility accounted for, nothing ever missed

- A hawk eye on everything. You are comfortable watching every moving piece at once and following up every single day if that is what it takes to get things done

- Independent and self-directed. You build your own systems rather than waiting to be told what to check

- Strong written and spoken English. Your updates need to be clear and easy to act on



Only apply if you are exceptional in organisation and follow-through. If you are not, this role will not work out.



Strongly Preferred

- Experience managing remote or distributed development teams

- Experience with ecommerce platforms or multi-application projects

- Hands-on development experience in any stack

- Experience working alongside QA and structured testing processes

- Experience holding external vendors or agencies accountable

- Experience working with Australian businesses



Hours and Benefits

- Monday to Friday schedule, we'll agree on a roster

- Paid vacation leave after three months

- Performance-based pay increases over time

- Stable, long-term role with a growing Australian company

- A newly created position with real ownership and the opportunity to build the project management systems this team runs on as the business grows

- $800-$1000 USD (Depending on experience)



Application Questions

1. Describe your project management experience with software or development teams, including team sizes, the tools you used, and exactly what you were responsible for.

2. Describe the personal system you use to make sure nothing you are responsible for is ever missed. Be specific.

3. A developer's task is due tomorrow and they have not responded to your follow-up message today. Walk us through, step by step, what you would do.

4. A developer's hourly summary bills six hours for a task, but the delivered work looks much smaller. How would you handle this?

5. QA reports a defect but it is unclear which developer's work caused it. What do you do?

6. What is your experience with ClickUp (or Jira/Asana)? Give specific examples of what you have set up or managed.

7. In your own words, walk us through what typically happens between a developer finishing a piece of work and that work going live for users.

8. Briefly describe your technical or development background.

9. Please include a link to your LinkedIn profile if you have one.

Please begin your application with HAWKEYE so we know you have read the full job description.

title: Executive Assistant  for Business Operations & Growth Support
description:
We're an Australian property investment business launching several new ventures — including an online education platform and a drop-shipping curtain business — alongside our core operations. We're looking for a strong, capable operator who can take true end-to-end ownership: setting up a business from scratch and then running it day-to-day once live.



This is not an admin or support role. You'll be the person who builds how a business works — systems, processes, structure — and then keeps it running well. If one venture doesn't fill your time, you may take on more than one.



This is a full-time role, starting part-time for the first few months.



What you'll be doing

- Setting up new business ventures — it's systems, structure, and operations

- Running ventures day-to-day once they're operational

- Building and managing teams where needed as ventures grow

- Establishing processes so each business operates smoothly without constant oversight

- Identifying and solving operational problems before they become blockers

- Reporting progress and flagging issues that need attention

- Taking on new ventures or projects as they come up — scoping and launching each one

- Bringing structure to ambiguous, early-stage situations



Who we're looking for

You may be a strong fit if you:

- Have experience setting up a business, department, or venture from scratch — not just running an existing one

- Have experience managing or coordinating teams

- Are comfortable operating with real autonomy and minimal day-to-day direction

- Can make sound decisions independently and follow through without being chased

- Communicate clearly and professionally in written and spoken English

- Are a strategic thinker who is also structured and detail-oriented in execution

- Can juggle multiple ventures or priorities at once



Experience in online education, real estate, buyers agency, or ecommerce is a strong plus — but we're primarily looking for a proven operator who can figure things out, regardless of specific industry background.



What success looks like

- New ventures move from idea to fully operational

- Once live, each venture runs smoothly with minimal oversight required

- Problems get identified and solved before they escalate

- You become someone we can hand a new venture to and trust it'll get built and run well



Hours and working arrangement

- Full-time role, starting part-time for the first few months. Some availability during Melbourne business hours required. Exact hours and schedule will be discussed with shortlisted applicants.



How to apply

Please submit the following:

- Your most recent, updated CV

- A 2–3 minute Loom video introducing yourself and walking through your relevant experience — please speak naturally, and DO NOT read from a script



Applications without a Loom video will not be considered. Please speak naturally in your video rather than reading from a prepared script.
