title: Short-Term Rental Operations Virtual Assistant
description:
About Us



We’re a Melbourne-based, family-run short-term rental and property management business managing a growing portfolio of high-quality homes and apartments.



Our focus is not simply on managing bookings. We aim to operate properties professionally, maximise their performance, provide an excellent experience for guests and owners, and build systems that allow our portfolio to grow without sacrificing quality.



We place a high value on fast communication, attention to detail, clear processes, commercial thinking, and people who take genuine ownership of their responsibilities.



You’ll be joining a close-knit team of six people, made up of three team members based locally in Melbourne and three Virtual Assistants in the Philippines. You will be working closely with both the Melbourne team and the other VAs, with responsibilities shared across guest operations, property performance, owner communication, cleaning coordination, listings, pricing, onboarding, and administration.



This is intended to be a long-term position with opportunities to take on greater responsibility as the business grows.



Role Overview



We’re looking for someone who already understands the short-term rental industry and can become an important part of our day-to-day operations team.



Previous experience working in short-term rental management is highly preferred. This may include working directly for a short-term rental/property management company or previously working as a Virtual Assistant supporting an Airbnb or short-term rental management business.



Because of the nature of the position, we’re particularly interested in candidates who already understand concepts such as guest communication, turnovers, cleaning coordination, property issues, Airbnb and 
 listings, calendar management, owner expectations, and the fast-moving nature of short-term accommodation.



The position will begin with a strong focus on guest communication and daily operations, but it is designed to develop well beyond guest messaging.



As you become confident with our portfolio and systems, you will become increasingly involved in:



Guest and reservation management

Pricing and revenue optimisation

Listing optimisation

Owner communication

Property onboarding

Cleaning and turnover coordination

Maintenance coordination

Property performance reviews

Administrative and bookkeeping support

New business and portfolio growth



We are looking for someone who wants to understand why we do things, not simply complete tasks from a checklist.



Over time, there will be opportunities to take ownership of areas of the business, help improve our systems, train future team members, and develop into a more senior operations or portfolio management position.



Working Hours



This is a full-time position working 5 days per week, with Thursday and Friday off.



**Monday**

Melbourne Time: 7:00 AM – 3:30 PM

Philippines Time: 5:00 AM – 1:30 PM



**Tuesday**

Melbourne Time: 3:00 PM – 11:30 PM

Philippines Time: 1:00 PM – 9:30 PM



**Wednesday**

Melbourne Time: 3:00 PM – 11:30 PM

Philippines Time: 1:00 PM – 9:30 PM



**Thursday**

Melbourne Time: OFF

Philippines Time: OFF



**Friday**

Melbourne Time: OFF

Philippines Time: OFF



**Saturday**

Melbourne Time: 7:00 AM – 3:30 PM

Philippines Time: 5:00 AM – 1:30 PM



**Sunday**

Melbourne Time: 7:00 AM – 3:30 PM

Philippines Time: 5:00 AM – 1:30 PM



**Working Days:** Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Saturday and Sunday

**Days Off:** Thursday and Friday



Because this role supports live short-term rental operations, reliability and availability during these rostered hours are essential.



Key Responsibilities

1. Guest Messaging & Reservation Operations



You will help manage communication throughout the complete guest journey, including pre-booking, pre-arrival, in-stay, checkout, and post-stay communication.



Responsibilities will include:



Responding to guest messages across Airbnb, 
, VRBO, and other booking channels

Answering pre-booking enquiries and helping convert suitable enquiries into reservations

Sending and checking arrival, access, check-in, and checkout information

Managing common guest requests such as early check-in, late checkout, parking questions, date changes, additional guests, lost property, and property-specific questions

Troubleshooting access issues and common property problems

Identifying urgent situations and escalating them quickly

Coordinating with cleaners, maintenance contractors, and Melbourne-based team members when required

Managing noise complaints, lockouts, urgent maintenance issues, and other time-sensitive situations in accordance with our procedures

Maintaining accurate reservation notes and internal records

Following up on outstanding guest issues until they are resolved

Identifying potential guest experience issues before they develop into complaints or poor reviews



The goal is not simply to respond quickly. We expect communication to be clear, thoughtful, professional, and solution-focused.



2. Pricing & Revenue Optimisation



A significant part of the role will develop into pricing optimisation and revenue management across our portfolio.



You will work with the team to ensure that our properties are competitively positioned and that pricing reflects demand, seasonality, booking pace, events, occupancy, and market conditions.



Responsibilities may include:



Reviewing property pricing regularly

Monitoring future occupancy and booking pace

Identifying dates where pricing may be too high or too low

Reviewing minimum-night requirements and length-of-stay restrictions

Adjusting rates and calendar strategies based on demand

Monitoring upcoming Melbourne events, holidays, school holidays, concerts, sporting events, and other demand drivers

Reviewing gaps between reservations and identifying opportunities to increase occupancy

Monitoring short-notice availability

Comparing our properties against relevant competing listings

Identifying underperforming periods

Supporting last-minute pricing strategies

Reviewing longer-term forward occupancy

Helping maximise revenue without unnecessarily discounting properties

Reviewing the performance of pricing changes and learning from the results



Depending on experience, you may work with dynamic pricing software and our property management/channel management systems.



Training will be provided around our strategy, but we are particularly interested in someone who enjoys working with numbers, patterns, and commercial decisions.



3. Listing Optimisation



You will also help ensure that our listings are continually improving rather than simply being created once and forgotten.



Listing optimisation will include:



Reviewing Airbnb, 
, VRBO, and other listings for accuracy

Improving listing titles and descriptions

Strengthening the first sections of listings to communicate key selling points

Reviewing photo sequencing and identifying photography improvements

Ensuring amenities are correctly selected and displayed

Updating property information when features or facilities change

Improving house rules and guest expectations

Updating check-in information

Maintaining digital guidebooks

Reviewing competitor listings

Identifying opportunities to differentiate our properties

Reviewing guest questions and feedback to identify information that should be added to listings

Monitoring listing quality and completeness

Helping improve conversion from listing views to bookings



We want someone who can eventually look at a property listing and ask:



What can we change to make this property perform better?



4. Owner Communication



As you become familiar with our properties and systems, you will increasingly assist with owner communication.



This can include:



Responding to routine owner questions

Providing updates regarding maintenance and property issues

Requesting approval for repairs, purchases, or improvements

Following up on outstanding owner decisions

Communicating recommendations for property improvements

Providing updates regarding guest i
 where appropriate

Helping explain operational decisions

Maintaining clear records of owner approvals and instructions

Assisting with property performance discussions



Our owners trust us with valuable assets, so communication needs to be professional, accurate, timely, and well documented.



5. New Property Onboarding



You will help take newly signed properties from initial handover through to being ready to accept their first guests.



This includes following our onboarding systems and ensuring that no important details are missed.



Responsibilities may include collecting and documenting:



Property access information

Wi-Fi information

Parking instructions

Building access procedures

Rubbish and recycling instructions

Appliance instructions

Heating and cooling information

Linen requirements

Bedding configurations

Property inventory

House rules

Emergency information

Owner preferences

Maintenance contacts

Local recommendations



You may also assist with:



Building Airbnb and other platform listings

Creating house manuals and digital guidebooks

Coordinating photography

Reviewing photography

Setting up cleaning requirements

Preparing cleaner checklists

Setting up pricing

Configuring booking rules

Testing guest communications

Conducting final pre-launch checks



The objective is to make sure a new property launches professionally from day one.



6. Cleaning & Turnover Coordination



Our cleaning team is a critical part of the guest experience.



You will help ensure that cleaning schedules accurately reflect reservations and that problems are followed through to completion.



Responsibilities include:



Scheduling cleans based on bookings

Checking for booking changes that affect cleaning schedules

Communicating last-minute changes

Monitoring cleaner reports

Tracking linen requirements

Coordinating restocking of guest consumables

Reviewing reported damage or maintenance issues

Following up on cleaning quality concerns

Recording recurring problems

Escalating serious cleaning issues

Helping maintain consistent presentation standards across the portfolio



You will need to be comfortable communicating clearly and professionally when something has not been completed to the expected standard.



7. Maintenance & Issue Coordination



You will assist the Melbourne team with keeping maintenance issues organised and moving toward resolution.



This may include:



Logging maintenance issues

Gathering information and photos

Communicating with guests

Contacting relevant contractors

Requesting quotes

Seeking owner approval where required

Scheduling access

Following up on incomplete work

Updating guests and owners

Recording completed repairs

Escalating urgent issues to the Melbourne team



An important part of this responsibility is making sure tasks do not disappear simply because the first message has been sent.



We value people who follow an issue through until there is a clear outcome.



8. Administration & Bookkeeping Support



As you develop in the role, you may also assist with financial and administrative processes.



This can include:



Invoice tracking

Receipt organisation

Recording expenses

Tracking owner-reimbursable expenses

Basic account reconciliations

Checking contractor invoices

Supporting owner statement preparation

Maintaining financial trackers

Identifying missing invoices or documentation



Full bookkeeping experience is not required, but strong numerical accuracy and attention to detail are important.



9. Business Growth & New Management Opportunities



As the business continues to grow, there will also be opportunities to assist with bringing new properties into our portfolio.



This may include:



Following up with prospective owners

Maintaining our sales and enquiry pipeline

Preparing information or proposal packs

Conducting property and market research

Gathering comparable listing information

Preparing preliminary revenue information

Tracking follow-ups

Helping ensure potential new clients receive timely communication



Candidates who demonstrate strong communication and commercial skills may take on considerably more responsibility in this area over time.



Working as Part of Our Team



You will be joining a team of six:



Three team members based in Melbourne

Three Virtual Assistants based in the Philippines



We operate as one team rather than treating our offshore team as a separate support function.



You will communicate regularly with both the Melbourne-based team and your fellow VAs, hand over outstanding tasks between shifts, share information about properties and guests, and help ensure nothing is lost between team members.



Because several people may interact with the same reservation or property, clear documentation is extremely important.



We expect team members to:



Leave useful notes for one another

Communicate important developments

Ask questions when something genuinely requires clarification

Make decisions independently when the appropriate process is clear

Escalate appropriately rather than escalating everything

Take responsibility for following through on tasks

Help other team members when workloads change

Look for opportunities to improve our systems

Experience We’re Looking For



We are particularly interested in applicants who have previous short-term rental experience.



Ideally, you have previously:



Worked for a short-term rental or Airbnb management company

Worked as a Virtual Assistant for a short-term rental management business

Managed Airbnb, 
, VRBO, or similar reservations

Communicated directly with short-term rental guests

Coordinated cleaners or turnovers

Worked with a property management system or channel manager

Helped update listings or calendars

Been exposed to dynamic pricing or revenue management



Experience with Australian short-term rentals is a bonus but is not essential.



Candidates with substantial hotel, serviced apartment, hospitality operations, or property management experience may also be considered where the experience is directly relevant.



Tools & Systems



Experience with some of the following would be beneficial:



Airbnb



VRBO

Hostaway

Guesty

Lodgify

Dynamic pricing/revenue management software

Notion

Google Sheets

Microsoft Excel

Dropbox


WhatsApp

Canva



You do not need to know every system we use.



More important is your ability to learn software quickly, follow processes accurately, and understand how different systems connect to the overall operation.



What We're Looking For

Excellent Written English



A large portion of this role involves communicating with guests, owners, cleaners, contractors, and team members.



Your written English should be natural, clear, professional, and appropriate to the situation.



Strong Attention to Detail



Small mistakes in short-term rental management can become large problems.



An incorrect access code, missed cleaner update, wrong date, pricing error, or forgotten maintenance task can directly affect a guest stay or property owner.



We are looking for someone who checks their work.



Calm Under Pressure



Not every day will go according to plan.



Guests may be locked out. Cleaners may be delayed. Appliances may stop working. A booking may arrive unexpectedly. A guest may be frustrated.



We need someone who can remain calm, understand the problem, communicate clearly, and work toward a solution.



Commercial Thinking



We want you to care about how properties perform.



That means thinking about occupancy, nightly rates, reviews, listing quality, guest satisfaction, operating costs, and owner retention rather than seeing each task in isolation.



Ownership



If you identify a problem, we want you to help move it toward a resolution.



If someone needs to be followed up tomorrow, it should be followed up.



If a listing contains incorrect information, it should be corrected.



If a property has several empty nights approaching, we want you to notice.



Reliability



Because this role covers live guest operations, attendance and punctuality are extremely important.



You must have a reliable computer, reliable internet connection, and an appropriate backup plan for reasonable internet or power interruptions.



Ability to Follow Systems — and Improve Them



We have SOPs, templates, checklists, and processes that should be followed.



At the same time, we do not want someone who blindly follows an inefficient process forever.



Once you understand the business, we encourage you to identify improvements and suggest better ways of working.



How Performance Will Be Measured



Performance will be assessed across a combination of operational quality, responsiveness, accuracy, and property performance.



Key indicators may include:



Guest response times

Quality and accuracy of guest communication

Guest satisfaction and review outcomes

Number of preventable operational mistakes

Accuracy of reservation and property information

Completion of tasks within required timeframes

Quality of shift handovers and internal notes

Cleaning and maintenance issue follow-through

Accuracy of listing information

Improvement in listing quality

Pricing and calendar management accuracy

Identification of revenue opportunities

Forward occupancy awareness

Owner communication quality

Reliability and attendance

Ability to solve problems independently

Contribution to improving team systems and processes

title: Senior Video Editor (YouTube)
description:
WHO WE ARE

NIA Production is a YouTube conglomerate. We own, build, and operate our own channels in-house. Every channel we run is ours.

You can see our work at 



We are 90+ people strong and growing rapidly. Most of our team is hybrid and we hire globally. We move fast. We care about results, and we hire people who think the same way.

WHY THIS ROLE EXISTS

NIA Production doesn't launch channels by guessing what works; we build repeatable systems backed by audience data.

The Experimental Channel Video Editor/Channel Launch Editor exists to develop the editing formula behind every new YouTube channel we launch. Rather than maintaining an established editing style, you'll identify what keeps viewers watching, test competing creative approaches, and turn successful experiments into documented systems that other editors can execute consistently.

Once a channel's editing formula has been proven and handed off, you'll move on to the next experimental channel and repeat the process. Your success isn't measured by how many videos you edit, rather it's measured by how many successful editing systems you create.



HOW THIS ROLE WORKS

Each engagement follows the same cycle:

Discovery and competitor research. Align on goals and audience, tear down 8 to 15 competitor channels (plus any channels outside the niche whose packaging approach could be useful to intergrate), and document which visual patterns work. 

Concept development. Build mood boards and concept options, then commit to one direction.

Pilot videos. Edit benchmark videos to prove the style works in a real edit, not just in mockups.

Style package and template build. Package the style guide and all reusable assets so someone else can run it without you.

Handoff and training. Train the incoming editor, answer their questions, and guide them accordingly through the transition, then move to the next channel.



RESPONSIBILITIES

Research and creative direction. Study the top-performing videos in the niche and work out the editing mechanics behind their retention: how the first 15 to 30 seconds are built, where cuts speed up or slow down, how b-roll and sound design hold attention. Turn that into a direction covering pacing, hook structure, text and graphics, music, and SFX. You pitch this direction and you defend it, with reasoning specific to that niche rather than copying what worked elsewhere.

Niche and channel mastery. Develop a deep, working understanding of both the niche and the specific channel you're building, deep enough to know what will work before testing it. Take what's proven to work elsewhere and adapt it so it fits this channel specifically, and originate new ideas where the niche has a gap, so the channel stands out rather than blends in. 

Pilot editing. Prove the style in real edits. Take raw, unstructured footage and turn it into videos with a strong hook and intentional pacing.

Testing and optimization. Run structured tests between competing approaches, such as two different openings or pacing styles, and use average view duration and retention data to d
 what becomes the standard. When a style is not working, flag it early and propose a new direction instead of repeating what has already failed.

Systemizing and handing off. Build the infrastructure the channel needs to move fast: intro templates, title and caption styles, SFX libraries, transition presets, project templates. Document the formula, train the editor who inherits it, and leave notes detailed enough for them to hold the retention curve without guessing at your reasoning.

Team coordination and delivery. Coordinate with the team, always meet turnaround times, keep up great communication, and be reliable. As we scale, this includes managing and coordinating any additional designers brought on to support volume.

Proactive growth mindset. Be proactive and obsessed with self-improvement, pushing to get better each day.



WHAT THIS ROLE IS NOT

This is about the kind of person you are, not just the tasks.

You are not a stylist. You do not have one signature look you apply to everything. A fast-cut challenge channel and a slow cinematic one need different instincts, and you have both.

You are not a maintainer. You like working out the formula, not running it. If you need one channel to settle into, the constant handoffs will wear on you.

You are not an order-taker. You do not just cut what you are handed. You push back on footage that cannot support retention and defend a direction with reasoning.

You are not attached to your edit. Your taste is not the standard. A retention graph can prove you wrong, and you accept it when it does.

You are not a lone wolf. You do not make yourself valuable by being the only one who can recreate your edit. You build so someone else can take over.



REQUIREMENTS



Must-Have:

A portfolio of real, published YouTube edits, ideally across more than one niche or format, since this role will not stay on one type of content.

A track record of turning raw, unstructured footage into compelling videos with a strong hook and intentional pacing, not just polishing footage already shot to a script.

Strong ability to read retention graphs: spotting the exact 
nt viewers dropped off, explaining why, and tying it to a specific editing decision.

Demonstrated versatility, with evidence of adapting your pacing and style across genuinely different content instead of applying one signature style to everything.

The ability to watch a competitor's video and go into full technical detail which editing decisions are driving retention, rather than just saying it feels well edited.

Strong motion graphics ability and working knowledge of AI tools relevant to editing and production.

Ability to manage your own workload across more than one channel without close oversight.

You genuinely enjoy hard challenges. Working out a retention formula from raw, untested footage is difficult and full of dead ends, and you are the kind of person who is drawn to that rather than worn down by it.



Nice-to-Have:

You have launched a channel from its earliest uploads, building the editing style and format from scratch instead of joining an established show.

You have built reusable editing systems (templates, presets, SFX libraries) that other editors actually adopted.

You have trained someone or handed off work before. 



RESULTS



Success in this role is measured by:

Average view duration and retention improve and hold across multiple uploads, not on one standout edit.

Every channel you work on ends up with a documented editing system the team can run without you.

Your tests produce clear, data-backed winners the team can confidently standardize.

You move through channels at a healthy pace instead of staying on one longer than needed.

Your handoff notes are clear enough that another editor understands the reasoning behind every major decision and can hold the retention performance without extra guidance.

You coordinate well with the team and continue to be proactive in surfacing issues that affect the channel’s success.

Remote | Philippines-Based | AEST Hours



**To Apply:** forms.cloud.microsoft/r/xawDceDUDU





At Pierian, we help Australian mortgage brokers scale their businesses through highly skilled offshore teams, streamlined operations, and AI-powered solutions. 



The Senior Mortgage Analyst is responsible for managing and strengthening long-term relationships with Australian mortgage broker clients following successful onboarding by the Transition Team. Combining strong Australian mortgage expertise with operational leadership, this role ensures clients continue to receive exceptional service, achieve operational efficiencies, and maximize the value of their offshore team. Working closely with brokers and internal teams, you will monitor operational performance, resolve challenges, identify improvement opportunities, and provide strategic recommendations that support client growth and retention. This role is ideal for experienced Australian mortgage professionals looking to move beyond day-to-day loan processing into a client-facing operational leadership position. 





What You'll Be Doing Every Day  



Client Relationship Management

> Partner with Operations Managers, Team Leaders, Recruitment, and Leadership to support client success.

You Must Have 

> Minimum 5 years of experience working within an Australian mortgage brokerage or lending environment.  

> Extensive knowledge of Australian residential lending processes from application through settlement.  

> Strong understanding of lender policies, NCCP compliance, and mortgage operations.

> Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.  

> Availability to work full-time during AEST business hours.

> 5+ years of experience in Australian mortgage operations, broker support, or client relationship management.  

> Previous experience in one or more of the following:  

Senior Mortgage Broker Assistant

Loan Analyst  

Mortgage Operations Specialist  

Team Leader  

Client Relationship Manager  

Account Manager  

Broker Support Lead

> Proficient in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook).  

> Fast internet connection and a professional home office setup. 





Nice to Have

> Experience creating SOPs, workflow documentation, or training materials.  

> Experience managing offshore teams.  

> Exposure to AI-powered workflow tools and automation platforms.  

> Experience with Quickli, Podium, Simpology, MyCRM, or similar mortgage technologies.  

> Cert IV in Finance & Mortgage Broking. 

 



Education 

A bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Banking, Accounting, Management, or a related field is preferred but not required. We value extensive Australian mortgage experience, client relationship management, and operational leadership above formal qualifications. 



 

What We Offer 

> Competitive base salary based on experience 

> HMO coverage 

> Leave credits 

> 13th Month Pay 

> Career growth — we're building a 50+ person capability centre within 12 months

Working hours



9:00 AM – 5:30 PM Eastern Time (ET)

Onboarding

Comfortable navigating a CRM independently — logging calls, updating records, and managing your pipeline.





What you're walking into



A company with a clear system, transparent compensation, and leadership that takes your development seriously. You'll know exactly what's expected, exactly what you'll earn, and exactly how to grow. We want people who stay, improve, and build with us long term.

Ready to apply?

title: Loan & Transaction Coordinator (High Growth / Long-Term Career)
description:
About Us

We are an evolving, fast-growing US mortgage and real estate firm (NEXA Lending / New World Real Estate Consultants) specializing in real estate investor financing, commercial projects, and residential lending.



Our business is constantly expanding and introducing new concepts. Software and industry tools can be taught, but attitude, resourcefulness, and adaptability cannot. We pride ourselves on a high-touch, relationship-first experience where every client feels supported, valued, and cared for.

title: Part-Time SolidWorks Sheet Metal Designer / CAD Draftsman
description:
Position Overview



We are looking for an experienced SolidWorks Sheet Metal Designer / CAD Draftsperson to support our engineering and fabrication requirements on a part-time basis.



The ideal candidate has strong practical experience using SolidWorks, particularly the Sheet Metal module, and is comfortable working from existing models, basic concepts, measurements, and hand sketches to produce accurate, fabrication-ready drawings.



This is a part-time position of approximately 10–20 hours per week, with the potential for ongoing work depending on project requirements.



Key Responsibilities



CAD Design & Modification

Redraw, modify, and adjust existing SolidWorks parts and assemblies.

Create new sheet metal parts based on:

Basic SolidWorks models or concepts provided by the client.

Hand sketches and drawings.

Measurements and other design information.

Develop accurate sheet metal models using SolidWorks Sheet Metal tools.

Apply appropriate bends, folds, bends allowances, reliefs, holes,  cut-outs, and other sheet metal features.

Modify designs based on feedback and fabrication requirements.

Assembly & Mating

Create and update SolidWorks assemblies.

Mate and position components accurately within assemblies.

Check that components fit and function correctly together.

Identify potential design or fitment issues before fabrication.





Technical Drawings & Documentation

Produce clear, professional, fabrication-ready technical drawings.

Generate drawings in PDF format for manufacturing/fabrication.

Include appropriate dimensions, tolerances, material specifications,  bend information, notes, and other relevant manufacturing details.

Prepare complete parts lists / Bills of Materials (BOMs) where required.

Ensure drawings and documentation are accurate and consistent with   the final SolidWorks models.

Maintain organized CAD files, revisions, and drawing documentation.



Required Skills & Experience

Proven experience using SolidWorks professionally.

Strong experience specifically with SolidWorks Sheet Metal.

Experience creating sheet metal components and assemblies.

Ability to interpret hand sketches, rough concepts, measurements, and existing CAD models.

Strong understanding of manufacturing and fabrication principles.

Ability to create accurate, production-ready technical drawings.

Experience creating BOMs and detailed parts lists.

Strong attention to detail and accuracy.

Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.

Good understanding of dimensions, tolerances, materials, bends, folds, and fabrication requirements.



Preferred Experience

Experience with the following would be advantageous:

Metal fabrication and manufacturing.

Laser cutting, CNC cutting, bending, folding, and welding.

Fabrication drawings for workshop/manufacturing environments.

Designing brackets, enclosures, frames, panels, guards, and other  fabricated sheet metal components.

Working with existing products and improving or modifying their designs.



Working Arrangement

Part-Time: Approximately 10–20 hours per week

Work Arrangement: Remote / Flexible

Workload: Project-based and ongoing as required

Schedule: Flexible, provided agreed deadlines and deliverables are met

Engagement: Suitable for a freelancer, independent contractor, or part-time CAD         



What We Are Looking For

We are looking for someone who is hands-on, technically capable, and detail-oriented.

You should be able to take a basic concept or sketch and turn it into a properly modelled SolidWorks sheet metal component and, ultimately, a clear, accurate drawing that can be sent directly to the workshop for fabrication.

The ability to work independently is important, as projects may range from simple modifications to creating new components and assemblies from initial concepts.



Application Requirements

When applying, please provide:

Your CV or professional profile.

Examples of previous SolidWorks Sheet Metal projects or a portfolio.

Details of your experience with sheet metal design and fabrication.

Your experience creating manufacturing/fabrication drawings.

Your preferred hourly rate.

Your availability and typical hours per week.

Your SolidWorks version/license availability.



Please note: Candidates may be asked to complete a short practical SolidWorks Sheet Metal test as part of the selection process.

title: Junior Video Editor
description:

Exchange Life is a fast-growing e-commerce travel jewelry brand. We sell collectible country charms for travelers, with new product lines launching soon. Our content team of editors, filmmakers, and creators works fully remotely across the world.

This role is a starting point, and we're straight about that — it's focused work editing headline videos to a proven format. But it's a starting point on a team that promotes from the inside. Many of our editors have been with us two or more years, and the ones who started here are now the people briefing everyone else.

Where You'll Be in Six Months

AI Advanced Editor.

That's the next title, and it's the step most of our strong headline editors make inside their first six months. An AI Advanced Editor works on our highest-leverage creative: AI-assisted video, hook development, and the ad formats we scale behind. You stop working purely to a template and start building the ones other people follow.

It's d
 by performance, not tenure. Produce winners consistently and you'll get there sooner.

What You'll Earn

Base: $5 USD/hour

Performance bonuses: $300–$800/month, paid per winning creative — when a video you cut hits our performance thresholds or scales on paid, you get paid for it

There's no cap on how good your month can be

What Success Looks Like

Within three to six months, you're consistently producing headline videos that perform on both paid and organic channels — 50%+ thumb-stop rates and 30%+ hold rates — and iterating on winning formats without needing day-to-day direction.

Responsibilities

Edit TikTok and Reels headline content optimized for hook rate, retention, and watch time

Review past edits daily, identify what is and isn't working, and apply those lessons

Work with the marketing team to test new creative angles and iterate on proven formats

Turn work around quickly and communicate proactively each day

Track TikTok and Instagram trends and apply them where relevant

Requirements

A recent portfolio of short-form edits (ideally 20+ from the past few months)

Ability to break down why a viral video or high-performing ad worked

Comfortable reading performance metrics (hook rate, retention, watch time) and adjusting accordingly

Skilled in CapCut Pro or a comparable editing tool

Strong written and spoken English, and the ability to work independently

Takes ownership and applies feedback consistently

Preferred

Experience editing for e-commerce brands

Exposure to AI video tools, talking heads, or voiceover formats

Experience interpreting paid ad metrics

What You'll Learn Here

Most editing roles teach you software. This one teaches you why things sell. You'll get direct access to paid ad data on real spend, see which of your creatives print money and which die, and build the one skill that makes editors expensive: knowing what to make before you make it.

Access to courses and paid software

1-on-1 mentorship from our Content Lead

Full visibility into TikTok and Meta performance data on your own work

Not a Fit If

Your portfolio is mostly long-form, YouTube, or event/wedding content

You prefer a fixed schedule or close day-to-day supervision

You're looking for a short-term project or side gig

Working Style

Independent contractor engagement, paid in USD

100% remote, approximately 40 hours per week, long-term

Flexible schedule with no required timezone overlap — async communication daily

Flexible paid time off, coordinated with the team

Tools: CapCut Pro (or comparable), TikTok and Meta analytics

No micromanagement

How to Apply

Applications take about five minutes. We review every submission.

title: Tekla Structural Steel & AutoCAD 2D Detailer
description:
We are seeking a highly experienced and detail-oriented Tekla Structural Steel Detailer who is also proficient in AutoCAD 2D. This is a full-time, long-term remote position.



Both Tekla Structures and AutoCAD 2D are mandatory. Please do not apply unless you have strong practical experience with both programs and access to fully operational versions of the required software. Software will not be provided by the company.



Key responsibilities:



• Develop accurate Tekla models for structural steel projects using architectural, structural and engineering drawings.



• Prepare complete structural steel shop drawings, including general arrangement drawings, assembly drawings, single-part drawings, connection details, material lists and fabrication information.



• Identify discrepancies, missing information and coordination issues between architectural, structural and other relevant drawings.



• Prepare clear and professional RFIs and coordinate drawing revisions and approvals.



• Produce accurate AutoCAD 2D shop drawings for aluminium and architectural metalwork, including balustrades, handrails, privacy screens, louvres, awnings, pergolas, fences, gates and façade-related metalwork.



• Communicate professionally by telephone and
 with engineers, architects, builders, project managers, suppliers and our internal team.



• Manage drawing comments, maintain revision control and complete work within the required deadlines.



Mandatory requirements:



• Advanced practical experience with Tekla Structures and structural steel detailing.



• Strong AutoCAD 2D drafting experience.



• Access to fully operational Tekla Structures and AutoCAD software. The company will not provide the required software.



• Ability to accurately read and understand architectural, structural and engineering drawings.



• Strong knowledge of structural steel fabrication, connections and erection requirements.



• Ability to independently produce complete, fabrication-ready drawings—not only Tekla models.



• Excellent written and spoken English.



• Confidence communicating professionally by telephone,
 and online meetings.



• Exceptional attention to detail and a thorough checking process.



• Reliable, hardworking, organised and able to work quickly without compromising accuracy.



• A suitable computer, reliable high-speed internet and a professional remote working environment.



Our projects are detailed in millimetres and require an extremely high level of accuracy. Even small errors involving dimensions, levels, members, connections or revisions can cause significant fabrication and installation problems. The successful applicant must carefully cross-check all drawings and take responsibility for the accuracy and completeness of their work.



Shortlisted applicants will be required to complete a practical Tekla and AutoCAD 2D drafting test. Only applicants who successfully complete the test will be considered for the position.



Experience with Australian construction projects, Australian structural steel practices and relevant Australian Standards will be highly regarded.



To apply, please provide:



1. Your CV.

2. Examples of Tekla structural steel models and fabrication drawings completed personally by you.

3. Examples of AutoCAD 2D metalwork shop drawings completed personally by you.

4. Details of your Tekla and AutoCAD experience.

5. Confirmation that you have access to fully operational Tekla Structures and AutoCAD software.

6. Your expected monthly salary.

7. Your availability and proposed commencement date.

8. Confirmation that you are willing to complete a practical Tekla and AutoCAD 2D drafting test.



Applications without relevant Tekla and AutoCAD 2D work samples, or without access to the required software, will not be considered.

HOW TO APPLY — DO NOT SEND A GENERIC RESUME



Answer the Matrix below. Short, specific answers. I want proof you have been the driver of success and revenue for an organization — the result that would not have happened without you.

Send your resume / cv, portfolio, linkedin, and a short loom video or voice recording detailing the past successful contributions that most makes you an eligible candidate.

Start your application with the word MATRIX so I know you actually read this.



Fastest and sharpest wins. Generic loses.

title: Appointment Setter
description:
You've achieved great results in sales, appointment setting, or telemarketing. You're resilient, you don't take rejection personally, and you understand that the phone is your primary tool. You're comfortable with cold calling and know that every 'no' gets you closer to a 'yes'. But you're ready for a role where your effort is directly tied to your results.



You'll join Performia Australia, part of a global Swedish HR consultancy operating in 26 countries. Our mission is to train and support business owners so they know how to identify and build productive, safe and fun teams.



Your end goal is to fill the CEO's calendar with qualified appointments. You'll be proactively prospecting and calling a mix of warm leads, contacts from our database, and cold lists. Your job is to generate the activity that creates the pipeline. You'll qualify them, handle objections, and book them for a meeting with the CEO.



We have a strong lead database and we need you to take ownership of finding and creating opportunities. This means a significant portion of your time will be spent on cold calling and prospecting. The role will be high-volume and requires discipline and resilience.



The role will be challenging and demanding. You'll be expected to make a high volume of calls, face frequent rejection, and maintain a positive, professional attitude. You need to be able to work independently, manage your time effectively, and take full ownership of your results. This is not a role for someone who needs a warm lead handed to them.



In return, you'll be paid a base hourly rate plus a generous bonus for every qualified appointment that is kept. You'll have the opportunity to receive full training on the Performia methodology and sales process once proven your ability. You'll work from home with a flexible, cheerful, and outcome-focused team. There are significant growth opportunities for top performers.



If you are someone who cannot work independently, needs to be around people all the time, or cannot handle cold calling and rejection, then this role will not be right for you.



If you're driven and love the challenge of the hunt, apply now.



IMPORTANT INSTRUCTIONS. 



We will only consider candidates who submit their application to our candidate management system.



To submit your application - Fill out this short form. It takes 10 seconds.





About Us



At Performia, we help businesses through our flagship product called the Performia Journey, to transition their culture from being a place where people go to 'do a job' to a productive, safe and fun space where much like a sports team, everyone is motivated by accomplishment, and working towards the same goals.



It’s unlike anything else in the market and we need someone who thrives on creating opportunities.



We give businesses a complete system to create a high performing, safe and fun team culture, and it starts with knowing how to hire the right people.



Clients who build their team the Performia way, see that work stops feeling like work, and becomes a game the team is motivated to play.



Performia is a Swedish company established in 2002 with offices in 27 countries, launching in Australia in 2006.

title: # SEO Implementation Specialist — WordPress / Divi, On-Page, Technical & Content SEO
description:
# SEO Implementation Specialist — WordPress / Divi, On-Page, Technical & Content SEO



**Project-Based | Remote**

**Project Budget: $1,000–$1,500 USD**



## About the Project



We are a U.S.-based B2B managed IT services company looking for an experienced **SEO Implementation Specialist** to complete a defined SEO improvement project.



A comprehensive SEO audit has already been completed, and we have established the overall business and marketing direction.



**We are not looking for another SEO audit. We need someone who can implement the work.**



Our website is built in **WordPress using Divi Builder**. You must be comfortable going directly into WordPress and Divi to make approved changes rather than simply providing recommendations for someone else to implement.



Our SEO and website strategy is being updated to focus primarily on businesses in:



* Architecture

* Engineering

* Construction

* Manufacturing



Our goal is not simply to increase website traffic. We want to improve organic visibility among businesses that fit our target market and ultimately generate qualified managed IT opportunities.



## Project Responsibilities



You will receive our existing SEO audit and approved priorities. Your responsibility will be to implement the approved work directly in WordPress, Divi, analytics platforms, and other applicable systems.



### WordPress & Divi Implementation



* Edit existing WordPress pages using Divi Builder

* Create approved new pages using our existing website design and components

* Update copy, headings, links, buttons, images, and other page elements

* Maintain consistency with the existing website design

* Make SEO improvements without unnecessarily redesigning the website

* QA your work on desktop and mobile



### On-Page SEO



* Optimize existing service pages

* Perform keyword and search-intent research where necessary

* Optimize page titles and meta descriptions

* Improve H1, H2, and H3 structure

* Improve page and keyword targeting

* Optimize image alt text where appropriate

* Improve internal linking

* Identify and resolve duplicate or competing content

* Optimize existing pages before recommending unnecessary new pages

* Improve service, industry, and location cross-linking



### Website Copy & Content



* Rewrite and improve existing website copy where necessary

* Improve service pages for both search visibility and conversion

* Develop and optimize content focused on Architecture, Engineering, Construction, and Manufacturing

* Improve existing location pages

* Create approved new service, industry, or location pages

* Write clear, natural copy for a professional U.S. B2B audience

* Incorporate our positioning and subject-matter expertise into the content

* Avoid generic, keyword-stuffed, or obviously AI-generated SEO copy



### Technical SEO



* Implement appropriate 301 redirects

* Correct broken internal links

* Help resolve duplicate, orphaned, and unnecessary pages

* Review and correct approved sitemap/indexation issues

* Consolidate competing pages where appropriate

* Implement or correct appropriate schema/structured data

* Address technical SEO issues identified in the existing audit

* Identify when an issue genuinely requires specialized development work and clearly document what is needed



### Analytics & Measurement



* Review existing Google Analytics 4 and Google Search Console configuration

* Configure and verify appropriate conversion/key-event tracking

* Verify form-submission tracking

* Track important website interactions where appropriate

* Help identify internal or clearly automated traffic affecting analytics

* Establish baseline measurements before major changes

* Document results so website performance can be evaluated after implementation



### Local & Website SEO



* Establish consistent business information across the website and applicable third-party citations

* Correct inconsistent NAP/business information where access is available

* Improve website location signals

* Optimize approved location pages

* Support a Central Texas service-area strategy through website content and SEO



Our company is based in **Kyle, Texas** and serves businesses throughout **Central Texas**.



## Google Business Profile



**Google Business Profile management is NOT part of this project.**



All Google Business Profile changes will be handled internally.



You may identify or recommend a Google Business Profile change when relevant, but you will not be responsible for implementing it.



## Initial Project Deliverables



The exact implementation plan will be finalized before work begins, but the project is expected to include:



* Analytics and conversion tracking setup

* SEO baseline documentation

* Technical SEO cleanup

* Broken link and redirect corrections

* Sitemap/indexation review and cleanup

* Duplicate/orphan page cleanup

* Schema/structured data improvements

* Optimization of existing core service pages

* Website copy improvements

* Internal linking improvements

* Optimization of priority location pages

* Development or optimization of priority industry pages

* A limited number of approved new SEO landing pages

* Citation/NAP cleanup where applicable

* Final crawl and quality assurance

* Documentation of all completed changes



We do **not** expect you to blindly follow the existing SEO audit.



We want someone experienced enough to review each approved recommendation, understand its purpose, identify concerns when necessary, and implement it correctly.



## What We Are Looking For



This project is best suited for someone with **hands-on SEO implementation experience**.



You should be comfortable making the changes yourself rather than producing a report and handing the implementation to someone else.



Strong candidates should have experience with:



* WordPress

* **Divi Builder**

* On-page SEO

* Technical SEO fundamentals

* SEO copywriting and content optimization

* Google Search Console

* Google Analytics 4

* Conversion tracking

* Keyword research

* Search-intent analysis

* Internal linking

* 301 redirects

* Sitemap and indexation management

* Schema/structured data

* Local SEO and citation consistency

* Competitor research



Strong written English is important because you will be editing and writing content intended for **U.S. business owners and executives**.



Experience with B2B, managed IT services, cybersecurity, professional services, Architecture, Engineering, Construction, or Manufacturing is helpful but **not required**.



We care more about your ability to research unfamiliar industries, understand the buyer, ask good questions, and turn that information into effective SEO and website content.



## What This Project Is NOT



This is not:



* An SEO audit project

* An ongoing monthly SEO position

* A Google Business Profile management position

* A social media position

* A graphic design position

* A general virtual assistant position

* A paid advertising position

* A link-building-only project

* A complete website redesign

* A role where you only send us recommendations and expect us to make the website changes



**You are being hired to implement the approved work.**



If you identify something that requires specialized development outside your expertise, we expect you to clearly explain and document the issue.



## How We Will Work Together



We will provide:



* Our existing SEO audit

* Approved project priorities

* Information about our services and target customers

* Necessary access to complete approved work

* Subject-matter expertise when needed

* Feedback and approval on major website messaging



You will be expected to:



1. Review the existing audit and website.

2. Understand our approved priorities and direction.

3. Convert those priorities into specific implementation tasks.

4. Complete approved changes directly in WordPress/Divi and applicable SEO/analytics systems.

5. QA your work before marking tasks complete.

6. Document what you changed.

7. Monitor changes through Google Search Console and analytics.

8. Identify additional opportunities based on data and results.



Major positioning, target industries, target markets, website architecture, and messaging decisions will be approved by us before implementation.



## Project Compensation



**Budget: $1,000–$1,500 USD fixed project**



This is a project-based engagement, not an hourly or full-time position.



The final project price will depend on experience and demonstrated ability with WordPress/Divi, technical SEO, on-page SEO, analytics, and SEO-focused website copy.



The project will be divided into agreed milestones with payment upon completion of each milestone.



Any work outside the agreed project scope will be discussed and approved separately before work begins.



## To Apply



Please include the following:



1. A brief explanation of your SEO experience.

2. Your experience working directly in **WordPress and Divi Builder**.

3. Two or three websites or pages where you personally implemented SEO improvements.

4. A brief explanation of what **you personally changed** on those websites.

5. Your experience with Google Analytics 4 and Google Search Console.

6. An example of a page you personally wrote or substantially rewrote for SEO.

7. Your proposed fixed project price between **$1,000 and $1,500 USD**.

8. Your availability and estimated timeframe to complete a project of this type.



**Please also answer this question in your application:**



> You receive an SEO audit containing 25 recommended changes. Some involve website copy, some technical SEO, some analytics, and some new pages. Before making any changes, how would you d
 what to work on first?



Please answer this question in your own words. Applications that do not answer it will not be considered.



## Hiring Process & Paid Practical Test



Selected applicants will first be invited to a brief interview.



A small number of finalists will then be invited to complete a **$75 USD paid practical test** before we select the person for the full project.



The test will use a real page from our website and a relevant portion of our existing SEO audit. The assignment may include:



* Reviewing the current page and applicable audit findings

* Explaining what you would change and why

* Performing basic keyword and search-intent research

* Recommending on-page SEO improvements

* Rewriting or improving a selected portion of website copy

* Implementing approved changes in a WordPress/Divi test or staging environment

* Checking your work on desktop and mobile before submitting it



**The practical test is paid. We are not asking applicants to perform free SEO or website work as part of the application process.**



The purpose of the test is to evaluate your **SEO judgment, writing quality, attention to detail, WordPress/Divi ability, and ability to actually implement SEO recommendations.**



Successful completion of the paid test may lead to the full **$1,000–$1,500 fixed-price implementation project**.

title: Marketing Specialist
description:
About the company

At Miraco Nutripharm, we are dedicated to advancing health & improving lives. Our goal is to relieve 1 billion people worldwide of pain & discomfort. If you know of anyone who has been worried about or suffered from any health problems, join us in making a positive impact by reducing the pain & distress others have to endure.



Job description

We're looking for a Marketing Specialist to shape how our health & pharmaceutical brands communicate across both digital & offline channels. You'll craft effective strategies that translate scientific credibility into compelling storytelling & creative assets - helping us engage our diverse audience as we expand our presence regionally. 



The Marketing Specialist will be the visionary link between our brand identity, compelling content creation & drive measurable performance across all key channels. This role is responsible for developing & testing high-impact creative strategies as well as producing content assets (visual, video, copy) internally, specifically designed to drive traffic, increase conversion rates, lower Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC) & drive overall revenue growth for our Shopify, Shopee & Lazada stores via social media as well as paid advertising platforms.



You'll work across multiple channels & markets to plan, create & optimize content that builds awareness, strengthens partnerships & supports the new channels of the business. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys balancing creativity, analytics & brand strategy in the health supplement industry. 



Key Responsibilities:

Creative Strategy

- Platform & Channel Strategy: Craft tailored creative strategies for B2C & B2B audiences optimized for platform-specific best practices & formats that align with brand goals & regulatory requirements in each market (e.g., Meta carousel ads, vertical video for TikTok/Reels, static product carousels for Shopee/Lazada e-commerce banner ads).

- Hypothesis Generation & A/B Testing: Develop robust creative testing matrices, formulate clear hypotheses for creative elements (hooks, calls-to-action, visual styles, copy length) that drive measurable improvements in Click-Through Rate (CTR) & Conversion Rate (CVR).

- Audience Segmentation: Translate target audience data & segmentation provided by media buyers into resonant creative themes, ensuring content speaks directly to different stages of the marketing funnel (awareness, consideration, conversion).

- Competitive Analysis: Continuously keep up to date with competitors & industry trends, identifying new & successful creative formats, hooks & messaging to finetune our strategy.

In-House Content Production & Execution 

- Performance Creative Development: Lead the end-to-end creative concept development & production for all organic & paid media campaigns (Meta, TikTok, Google/YouTube, etc.) that align with brand & campaign goals, focusing on high-volume, quick-turnaround testing required for performance marketing.

- Hands-on Asset Creation: Directly produce & edit native social content & performance ads using existing assets, stock libraries & internal resources. This includes:

i. Plan platform-specific content calendars: Cover educational, promotional & corporate communications

ii. Static/Image Editing: Adapt product photography, create ad variations & design simple graphics & banner ads

iii. Video Editing: Fast-paced assembly, cutting, adding text overlays, music & effects for short-form, vertical video (UGC-style, product demos, testimonials)

- Copywriting: Develop high-converting ad copy, landing page headlines & social media captions that align with the creative strategy & brand voice, with a focus on clear value propositions & strong CTAs.

- Asset Management: Ensure all campaign assets are correctly tagged, archived & deployed across relevant channels (Shopify, Shopee, Lazada store fronts & advertising platforms).

- Testing & Optimization: apply insights & analytics to refine & optimize content effectiveness across platforms.

Performance & Reporting

- Data-Driven Insights: Work closely with the Marketing Manager to analyze creative performance reports, identifying which creative variables are driving results (or failing) across Shopify, Shopee & Lazada traffic.

- Iteration & Optimization: 

i. Develop, adapt or review content & formats to improve engagement & performance

ii. Use performance data (ROAS, CPA, CTR, CVR) to rapidly iterate on existing creative assets & inform future strategy, ensuring a continuous cycle of improvement & optimization

Storefront Integration: Integrate winning creative messages & visuals onto the respective e-commerce storefronts (product pages, banners) to ensure a cohesive customer journey.

Multi-Channel Storytelling

- Content cohesion: Ensure content is aligned where possible across digital & print media, including LinkedIn, Instagram,
, YouTube, e-commerce platforms, brochures & trade materials.

- Tailor content: To achieve relevance & effectiveness across different stages of the audience journey — from brand awareness & education to conversion.

- Storytelling & visual consistency: To strengthen brand trust & recognition.

Compliance & Brand Integrity

- Uphold regulatory & ethical communication standards across all marketing activities.

- Ensure all content complies with regulatory guidelines & marketing requirements in each country we operate in, including product claims, advertising language & digital promotions.

- Maintain brand credibility by ensuring all communications are factual & aligned with company values.

- Collaborate with internal teams to review materials for accuracy, effectiveness & compliance before publication.



Requirements:

- 3–5 years of experience in creative strategy, content creation, social media, or brand marketing — ideally in health supplements, healthcare or wellness.

- Strong understanding of social media trends & platform best practices (Meta (FB/IG), LinkedIn, TikTok, YouTube, Google, Generative AI).

- Proficient in Adobe Creative Suite (Illustrator, Photoshop, Premiere Pro), CapCut, Canva, Figma, or similar tools.

- Excellent writing, editing & visual storytelling skills — adopt a strategic approach to design that integrates marketing & commercial goals.

- Excellent communication, project management & cross-functional collaboration skills.

- Familiarity with regulatory communication standards or track record in health supplements or healthcare industry is a plus.

title: Technical Estimator – Smart Home, Security & Automation Systems
description:
Airla Automation Systems is an Australian business specialising in automation systems for architectural openings, including automated doors, windows, louvres, actuators, motors, control panels and smart building interfaces.



We are also expanding into premium smart home, security, access control, CCTV, intercom, networking, data, low-voltage and building automation projects.



We are looking for a detail-focused Technical Estimator to support quoting, system takeoffs, project documentation, supplier RFQs, scope preparation and technical coordination for smart home and automation projects.



This is not a general civil engineering role.



This role is best suited to someone with experience in CCTV, security systems, access control, intercoms, alarms, smart home automation, AV, networking/data, electrical coordination, low-voltage systems, BMS, building automation, or related technical estimating/documentation work.



About the Role:

The successful candidate will help prepare quotes, scopes, takeoffs and technical documentation for smart home and automation projects.



This may include CCTV systems, access control, alarms, intercoms, smart locks, gates, networking, data cabling, AV, control systems, automation panels, smart switches, sensors, actuators and other connected building systems.



You do not need to already know all Airla products. We will train you on our specific systems.



However, you must already understand technical estimating, low-voltage systems, construction drawings, device schedules, cable routes, equipment schedules, scope breakdowns, and the importance of checking details before quoting.



Key Responsibilities:

- Review architectural drawings, electrical drawings, reflected ceiling plans, site photos, client briefs and project requirements

- Prepare takeoffs and estimates for smart home, CCTV, security, access control, intercom, alarm, networking, data, AV, low-voltage and automation systems

- Count and schedule devices such as cameras, sensors, intercoms, access control readers, smart locks, switches, keypads, network points, Wi-Fi access points, control panels and automation equipment

- Prepare quote support documents, scope notes, assumptions, exclusions and supplier RFQs

- Identify missing information, unclear requirements, risks and assumptions before quoting

- Check whether drawings, client requirements and site information align before preparing estimates

- Prepare technical information for suppliers, electricians, installers, builders, architects and clients

- Help prepare simple markups, device schedules, cable schedules, equipment lists and documentation

- Maintain organised records in Google Drive, Notion, HubSpot, spreadsheets and internal trackers

- Support smart home, building automation, access control, security, CCTV and low-voltage project documentation

- Help build estimating checklists, scope templates, assumptions registers and quotation systems

- Work with the Airla team to improve quote accuracy, reduce mistakes and create cleaner handovers



Required Experience:

- Experience estimating or documenting CCTV, security, access control, intercom, alarm, smart home, AV, networking, data, electrical, low-voltage, BMS or building automation systems

- Ability to read architectural, electrical or services drawings

- Ability to prepare takeoffs, equipment lists, device schedules or scope breakdowns

- Understanding of low-voltage systems, cabling, control panels, devices, racks, networking or electrical coordination

- Strong attention to detail and a clear checking process

- Ability to identify missing information, conflicting information and unsafe assumptions

- Good written English

- Strong organisation and follow-through

- Comfortable working remotely with strong overlap to Australian business hours

- Able to think through problems before escalating



Highly Regarded:

- Experience with CCTV systems, NVRs, IP cameras, PoE switches and network infrastructure

- Experience with access control, smart locks, intercoms, alarms and security systems

- Experience with smart home platforms, BMS, Control4, KNX, C-Bus, Savant, Loxone, Crestron, Clipsal, Shelly or similar systems

- Experience with electrical/data drawings, low-voltage wiring, cable pathways, conduits and rough-in coordination

- Experience with AutoCAD, Revit, Bluebeam, Planswift, Excel, Google Sheets, Notion, HubSpot or similar tools

- Experience supporting Australian, New Zealand, UK or US construction, electrical, security, AV or automation businesses

- Experience with glazing, façade systems, aluminium windows/doors, automated openings or architectural openings is a bonus, but not essential



Important:

This is not a general civil engineering role.



Please do not apply if your experience is mainly roads, drainage, earthworks, concrete, structural design, general site engineering, government civil works or general admin.



We are looking for someone with technical estimating or documentation experience in smart home, security, CCTV, access control, electrical/data, low-voltage, AV, automation or building systems.



This role is not a basic VA role.



You must be able to read drawings, check details, prepare takeoffs, document assumptions and avoid guessing when information is unclear.



To Apply:

title: Podcast & Content Producer
description:
We're looking for the person who turns a raw recording into something people actually want to watch, listen to, and read.

The one who can't stand a good episode going out with sloppy shownotes or a YouTube upload nobody optimised. The person who gets genuine satisfaction from taking one piece of content and making it work hard across every platform it lives on.



At TK Coaching, our podcast is one of the ways we build trust with regional business owners across Australia before they ever become clients. That means production quality and consistency matter — every episode, every platform, every time.

This isn't a "press publish and move on" role. It's a content ownership role.



The role

This is a contractor position of approximately 20-30 hours per month.



Your responsibilities will include:

Taking a raw podcast episode and preparing it for publishing — editing, shownotes, platform upload, and distribution

Editing and publishing the video version of each episode to YouTube, including titles, descriptions and thumbnails

Turning each episode into a blog post for our website

Repurposing into reels, carousels and more across
, Threads, Instagram

Managing the publishing calendar across all platforms so nothing goes out late

Reporting on episode performance — downloads, YouTube views, blog traffic — so we know what's landing

Spotting opportunities to improve or repurpose content further as our audience grows



To be eligible, you will need access to:

A computer


BuzzSprout (access provided)

Canva

Zoom (for meetings and training)

Fast internet connection



About you

You'll probably love this role if you:

Are meticulous about the details other people miss

Can edit video and audio confidently, not just format what's handed to you

Write well — you'll be drafting shownotes and blog content, not copy-pasting a transcript

Take ownership of the calendar rather than waiting to be told what's due

Are confident learning new software and systems

Enjoy the satisfaction of a job done properly, not just done

Experience in podcast production, video editing, or content repurposing would be highly regarded.



A few things to know

We're a fast-moving online coaching business that supports regional business owners across Australia. Our podcast is currently rebranding and moving platforms — you'll be part of shaping how it runs going forward, not just maintaining someone else's system.

If you're someone who gets real satisfaction from making content look and sound professional, and who takes pride in "no missed deadlines, ever," we'd love to hear from you.

Read through the entire description before applying.
