title: QA & Release Engineering Manager
description:
We are seeking a hands-on QA & Release Engineering Manager to raise the quality bar across our software delivery process and help build a disciplined, scalable QA function. This person will actively test software, lead QA practices and standards, expand test automation, and ensure releases are validated and deployed safely and predictably.



This is not a coordination-only management role. The ideal candidate is an experienced QA or quality engineer who can set expectations for the QA team while remaining technically hands-on with testing, automation, CI/CD, deployments, and release troubleshooting. The role combines QA leadership, quality engineering, release management, and practical DevOps responsibility.



Core Responsibilities

QA Leadership, Standards & Discipline

• Own and continuously improve the QA process across the product and engineering organization.

• Establish clear QA standards for test planning, execution, regression testing, defect reporting, evidence, retesting, and sign-off.

• Set a high and consistent quality bar for the QA team and coach team members on effective testing practices.

• Ensure QA work is systematic, reproducible, documented, and traceable rather than dependent on informal or ad-hoc testing.

• Define what must be validated for different types of changes and ensure appropriate test coverage before release.

• Review QA results and challenge incomplete testing, weak defect reproduction, or unsupported sign-off.

• Identify recurring gaps in QA execution and drive corrective process improvements.

• Help establish useful QA metrics such as escaped defects, regression failures, reopen rates, automation coverage, and recurring defect categories.

• Work constructively with Engineering and Product while maintaining independent authority to determine when quality requirements have not been met.



Hands-On Quality Assurance

• Personally perform functional, regression, integration, exploratory, and release testing as needed.

• Create and maintain test plans and test cases for new functionality, regressions, integrations, and critical workflows.

• Validate acceptance criteria and verify that completed engineering work behaves correctly across relevant environments and scenarios.

• Produce clear, actionable defect reports with reproducible steps, expected versus actual behavior, supporting evidence, and appropriate severity.

• Ensure defects are properly retested and regressions are covered before closure.

• Focus QA effort based on product risk, customer impact, change scope, and historical failure patterns.



QA Automation & Quality Engineering

• Own and expand meaningful automated regression coverage across the product.

• Determine which tests should be automated and which are better suited to manual or exploratory testing.

• Build, maintain, and troubleshoot automated UI, API, integration, and regression tests as appropriate.

• Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines and ensure they run at the correct stages of software delivery.

• Establish automated quality gates that prevent progression or release when required tests fail.

• Track flaky tests, automation failures, coverage gaps, and recurring regressions and drive them to resolution.

• Work with Engineering to ensure unit and engineering-level tests remain an engineering responsibility while QA provides broader product, integration, and regression assurance.

• Continuously reduce repetitive manual QA work where reliable automation provides better coverage and faster feedback.



Release Ownership & Deployment Control

• Own or directly support the end-to-end release process from QA readiness through production deployment and validation.

• Establish and enforce clear Definition of Release Ready and Definition of Release Complete standards.

• Confirm required code reviews, tests, scans, approvals, documentation, QA sign-off, deployment steps, and rollback preparation are complete before release.

• Plan, coordinate, execute, and validate production releases across relevant application components.

• Maintain release schedules, release manifests or records, release notes, deployment evidence, and rollback procedures.

• Identify release risks and dependencies early and escalate blockers before they affect delivery.

• Have the authority and judgment to stop or delay a release when required quality or readiness criteria have not been met.

• Ensure failed or partially completed releases have clear recovery and rollback procedures.

CI/CD, DevOps & Deployment Automation

• Own and improve CI/CD pipelines supporting build, test, security validation, packaging, and deployment.

• Maintain and improve Bitbucket repositories, Git workflows, branching practices, pull-request workflows, and pipeline integrations as they relate to quality and releases.

• Automate deployments across development, QA/staging, and production environments.

• Reduce manual deployment steps and opportunities for human error while preserving appropriate controls.

• Ensure pipelines provide clear visibility into failures and prevent unsafe deployments.

• Support and troubleshoot Docker/containerized application environments and deployment workflows.

• Support and oversee deployments into AWS environments, including configuration, permissions, dependencies, logs, monitoring, and deployment health.

• Help maintain consistency across development, QA/staging, and production environments and troubleshoot environment-related failures with Engineering.



Security, Release Validation & Production Follow-Through

• Integrate and maintain automated security, dependency, vulnerability, and code-quality scanning within the delivery pipeline.

• Define how critical test, security, and code-quality findings affect release readiness.

• Define and execute post-deployment smoke tests and validation procedures.

• Verify that releases are functioning correctly before considering deployment complete.

• Monitor deployment health, errors, logs, and other production signals following releases.

• Coordinate rapid response, rollback, or remediation when a release introduces problems.

• Lead or participate in post-release reviews and ensure quality or release failures result in concrete corrective actions.

• Maintain a clear audit trail showing what was released, when, by whom, and with which validations.



Required Skills & Traits



Must Have

• Strong hands-on software QA experience in a production SaaS, web application, or similarly complex software environment.

• Experience leading QA practices, setting testing standards, or serving as a senior/lead QA engineer responsible for the quality bar of a team.

• Strong understanding of test strategy, functional testing, regression testing, exploratory testing, integration testing, defect management, and release validation.

• Hands-on experience building or maintaining automated software tests, ideally including API, integration, regression, and/or browser-based testing.

• Experience integrating automated tests and quality gates into CI/CD pipelines.

• Experience managing or directly supporting software releases and production deployments.

• Strong experience with Git workflows, branches, pull requests, and repository management; Bitbucket experience is strongly preferred.

• Experience building, maintaining, or troubleshooting CI/CD pipelines and automated deployments.

• Working knowledge of AWS and cloud deployment environments.

• Ability to troubleshoot failed builds, pipelines, automated tests, environment problems, and deployments.

• Understanding of rollback strategies, release risk management, and production i
 response.

• Ability to distinguish between QA responsibilities and engineering responsibilities and hold both functions to appropriate quality standards.

• Strong attention to detail, disciplined follow-through, and low tolerance for undocumented, unverified, or casually bypassed quality steps.

• Ability to coach others, enforce standards constructively, and communicate clearly when work is not ready to progress.

• Strong written and verbal English communication skills.



Nice to Have

• Previous experience as a QA Lead, QA Manager, Senior QA Automation Engineer, Quality Engineer, SDET, Release Engineer, or similar hands-on quality role.

• Experience managing or mentoring a distributed QA team.

• Experience with Bitbucket Pipelines.

• Experience with Docker or containerized deployments.

• Experience with infrastructure-as-code and AWS deployment automation.

• Experience with automated security, vulnerability, dependency, or static-analysis scanning.

• Familiarity with PHP, JavaScript, SQL, APIs, and web application architectures.

• Experience with monitoring, logging, and alerting tools.

• Experience improving an existing QA organization where processes, automation, or release discipline needed to mature.

• Experience supporting distributed engineering and QA teams.



Ideal Profile

The ideal candidate is a senior QA practitioner who wants ownership, not someone who views QA management as primarily assigning test work or tracking tickets. They are comfortable getting directly involved in difficult testing, reproducing defects, reviewing automation, troubleshooting pipelines, and validating releases.



They can walk into an existing QA process, identify where discipline or coverage is weak, establish practical standards, coach the team to meet them, and measure whether quality is actually improving. They know when a defect indicates an isolated issue and when it points to a broader gap in testing, engineering checks, or release controls.

They also understand the software delivery process beyond QA: why a build failed, why a test should block deployment, how environments differ, how a release should be packaged and validated, and where CI/CD or deployment automation can eliminate risk and manual work.



They are comfortable saying that a release is not ready when required standards have not been met, while working constructively with Engineering, Product, and QA to resolve the issue quickly.



Success in this role means the QA team becomes more disciplined and effective, automated coverage increases where it matters, fewer defects escape into production, and releases become more predictable, auditable, and automated over time.

title: Cinematic Social Media Video Editor
description:
Cinematic Social Media Video Editor – Ongoing Entertainment Brand







We’re looking for a highly creative and talented video editor who can take our existing professional and organic footage and turn it into cinematic, high-energy short-form promotional videos for social media.







We are an established Australian live entertainment company producing shows and events throughout Australia and New Zealand.







This is an opportunity for the right person to become an ongoing member of our marketing and creative team.







What We’re Looking For







We are NOT looking for basic social media editing or simple template-based videos.







We want someone who can create content that feels more like a:







Movie trailer

Entertainment commercial

Vegas-style show promotion

High-end nightlife/event campaign





Our brand style is:







Cinematic and premium

High-energy and exciting

Sexy but classy

Fun girls’ night out atmosphere

Vegas / live entertainment feel

Strong audience reactions and emotion

Professional transitions and effects

Excellent music selection and sound design

Strong opening hooks that capture attention immediately





The ultimate goal is simple:







Make someone watching the video think, “Wow — I want to go to that show!”







The Work







We will provide you with a library of content including:







Professional show footage

Live performance footage

Individual performer footage

Audience reactions

Girls laughing, cheering and having fun

Customer testimonials

Behind-the-scenes content

Venue footage

Photos and existing graphics





Your job will be to turn this material into high-quality short-form promotional videos, primarily for:







 • Instagram Reels • Stories • TikTok







Most videos will be approximately 15–30 seconds.







These are not simply highlight videos. They are marketing videos designed to capture attention, create excitement and ultimately help sell tickets.







Skills We’re Looking For







You should have strong experience with:







Cinematic video editing

Short-form social media advertising

Storytelling through video

Strong hooks in the first 1–3 seconds

Music selection and timing

Sound design

Colour grading

Professional transitions and effects

Editing specifically for vertical social media

Understanding what keeps viewers watching





Experience creating content for live entertainment, nightlife, concerts, festivals, events, movie trailers or entertainment advertising would be a major advantage.







Portfolio Required







Please send us ONLY 3 examples of your very best work that most closely match the cinematic entertainment style we’re looking for.







Please don’t send us 20 links.







We want to see the three videos that make you think:







“This is why you should hire me.”







If your portfolio mainly consists of basic talking-head videos, podcasts, subtitles or template-based social media content, this probably isn’t the right position.







Paid Test for Shortlisted Applicants







Our Venue Marketing Manager will review the applications, portfolios and experience of all suitable candidates and create a shortlist.







The strongest applicants will then be invited to complete a paid test edit.







We will provide the same Sydney Hotshots raw footage to several finalists and ask each person to create approximately a 15–20 second cinematic social media promotion.







This allows us to compare creativity, storytelling, editing ability and, most importantly, how well you understand our brand.







The successful applicant will initially be given a small batch of approximately 5 videos.







If the work is successful, we would like this to develop into an ongoing relationship with regular video work.







You’ll Be Working With a Team







You won’t be working alone.







We already have a marketing team including a Venue Marketing Manager and Graphic Designer.







Our Venue Marketing Manager will coordinate much of the day-to-day communication, upcoming campaigns, content requirements and video briefs.







The company owner will provide the overall creative direction and final approval where required.







We’re looking for someone who enjoys collaborating, contributing ideas and becoming part of a creative team rather than simply waiting for editing instructions.







How to Apply







Please include:







A short introduction about yourself.

Links to your 3 BEST cinematic/entertainment videos.

The editing software you primarily use.

Your experience with Reels, 
 and
 advertising content.

Your normal turnaround time for a 15–30 second video.

Your rate per finished video or preferred working arrangement.

Confirmation that you’re happy to complete a paid test edit if shortlisted.

A short answer to this question: What makes a 20-second promotional video stop someone scrolling and make them want to buy a ticket?





IMPORTANT







Please start your application with:







HOTSHOTS VIDEO







Applications that don’t include these words may not be considered.







We are looking for someone with a genuine creative eye who can take ordinary raw footage and turn it into something exciting, cinematic and memorable.







If that’s you, we’d love to see your work.

title: YouTube Documentary Scriptwriter — True Crime & Psychology
description:
ABOUT THE PROJECT



I am building a long-form YouTube documentary project focused on real police bodycam encounters, true crime, human behavior, psychology, and escalation.



The goal is NOT to simply narrate what happened. We want to explore how an encounter developed, the warning signs, changes in behavior, escalation, and the moment when the situation reached its breaking point.



YOUR ROLE



You will transform a detailed research package into an engaging long-form documentary script designed for strong viewer retention.



Your responsibilities include:



• Creating a strong opening hook that immediately creates curiosity

• Establishing the context and events leading up to the encounter

• Turning research and bodycam footage into a compelling narrative

• Highlighting observable behavioral changes and warning signs

• Building tension and escalation throughout the story

• Identifying and emphasizing the key “tipping point” of the encounter

• Integrating bodycam footage naturally into the narration

• Maintaining factual accuracy and avoiding unsupported psychological diagnoses

• Creating a satisfying conclusion covering the arrest, aftermath, and relevant consequences



PSYCHOLOGICAL / BEHAVIORAL STORYTELLING



Psychology and human behavior are a major part of this project.



We want viewers to understand why the encounter escalated, not simply watch the escalation happen.



You should be comfortable discussing observable behavior, decision-making, emotional escalation, pressure, conflict, and other relevant behavioral concepts while clearly separating evidence from interpretation.



TEAMWORK IS REQUIRED



You will work directly with our researcher and video editor.



The researcher provides the evidence, timeline, footage, and behavioral observations. Your job is to turn that material into the narrative. The editor will then use your script alongside the research and footage to construct the final episode.



You must be comfortable discussing revisions with the researcher/editor and adjusting the script when footage or additional research changes the strongest storytelling approach.



This is NOT a role where you simply receive a topic and independently write a generic true-crime script.



PAY



$15–25 per completed script, depending on length and complexity.



This is a fixed-rate, project-based position.



There is no open-ended hourly billing. Any work outside the agreed scope must be approved beforehand.



We are looking for someone interested in becoming a reliable long-term member of the production team as the project grows.



TO APPLY



Please provide:



Relevant YouTube/documentary writing experience

1–3 examples of your strongest long-form scripts

Experience with true crime, documentaries, psychology, or similar storytelling

Your experience writing for audience retention/watch time

Your expected fixed rate for a 15–30 minute script

In a few sentences, explain how you would make viewers interested in why an encounter escalated, rather than simply telling them what happened.



Please include relevant writing samples whenever possible.

title: Meta Ads and GoHighLevel Specialist
description:
***At Polaris, we’re on the lookout for a driven, detail-oriented, and marketing-savvy Marketing and Acquisitions Assistant to join our world-class team. If you thrive in fast-paced environments, love the idea of being the operational backbone of a company’s marketing engine, and have strong hands-on experience with GoHighLevel, content creation, CRM systems, and social media, this role is for you.



***About us:

Polaris is a consulting agency with a bold mission: To help 1 million Founders to leverage time, reclaim freedom, and scale without sacrifice. We’re the only firm blending coaching and done-for-you services through a hybrid model — empowering our clients with strategic delegation, streamlined operations, and scalable systems.



***Role Mission

Be the driving force behind the client acquisition process of established online coaches, consultants, and info product founders. These are expert-led businesses where the founder IS the brand. Your job is to oversee Meta ad campaigns such as lead ad campaigns, low-ticket course campaigns, and appointment/VSL campaigns — making sure that ad spend is turning into leads, customers, booked calls, and sales. You own two tightly connected lanes end to end: the Meta ads that put the founder's offer in front of the right people, and the GoHighLevel infrastructure that captures, nurtures, and routes every lead toward a call. This is not a support role for someone who waits to be told what to do — we're looking for a proactive, driven, high-energy operator who is ready to stand alongside the Founder and take real responsibility over marketing performance.





***Role Responsibilities

Meta Ads - End-to-End Campaign Ownership

- Strategy: Build the paid strategy around the funnel and offer stage lead magnet opt-ins, appointment/booked-call campaigns, webinar registrations, and low-ticket product sales for coaching and consulting offers. Map each campaign to a clear objective and a target cost per result.

- Audience targeting: Research and build custom audiences (pixel, CRM lists, engagement) and lookalikes; layer interest, behavior, and demographic targeting; set exclusions to avoid overlap and waste; and build retargeting audiences from website, video, lead-form, and CRM data.

- Creative production: Research winning competitor ads in the coaching/consulting space (offers, hooks, angles, formats); format and produce scroll-stopping static and video ad creatives; write ad copy (primary text, headlines, CTAs) that positions the founder as the authority; and run a steady pipeline of creative variations to test.

- Campaign build & launch: Set up campaigns, ad sets, and ads in Meta Ads Manager - including lead ad forms, appointment campaigns, placements, and conversion events and wire tracking end-to-end with pixels, Conversion API, and GoHighLevel before a single dollar goes live.

- Budget management: Allocate and pace daily/lifetime budgets across campaigns, scale winners, cut losers early, and manage frequency, CPM, and delivery to protect efficiency as spend grows.

- Performance optimization: Monitor spend and cost per booked call daily; run structured A/B tests across creatives, audiences, and offers; flag anomalies (spend spikes, tracking discrepancies, fatigue) immediately; and act on the data with a proposed fix rather than reporting and moving on.



Creative Research & Production (Ad & Funnel Assets)

- Leverage AI to analyze competitor ads, industry trends, and the messaging angles of competitor landing pages and creatives.

- Set up Claude copywriting projects with accurate project instructions and context files from competitor analysis, copywriting guidelines, and company internal assets.

- Leverage AI to produce first-draft copywriting assets such as
 campaigns, appointment reminders, campaign hooks & headlines, and landing page copy.

- Leverage existing company data such as sales call transcriptions, best-performing content, and validated landing pages to create new ad copy and
s under AI assistance.

- Leverage AI to create ad images and scroll-stopping graphics.



GoHighLevel CRM Setup & Management

- Set up GoHighLevel sub-accounts from scratch with domain,
, SMS (with A2P verification), custom fields, company details, and account snapshots accurately established.

- Build funnels such as lead magnet, webinars, VSL, and low-ticket digital product funnels — including setting up forms, integrations, and connecting automated
 sequences.

-
 management with deliverability best practices, contact tagging, smartlist segmentation, and automated
 sequence setup.

- Pipeline management with contact tagging, pipeline staging, and setting up triggers for automated opportunity creation / update.

- Manage the
 list through deliverability best practices, contact tagging, and smartlist segmentation.

- Set up integrations across Meta and Google, as well as other platforms, using either GoHighLevel's internal features or Zapier.



Marketing & Ads Performance Tracking

- Set up tracking across Meta Pixels, Meta Conversion API, Google Analytics, and UTMs.

- Build dashboards and spreadsheets to accurately track and report key metrics across Meta ad campaigns and the GoHighLevel pipeline — content/opt-ins ? booked calls ? show rate.

- Comfortable identifying optimization opportunities based on weekly campaign data, and delivering reports that end with insight and recommendation — what to kill, scale, or test next — never just numbers.

.

Workflow Documentation

- Document recurring tasks and processes into clear SOPs and process maps, with the help of AI.

- Document funnel templates, automated workflows, forms, and other sub-account setups into shareable snapshots.



Role Requirements:

- Minimum 3 years virtual work experience in paid media and marketing operations — experience with coaches, consultants, course creators, or founder-led personal brands highly preferred (agency background highly preferred but not mandatory).

- Proven, hands-on experience managing Meta 
 & Instagram) ad campaigns end to end — strategy, audience targeting, creative production, budget management, and performance optimization — with results you can speak to.

- Proven experience using GoHighLevel at agency and sub-account levels, especially lead magnet, VSL, and webinar funnels.

- Strong grasp of tech stack integrations and tracking setups across Meta and Google Analytics (Pixel, Conversion API, UTM).

- Excellent written and spoken English — able to write ad and
 copy in a founder's voice convincingly.

- Confident and proactive in using AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, and Perplexity to improve productivity and output quality.

- Proactive, driven, and high-energy — ready to take real responsibility over marketing performance alongside the Founder -rather than wait for instructions.

- Self-starter with extreme ownership, systems thinking, and a can-do attitude: flags problems before being asked, brings solutions with problems, and never marks a task done that isn't.

- High attention to detail around funnel formatting, ad campaign setups, and reporting accuracy — previews funnels on mobile, tests tracking before spend, and checks every link before anything goes live.

- Comfortable communicating with sophisticated entrepreneurs, with strong verbal and video presentation.



Role Results (KPIs)

- Measurable improvement quarter over quarter in the numbers that matter to an expert business: opt-ins, booked calls, show rate, and cost per acquisition.

title: CUSTOMER SUPPORT SPECIALIST - Shopify
description:
CUSTOMER SUPPORT SPECIALIST — Shopify / eCommerce

Part-Time (15-20h/week)  |  Remote  |  Long-term



"We don't just solve problems — we make customers feel heard, helped, and happy."





ABOUT US



We run a growing group of Shopify stores across Europe — currently five — and we work alongside partner stores in other European markets. Our team is small, fully remote, and runs on clear written processes.



We are looking for one Customer Support Specialist to own the inbox across all our stores. This is a long-term position. As we open more stores, this role grows with us in hours, in responsibility, and in pay.





THE ONE THING THAT MAKES THIS ROLE DIFFERENT — READ THIS



Our customers do NOT write in English.

They write in Finnish, Dutch, German, Spanish and Danish.



You are not expected to speak any of those languages. Nobody on our team does either.

You will use DeepL to translate every incoming
 into English/your language, d
 what to do using our written SOPs, write your reply in English, and translate it back. We will train you on this workflow it is simple and it works.



What this means for you:

  - You need JUDGEMENT, not languages. Knowing when to refund, when to resend,

    when to escalate — that is the job.

  - You need to be careful. A translated reply that is technically correct but tonally cold still loses a customer.

  - If you are uncomfortable working with text you cannot read directly, this role is not for you. Please do not apply.





TOOLS YOU WILL USE



  Zoho Mail        — where all customer
s arrive

  Shopify Admin    — orders, refunds, tracking

  DeepL            — translation, every single ticket

  Google Sheets    — daily reporting and tracking

  WhatsApp         — team communication





REQUIREMENTS



MUST — Fluent written English (C1 or above). Your writing IS the product.

MUST — Minimum 2 years in customer support. eCommerce strongly preferred.

MUST — Comfortable using translation tools daily and working in languages you do not speak.

MUST — Able to answer every ticket within 24 hours, including a check on weekends.

MUST — Available for one weekly team call.

MUST — Reliable internet and a quiet place to work.



PREFERRED — Experience with Shopify.

PREFERRED — Experience with dropshipping fulfilment (long shipping times, tracking issues, "where is my order").

PREFERRED — Experience with a helpdesk (Gorgias, Zendesk, Freshdesk or similar).

PREFERRED — Experience supporting European customers.





WHAT YOU WILL DO EVERY DAY



  - Translate, read and answer every incoming customer
 across all stores, within the 24-hour SLA.

  - Resolve the usual cases using our SOPs: refunds, tracking, delays, wrong item, cancellations, returns.

  - Escalate what you should not d
 alone — with the order number, the customer's message translated, and your recommendation. Never escalate empty-handed.

  - Send a short end-of-day report: how many
s, what the top issues were, what is still open and why.

  - Flag patterns. If eight people ask the same thing this week, that is a broken product page or a broken process and we want to know.

  - Keep the tracking sheet up to date.





WHAT WE OFFER



  USD 2.50/hour, 15-20 hours per week.

  Performance bonus on top — paid monthly, based on response time, resolution rate, and customer satisfaction. We will show you the exact numbers before you start, so you always know what you are being measured on.

  Paid two-week trial before we both commit.

  Written SOPs and video training for every process. You will not be guessing.

  Direct access to the owner during your first weeks.

  Real growth: we are opening more stores. Hours and pay grow with the workload.

  Fully remote, flexible within the 24-hour SLA.





IMPORTANT — READ BEFORE APPLYING



To confirm you actually read this post, start your application with the word "CLARITY" followed by your introduction.

Applications without this word will not be read.





HOW TO APPLY



Start with the secret word, then a short introduction, then answer these:



  1. Describe your most relevant customer support experience. Be specific about the product, the market and the volume.



  2. Which helpdesk or
 tools have you used, and for how long?



  3. A customer writes in Spanish, angry, demanding a full refund on an order that shipped 19 days ago and is still in transit. Our policy allows refunds only after 30 days. Write your actual reply to that customer, in English.

     (We want to see how you write, not a summary of what you would do.)



  4. Have you ever used DeepL or Google Translate as part of your daily job?

     Tell us how.



  5. What is your timezone and what hours per day can you commit to?



We read every application that includes the secret word. Thank you.

title: FULL-TIME VIDEO EDITOR & CONTENT PRODUCER DAVINCI RESOLVE | LONG-TERM ROLE | AUSTRALIAN COMPANY
description:
We’re looking for a talented full-time Video Editor & Content Producer to join our team long-term.



This is not a role for someone who simply knows how to cut clips, add captions and use templates.



We’re looking for an editor with taste.



Someone who understands storytelling, pacing, emotion, music, sound design and how to turn raw footage into content people genuinely want to watch.



ABOUT US



ACS Financial is an Australian financial services organisation that has served churches, Christian schools and not-for-profit organisations for decades.



We produce:



Client testimonial films

Interviews and podcasts

Educational videos

Short-form social content

Reels and vertical video

Campaign videos

Long-form content

Brand and internal communications



We are investing heavily in video and building our production capability internally.



For the right person, this is intended to be a stable, long-term, full-time position — not a short-term freelance project.



THE ROLE



Your primary responsibility will be taking footage we provide and turning it into polished, engaging finished content.



For example, we may give you a 45-minute client interview and ask you to turn it into:



A compelling 3–5 minute testimonial film

Several short-form reels

Social clips

Different hooks or opening sequences

Clean, professional audio

Music and sound design

Colour-corrected and graded footage

Captions and graphics where appropriate



You need to be comfortable d
 what should stay, what should be removed and how the story should be structured.



We do not want to tell an editor where every cut needs to go.



We want someone we can trust creatively.



DAVINCI RESOLVE



Our editing workflow is built around DaVinci Resolve Studio.



You should be confident with:



Editing

Multicam editing

Fairlight

Dialogue cleanup

Audio mixing

Colour correction

Colour grading

Music selection

Sound design

Titles and graphics

Subtitles and captions

Horizontal and vertical formats

Exporting correctly for web and social platforms



Experience with Fusion is useful, but you do not need to be an advanced VFX artist.



WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR



We want someone who:



Has excellent editing instincts

Understands storytelling

Can identify the strongest moments in an interview

Knows when an edit feels too slow

Knows when an edit feels over-produced

Can create emotion without making content feel artificial

Has strong attention to detail

Takes feedback well

Can work independently

Communicates clearly

Meets deadlines

Takes ownership of their work

Wants to become part of a team rather than constantly looking for the next freelance job



You should care about the difference between an edit that is technically correct and an edit that is genuinely good.



OUR STYLE



We do not want every video covered in:



Constant zooms

Meme editing

Excessive transitions

Random stock footage

Animated captions every two seconds



Sometimes simple editing is better.



The story comes first.



The edit should support the person speaking rather than compete with them.



Our content should feel:



Professional.

Human.

Credible.

Warm.

Cinematic when appropriate.



CHRISTIAN ORGANISATION



ACS Financial primarily serves Christian organisations, including churches and Christian schools.



Because of the nature of the organisation and the content you will be working with, we are specifically looking for a Christian who is comfortable working within this environment and whose values align with our organisation.



You do not need to use Christian language in your application or try to impress us.



We simply want someone who genuinely understands and is comfortable with the audience we serve.



EQUIPMENT



You will need:



A reliable computer capable of editing professional 4K footage

Fast and reliable internet

DaVinci Resolve Studio, or the ability to work within our Resolve Studio workflow

Reliable file storage

Suitable headphones or audio monitoring



You must be comfortable downloading and uploading large video files.



WORKING HOURS



This is a full-time position working with our Australian team.



We are based in Melbourne, Australia.



There will need to be some overlap with Australian business hours for communication, feedback and meetings, but we also want you to have uninterrupted editing time.



HOW TO APPLY



We do not want a long written cover letter.



Instead, please send us a short 3–5 minute video introducing yourself and answering the questions below.



THIS VIDEO DOES NOT NEED TO BE PROFESSIONALLY EDITED.



In fact, we would prefer that it isn’t.



Just speak naturally to the camera.



Please answer:



Tell us briefly about yourself and your experience as a video editor.

Why are you looking for a full-time, long-term editing role rather than freelance or project work?

Tell us about your experience with DaVinci Resolve. What parts of Resolve are you strongest in?

Imagine we give you a 45-minute client interview and ask you to turn it into a powerful 3-minute testimonial film. Talk us through exactly how you would approach it.

What do you think separates an average video editor from an excellent one?

Tell us about one video you are particularly proud of. What did you personally do, and why do you think the edit worked?

Why does working for a Christian organisation appeal to you?

What are you looking for in your next role over the next 2–3 years?



Please also include:



A link to your portfolio

Links to your three best edits

Your computer specifications

Your internet speed

Your expected monthly salary in PHP for a full-time position

Your availability/start date



Upload your video to Loom, YouTube as an unlisted video, or Google Drive and include the link in your application.



Please make sure we can access the link without requesting permission.



APPLICATIONS WITHOUT THE VIDEO WILL NOT BE CONSIDERED.



We are not judging your camera quality or presentation skills.



We want to understand how you think, communicate and approach your craft.



WHAT HAPPENS NEXT



Shortlisted applicants will be invited to complete a paid editing test using real footage.



We are not looking for the cheapest editor.



We are looking for someone exceptionally good who can become an important part of our team for the long term.



If that sounds like you, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Creative Content Creator & Community Manager (TikTok / Instagram)
description:
About Us:

We are a growing Italian e-commerce brand operating in the baking and bread-making niche. We have a growing community on Instagram and TikTok (over 500 followers and scaling fast!), and we need your help to take it to the next level.



The Role:

We are looking for a highly creative Community Manager and Content Creator to manage our Instagram and TikTok accounts and highlight our flagship bread-making product. I will ship the physical products directly to your home so you can film them yourself.



Don't worry, you won't be left in the dark! We will guide you and provide plenty of successful video examples and concepts to inspire you.



Your Responsibilities:



Filming & Production: Shoot high-quality, aesthetic video footage of our products at your home.



Content for Instagram & TikTok: Brainstorm and execute creative video concepts tailored for Reels and TikToks (educational videos, product comparisons, aesthetic showcases).



Direct Response Editing: Create highly engaging short-form videos with strong 3-second hooks and clear Call-To-Actions (CTAs) at the end to drive sales. These videos will also be used for Meta Ads.



Voiceovers & Audio: Manage the audio for the videos, adapting to your specific skills (see below).



Important Notes & HUGE Bonuses!



Speaking Italian & Showing your face: If you speak and understand Italian AND you are comfortable showing your face on camera, this is a MASSIVE PLUS! It makes the content much more authentic. However, this is not mandatory. You can absolutely still apply if you prefer to stay faceless and use AI tools (like ElevenLabs) for the Italian voiceovers.



Do you know how to bake bread? If you have experience or a passion for baking bread, this is another huge advantage for our niche! Please make sure to mention this in your application.



Requirements:



Extremely creative with a good eye for video framing and aesthetics.



Experience in short-form video editing and managing Instagram/TikTok accounts.



Ability to craft high-converting videos (Hook + Value + CTA).



If you love being creative and know how to make a product look amazing on camera for social media, we want to work with you! Let us know in your application if you speak Italian, if you can show your face, and if you know how to bake!

title: Graphic Designer and Webflow Builder
description:
We're Eos Digital, a premium video and brand development company working with boutique luxury property developers across South-East Queensland, Australia.



Our clients build landmark projects, and we build their brands.



We're at capacity and need a design all-rounder to help create and rollout brand systems.  You'll be working with our Senior Designer to curate the visual identity for our clients, in a full-time, sole-focus role: 



*   Contribute to projects from concept through to final execution across print, digital, website and social

*   Lead day-to-day branding tasks and asset development across multiple clients

*   Prepare digital and print artwork for production and manage files with precision

*   Translate brand positioning into thoughtful, consistent visual outcomes

*   Present your work clearly, articulating the thinking behind your design decisions



We are looking for someone who lives and breathes the Adobe creative suite.  Illustrator, InDesign, Photoshop are second nature, Premiere, AfterEffects and Figma are a plus.  You can build a Webflow page from scratch and can work confidently with existing templates.

Notion is also a key component of how our business operates, how we manage tasks, and communicate on projects.  Experience in Notion is essential to be considered for this role. 

Other tools we use within our team: Notion, Gmail, Google Drive, Google Meets, WhatsApp, Claude, Meta / Social media platforms



Tasks include but are not limited to: 

- Refining brands for new and existing clients

- Creating Social media assets that are on message and ready on time. (branded carousels, static and animated Instagram stories)

- Developing print material for marketing and property sales campaigns. 

- Creating and maintaining our clients’ Webflow websites:  building pages, adding CMS items, installing custom code



You’re curating the assets and websites that represent our clients online. Delivering design that reflects an industry of high-end trade specialists, builders, and developers.   



What we need from you:

*   Strong portfolio showcasing brand identity work and real world application

*   Detail-obsessed, organised and confident managing multiple deadlines

*   Comfortable receiving direction while also contributing ideas

*   Collaborative, proactive and hungry to grow

*   Passionate about building genuine design-led brands



You will work only with us: one company, one team, long-term. We're building something and we want you growing inside it, not juggling us with three other clients.



Attention to detail matters here so when you apply, start your first sentence with the words "Illustrator is life" so we know you've read this properly.



You'll be great at this if:

- Your written & spoken English is excellent.

- You've used Notion daily in a real job. This is a hard requirement as our whole business runs on it.

- You have 3–5 years experience as a graphic designer

- You use AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT) every day to work faster and better, not to replace your design intuition or artwork

- You're organised to the point of it being a personality trait. Trackers stay current because unfinished admin bothers you.

- You're comfortable on camera, we do regular Zoom/Google Meets check-ins

- You want feedback, act on it, and are always levelling up your skills.



Bonus points if you have:

-  Experience with architecture, construction, property, or real estate businesses.

-  An understanding of social media and marketing strategies for lead generation (Google Tag Manager, Meta Pixel, etc.) 



Hours: Australian business hours (AEST: just 2 hours ahead of Manila, standard day shift)



Salary: $1,000–1,400 USD/month depending on experience





To apply to this position, please provide:

1. Upload PDF resume/CV 

2. Supply a link to your online Design Portfolio which showcases visual branding, social media examples, and Webflow capability. (Large PDF attachments not accepted)

3. Link to a Webflow website you have created or worked on with a brief description



Answer these questions:

4.  What is the favourite piece of graphic design you have created and why? (This can be anything from branding, unique logo, poster art or Instagram post, etc.)

5. Tell us about the Notion setup you've worked in.  What did you manage inside it day to day, and how did it help you?





We read every application. Generic copy-paste applications are deleted (the five points above are the application)



Shortlisted candidates will complete a short paid trial task before hire.

title: Full-Time 2D Animator
description:
I’m looking for a full-time 2D animator to create opening music video–style animations for Mobamon, inspired by early 90s/2000s Japanese anime such as Medabots. The core project is a ~1 minute animated opening sequence with characters, action shots, logo moments, and camera moves that feel like a classic TV opening.







Your main responsibilities will include:



1. Designing and animating characters, creatures, and simple environments in a 90s anime style (bold outlines, clear shapes, expressive poses).



2. Creating storyboards/animatics from a rough script and music track to plan the full opening sequence (beats, camera moves, transitions).



3. Producing traditional frame‑by‑frame or layered digital animation (keys + in‑betweens) for action cuts, character introductions, logo reveals, and montage scenes.



4. Handling digital drawing, clean‑up, and colouring for all shots, keeping line quality and style consistent across the sequence.



5. Syncing animation with music and sound effects (hits on the beat, transitions on key moments, logo on chorus, etc.).



6. Preparing production‑ready files and exports (layered project files + final renders at 1080p or higher), with organised naming and folders so we can reuse assets later.



You should be comfortable drawing digitally and animating your own work, not just rigging or moving pre‑made assets. Strong draftsmanship, character posing, timing, and an understanding of classic anime openings are essential. Tools can vary (Adobe Animate, Toon Boom Harmony, Clip Studio Paint, TVPaint, etc.) as long as you can deliver clean, exportable 2D animation.



Please include in your application:



1. A showreel or links to 2–4 of your best 2D animations, ideally anime‑inspired or character‑driven openings/cutscenes.



2. Samples of your digital character art (full‑body poses, expressions, action shots).



3. A brief description of your animation workflow (from storyboard → keys → in‑betweens → clean‑up → colour → final export).

title: HR Coordinator (remote)
description:
We are looking for a People & Culture / HR Coordinator to help us build a strong, positive company culture and make sure our team feels supported, motivated, and aligned with the company’s vision.



This role is not just about hiring people.



We want someone who understands the CEO’s vision, believes in where the company is going, and can help communicate that vision clearly to the rest of the team so everyone feels like they are working toward the same goal.



You will also help us find great people, support existing team members, identify problems early, and make the company a genuinely good place to work.



WHAT YOU WILL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR

Recruitment & Hiring

Post job advertisements

Source and find strong candidates

Review applications

Conduct initial interviews and screening

Coordinate interviews with management

Follow up with candidates throughout the hiring process

Help onboard new employees

Maintain an organized hiring pipeline

Help management continuously find better people as the company grows

Employee Wellbeing

Regularly check in with team members

Understand how employees are feeling about their work

Identify signs of burnout, frustration, low motivation, or other problems

Make sure team members feel heard and supported

Help resolve smaller people-related problems before they become bigger issues

Escalate serious concerns to the management team quickly

Help management understand what is happening inside the team



You are not expected to act as a therapist, but you should care about people and be comfortable noticing when someone is struggling or unhappy.



Company Culture

Help build a positive and enjoyable company culture

Make sure employees understand the company’s mission, values, and direction

Help communicate messages from the CEO and management to the wider team

Come up with simple ideas to keep the team connected and motivated

Organize small online team activities

Remember and recognize birthdays and important milestones

Help organize things like online Friday drinks, games, celebrations, or team events

Find simple ways to make people feel appreciated

Help make the company somewhere people are excited to work



We do not want forced corporate activities.



We want someone who can naturally create a good environment where people feel connected to the company and to each other.



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR



We are looking for someone who is:



Very good with people

Friendly and approachable

Emotionally intelligent

Organized

Reliable

Comfortable speaking with different personalities

Good at noticing when something is wrong

Comfortable having difficult conversations when necessary

Able to communicate management’s vision clearly

Proactive rather than waiting for instructions

Good at following up with people

Comfortable recruiting and interviewing candidates

Able to keep confidential information private

Able to work independently

Positive and energetic without being fake or overly corporate



Previous HR, recruitment, team management, employee engagement, or people operations experience is preferred.



THIS ROLE MAY BE A GOOD FIT IF



You naturally enjoy:



Talking to people

Helping people solve problems

Finding good candidates

Building relationships

Making people feel included

Organizing activities

Improving the work environment

Understanding why someone might be unhappy or underperforming

Helping a team feel connected to a bigger mission

THIS ROLE WILL NOT SUIT SOMEONE WHO

Only wants to post job ads and process paperwork

Is uncomfortable talking to employees about problems

Avoids difficult conversations

Does not follow up

Waits for management to notice every problem first

Is not interested in company culture

Struggles to keep confidential information private

Does not genuinely care about how employees are doing



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE



After a few months:



Hiring is organized and candidates move through the process quickly

Management always knows the status of open positions

New employees have a smooth onboarding experience

Employees feel comfortable speaking to you when something is wrong

Burnout or team problems are noticed earlier

Important employee concerns reach management quickly

The team understands the company’s vision and goals

Employees feel recognized and appreciated

Small culture activities happen consistently

The company feels more connected as it grows



The main goal of this role is simple:



Help us find great people, keep great people, and build a company that people genuinely enjoy being part of.



Please fill out this Google form to be considered.

title: Credit Repair Specialist (DisputeFox + GoHighLevel) — Part-Time, US PST Hours — Must Have Real Experience
description:
We are a US-based credit repair company (Fresh Start Credit Co., California). We are early-stage but funded, organized, and moving fast. We are not a hobby business and we are not looking for someone to "learn on the job."

I am looking for ONE experienced credit repair specialist who already knows this industry inside and out — someone who can take our DisputeFox CRM, clean it up, organize it, and run it properly from day one.

What you will actually be doing

Take full ownership of our DisputeFox CRM — clean up the existing setup, fix what's broken, organize the pipeline, and get it fully operational

Import, audit, and organize existing client files (we already have clients in the system)

Pull and read client credit reports; identify inaccurate, unverifiable, incomplete, or non-compliant items

Draft and send custom dispute letters based on the actual report — not generic templates

Track dispute rounds, deadlines, bureau responses, and follow-ups without being reminded

Work our GoHighLevel setup — pipelines, automations, follow-up sequences, client communication

Handle client communication through OpenPhone (calls, SMS, follow-ups) professionally and on time

Give clients clear status updates so they always know where they stand

Keep clean records and report results to me weekly — what moved, what didn't, what's next

Non-negotiable requirements

Real, verifiable credit repair experience. You have personally worked client files start to finish. You know what a dispute round actually looks like.

DisputeFox — you have actually used it, not watched a YouTube video. You will be tested.

GoHighLevel — you can build and maintain pipelines, automations, and workflows.

You work US Pacific Standard Time (PST). This is not negotiable. Our clients are in California. You must be available during our business hours, not yours.

Strong written and spoken English. You will be talking to American clients about their credit and their money.

Your own reliable equipment and internet. Working computer, backup power, backup internet, quiet workspace, headset. We are not buying you a laptop.

Legal and compliant work only. We follow FCRA, CROA, and Metro 2 compliance. If your "strategy" involves CPNs, fake identity theft claims, or anything that puts a client or this company at legal risk, do not apply. We win with real, aggressive, legal disputing — Metro 2 violations, Section 609/611, debt validation, CFPB complaints, re-aging violations, multi-bureau strategy.

Time is tracked, and it's tracked honestly. We use time tracking. Do not milk the clock. If you sit idle and bill me for it, you're gone the same day.

Bonus points

Experience building or documenting SOPs for a credit repair operation

Experience with Stripe, Zapier, or client onboarding automation

You bring ideas — not just execution. If you've helped a credit company scale before, say so and tell me how.

The honest pitch

This is part-time to start — real hours, real pay, paid hourly — and it grows into full-time as our client base grows. I'm telling you that upfront instead of dangling a fake full-time offer.

We just launched. That means the person who comes in now and does this right becomes the person who runs the credit operation as we scale. If you want to be a body filling hours, this isn't it. If you want to build something and grow with it, this is a serious opportunity.

The last person we hired claimed she knew DisputeFox. She didn't. That cost us time and money. So I'm being blunt: if you can't actually do this, please don't waste either of our time.

How to apply — follow these exact instructions or you will be skipped

Start your application with the word "FOXPRO" so I know you read the whole post.

Then answer all six questions:

How many years have you worked in credit repair, and for which companies or clients?

Have you used DisputeFox? Describe exactly what you did in it — which sections, which features, what you set up or managed.

Walk me through how you handle a client file from intake to first dispute round sent. Step by step.

What's your GoHighLevel experience? What have you personally built in it?

Can you commit to US Pacific Standard Time hours? What hours specifically, in PST?

What is your hourly rate in USD, and how many hours per week can you commit right now?

Attach a short screen recording (2–4 minutes) walking through a DisputeFox or GoHighLevel account you've worked in — hide any client info. Applicants who send the video go to the top of the pile.

title: Email flows for sales community
description:
Email Flows Specialist Needed (One-Off Project, Potential for More Work)



We run a sales training community called FP Elite, hosted on Circle. We need someone to build out our full
 flow system.



What we need



Three core lifecycle flows:



New member welcome flow — for people who just joined the community

Past-due subscription flow — for members whose payment has failed or lapsed

Cancellation flow — for members who have cancelled their subscription



Plus one lead capture flow:



Website
 capture flow — for people who fill out the
 opt-in form on our site before they ever become a member



We already know how we want each flow structured (sequence, timing, goals for each
). You will design and write every
 inside that structure, and then build and connect the flows so they are actually live and sending. This is not a "give me a strategy" job, and it's not a "hand us a design file" job either. We have the strategy. We need someone who can execute the
s, bring good ideas to them, and get them running end to end inside Circle or Klaviyo.



Platform



We host our community on Circle (circle.so). Ideally you have direct experience building and running
 flows inside Circle. If not, we are open to routing this through Klaviyo instead, using an exported lead list from Circle. Either way, you are responsible for setting the flows up and getting them live and sending, not just handing over designs for us to implement. Tell us in your application which setup you would use and why.



How we'll work together



This starts as a one-off project covering all four flows above. If the work and pricing are right, we will bring you on for ongoing flow work after this.



We'll work closely with you on flow logic and structure. You own the
 design, copy, and build.

These designs don't have to be crazy - simple and clean designs will work best



To apply, please include

A brief note on your experience with Circle and/or Klaviyo

A sample of your work

Your rate for a project like this - flat fee only!

title: SEO Specialist
description:
About The Ad Firm



The Ad Firm is a US-based, performance-driven digital marketing agency recognized for delivering measurable ROI through transparent strategies and proven results since 2009. We partner with businesses across industries to grow visibility, traffic, and revenue through precision-built campaigns.



Job Description



We are seeking a results-driven, SEO Specialist who’s passionate about search engine optimization, thrives on data, and knows how to turn insights into impact. You’ll support our SEO Strategists and collaborate with content, web, and sales teams to execute campaigns that drive rankings, traffic, and conversions.



Key Responsibilities



- Assist SEO Strategists with audits, research, strategy, and reporting

- Conduct keyword research, technical audits, and competitor analysis for client websites.

- Optimize on-page elements, including metadata, headings, content structure, and internal linking.

- Identify and resolve technical SEO issues that affect crawlability, site speed, and indexing.

- Collaborate with writers to guide SEO-friendly content creation.

- Monitor rankings and traffic metrics using Ahrefs, SEMrush, and Google Search Console.

- Prepare reports and highlight actionable insights for clients and internal stakeholders.

- Stay current with algorithm updates and SEO best practices.



Required Qualifications



- 4+ years of agency experience managing SEO for multiple clients simultaneously.

- Working knowledge of technical, on-page, and off-page SEO.

- Proven ability to improve organic rankings, traffic, and conversions across industries.

title: We Need One Great Support Person (Shopify + Subscriptions, US Brand, Long Term)
description:
Read this part first



Most support jobs are ticket jobs. You clear the queue, you hit a response time target, nobody notices you unless something goes wrong.



This is not that.



We sell consumer health products in the US on a monthly subscription. That means every single customer conversation is worth real money over time. A customer you calm down and keep stays with us for months. A customer you lose with a lazy reply costs us their entire lifetime value. Support is not a cost center in this business, it is where retention is won or lost.



So we are hiring one person and paying them properly, instead of three people cheaply.



We keep our brand name out of the public posting for competitive reasons. You get the full picture (brand, product, revenue, how we operate) on the intro call, and we will sign an NDA if you want one.



A normal day



You open the inbox. Overnight there are 40 to 70 messages from American customers. Some are simple: where is my order, can I change my address. Some are not: a failed payment on a subscription, someone who wants to cancel because they "did not see results yet", someone whose package says delivered but is not there, someone asking whether the product is safe alongside another supplement.



You work through all of it. You handle the subscription changes yourself in Loop. You issue the refund in Shopify when it is the right call, and you find a better solution when it is not. You notice that eleven people this week asked the same confusing question, and you tell us, because that is a landing page problem, not a support problem.



By the end of your day the queue is empty and nothing has been left for tomorrow.



The tools you will live in



Shopify, Loop Subscriptions, and a helpdesk (Gorgias or similar). If you have used Recharge, Skio or Bold instead of Loop, that transfers fine. If you have never touched a subscription tool, this role will be a hard climb.



This job is for you if



Your written English is genuinely native-level. Our customers are American and they will notice the difference. We test this before anything else.

You have supported ecommerce brands before and can name them

You can be trusted with a refund decision without asking permission every time

You would rather own one brand deeply than juggle five clients

You want a job you are still doing in two years, with more responsibility and more money each year



This job is not for you if



You are looking for something part time on the side

You need to be reminded and followed up on

Your plan is to use canned replies for everything

You cannot overlap with US business hours at all



Nice to have, not required



German (we run other brands in Europe and we pay extra for it)

Health, supplement or wellness niche experience

Experience writing SOPs or macro libraries from scratch



The money



$1,000 to $1,400 per month, depending on what you bring. That is above the usual range for this role and we know it. We would rather overpay one excellent person than manage three average ones.



How to apply

s, subscription changes, refunds, guarantee claims, chargeback documentation, and the weekly summary of what customers keep complaining about.

Queue at zero before you log off

CSAT above 4.7

Supplement or wellness niche

Be the driving force behind the client acquisition process of established online coaches, consultants, and info product founders. These are expert-led businesses where the founder IS the brand. Your job is to oversee Meta ad campaigns such as lead ad campaigns, low-ticket course campaigns, and appointment/VSL campaigns — making sure that ad spend is turning into leads, customers, booked calls, and sales. You own two tightly connected lanes end to end: the Meta ads that put the founder's offer in front of the right people, and the GoHighLevel infrastructure that captures, nurtures, and routes every lead toward a call. ***Role Responsibilities

Meta Ads - End-to-End Campaign Ownership

- Strategy: Build the paid strategy around the funnel and offer stage lead magnet opt-ins, appointment/booked-call campaigns, webinar registrations, and low-ticket product sales for coaching and consulting offers. Map each campaign to a clear objective and a target cost per result.

 campaigns, appointment reminders, campaign hooks & headlines, and landing page copy.

s under AI assistance.

title: Full-Time WFH Technical Onboarding Specialist — $900 Base + Bonuses
description:
We are hiring a Technical Onboarding Manager (TOM).



Your job is to guide new clients through their first 48 hours inside the program. You remove confusion, fix tech issues, assign the right 1:1 Coach, and make sure clients are fully set up before strategy begins.



This is not a passive support role. You are responsible for structure, clarity, activation speed, and client confidence.



This is a client-facing role. You must be clear, confident, calm, and reliable.



Most of our clients are 45+ and not tech-savvy. Patience and strong communication are required.



BENEFITS



- Salary: $900 per month

- Payment: Twice a month via Wise. Always on time.

- Performance bonuses based on CSAT (client rating) and CSQ (coach rating)

- OTE: $1,050–$1,400/month

- Bonus tiers from $30–$100 per category (minimum 20 surveys / 20 handoffs per month)

- Fully remote, long-term role

- Clear scorecard and monthly reviews

- Career growth path (Senior TOM, Lead TOM, CSM)

- 4,000+ clients served since 2019



SCHEDULE



- Full-time: 7.5 hours a day; 37.5 hours/week

- No fixed shift required. You may work a straight or split shift.

- You must attend team meetings (usually 3pm CET)

- Work 7.5 total hours per day within the 8 AM ET to 2 AM ET coverage window, not across the entire window

- Confirm your preferred working hours during hiring

- Maintain a schedule that is sustainable long term



Consistently low energy or repeated mistakes caused by poor schedule management will be treated as performance issues.



RESPONSIBILITIES



- Run structured Activation Calls

- Fully activate every client within 48 hours. Activation means the client has access to Kajabi, Slack, the Client Master Sheet, AI tools (AVA & VERA), understands where everything is, has a Coach assigned, and has their Kickoff Call booked.

- Book Kickoff Call same day or next day

- Assign the correct 1:1 Coach based on phase, fluency, timezone, and availability

- Build authority for the assigned Coach so the client feels confident before strategy begins

- Ensure basic access or setup issues do not reach Coaches

- Update CRM immediately after each call

- Send clear handoff notes to Coaches

- Upload all call recordings

- Reply in #tech-support within 24 hours (weekdays)

- Onboard 20–25 clients per week. Activation Calls are structured and typically 30–45 minutes.

Some weeks are high-volume during promotions. Quality and clarity must remain strong under pressure.

- Keep your calendar accurate and available

- Proactively manage your calendar capacity and flag issues early

- Avoid repeated client-facing process errors



Main goal: Zero confusion for the client. No surprises for the Coach.



CORE STANDARDS



- 100% activation within 48 hours

- CSAT average 85%+

- No Kickoff Call no-shows

- Prevent basic technical escalations

- High CRM accuracy and immediate handoffs

- 24-hour Slack response time

- Reliable, consistent performance



REQUIREMENTS



- Strong customer support or onboarding experience

- C1 English or higher

- Calm with older or low-tech clients

- Comfortable repeating instructions clearly multiple times

- Follows SOPs and scripts closely

- Advanced Slack skills

- Comfortable with Kajabi, Google Drive, and Zoom

- Willing to learn basic creator tools

- Reliable internet, strong camera, proper lighting, and quiet workspace

- Strong schedule discipline



WE ARE NOT A FIT IF



- You are low energy or unclear

- You get frustrated with confused clients

- You cannot explain tech in simple words

- You struggle to follow structured processes

- You cannot consistently maintain agreed working hours

- You have poor camera, lighting, or internet setup



HOW TO APPLY



Fill in the form: 
/to/nI8lIXV4



In the Name field, write: “TOM” + Your First and Last Name



Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.



P.S. Once hired, you will be contracted under Social Influence Consulting LLC.

title: AI VIDEO CREATOR & EDITOR — FULL-TIME
description:
AI VIDEO CREATOR & EDITOR — FULL-TIME



Read this first: this is not a general video-editing job.



You must already have hands-on experience creating video footage with AI tools. If you have never personally generated an AI video shot, this role is not for you.



ABOUT THE ROLE



We are a new European jewelry brand launching soon. Video will be one of the main ways we reach customers—and you will be responsible for creating it.



I provide the brief: the concept, marketing angle, product information, and references. You turn it into a finished short-form video.



You will work across multiple styles, including:



* AI UGC: realistic people talking about or using the product

* Product-focused videos

* ASMR content

* Cartoon and animated videos

* Paid social advertisements

* Organic short-form content

* New formats and creative styles we have not tested yet



AI generation is the most important part of this role.



Editing can be learned. What is harder to find is someone who knows how to get a specific shot from an AI tool: choosing the right model, writing strong prompts, using references properly, troubleshooting bad generations, and regenerating until the result is genuinely good—not simply “close enough.”



You will receive access to our paid Higgsfield account. You will never be expected to pay for tools or credits yourself.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



* Generate AI video shots, mainly using Higgsfield

* Turn written briefs into complete short-form videos

* Build strong hooks, pacing, structure, and endings

* Edit videos in CapCut

* Create and synchronize voice-overs using ElevenLabs

* Add readable, correctly timed text overlays

* Select and edit music and sound effects

* Export the correct formats and aspect ratios for organic social content and paid ads

* Iterate based on feedback and performance data

* Keep project files, generations, and final exports organized

* Study which videos perform and use those insights to improve future work

* Proactively suggest new hooks, concepts, and creative directions



MUST HAVE



* Provable experience generating video footage with AI

* Experience with Higgsfield is preferred, but Veo, Sora, Kling, Runway, Hailuo, or similar tools also count

* Strong CapCut skills—editing should not be your bottleneck

* Experience with ElevenLabs or another AI voice platform

* A portfolio containing short-form videos you personally created

* A good understanding of what makes someone stop scrolling within the first two seconds

* Good written English

* The ability to follow and interpret a written brief

* Fast and reliable communication

* Reliable internet and a computer capable of handling video work



NICE TO HAVE



* Experience with jewelry, fashion, beauty, or skincare

* Experience creating Meta or TikTok ad creatives

* AI image-generation experience using tools such as Nano Banana, Midjourney, or Flux

* After Effects experience

* A strong sense of music and sound design

* Experience analyzing creative performance data



HOURS



This is a full-time, long-term role.



The minimum commitment is 40 hours per week. If you can consistently work 50 hours, that is also possible, and every approved hour will be paid.



I am looking for one person who wants to focus seriously on one brand—not someone balancing five clients at the same time.



COMPENSATION — CHOOSE ONE OF TWO OPTIONS



You may choose the compensation model that suits you best.



OPTION 1: HIGHER GUARANTEED HOURLY RATE



* $5 per hour

* Approximately $867 per month at 40 hours per week

* Approximately $1,083 per month at 50 hours per week

* No sales or performance bonuses



This option is for someone who prefers a higher, predictable hourly income.



OPTION 2: LOWER BASE RATE + PERFORMANCE BONUSES



* $3 per hour

* Approximately $520 per month at 40 hours per week

* Approximately $650 per month at 50 hours per week



On top of this base rate, you earn bonuses based on the results of each original video you create:



* 10 sales: $25 bonus

* 25 sales: additional $70 bonus

* 100+ sales within 30 days: additional $250 bonus

* 50,000+ organic views: additional $25 bonus



The sales milestones stack.



Examples:



* 10 sales = $25

* 30 sales = $25 + $70 = $95

* 100+ sales within 30 days = $25 + $70 + $250 = $345

* If the video also reaches 50,000 organic views, the total becomes $370



There is no cap on how many of your videos can earn bonuses.



One strong-performing video can pay more in bonuses than an entire month of hourly work. This option is for someone willing to accept a lower guaranteed base rate in exchange for significantly more upside.



HOW PERFORMANCE IS MEASURED



To avoid disagreements:



* Sales are measured inside Meta Ads Manager and attributed per creative

* You will be able to see the relevant performance numbers, including sales, spend, and views

* A simple re-edit, resize, or minor variation of an existing video does not count as a completely new video

* A substantially new concept, hook, structure, or creative execution may count as a new video

* Sales bonuses are calculated within the first 30 days after a video starts running



We are a new brand without historical performance data. The bonus framework above is our starting model.



Once we have enough real data, we may discuss adjusting the benchmarks or introducing a combination of sales, creative output, and other performance targets. Any meaningful change will be discussed openly—it will not be changed unexpectedly.



Whichever compensation option you choose, approved working hours are always paid.



WHO THIS ROLE IS FOR



This role is for someone who thinks like an owner.



You should want to understand what each video is supposed to achieve—not just complete the brief.



The right person watches the results, notices which hook or visual worked, learns from failed creatives, and returns with a stronger idea before being asked.



If you only want to clock in, execute instructions exactly, and clock out, this is probably not the right role.



If you need a high guaranteed income immediately, Option 2 is not suitable for you. Choose Option 1 instead.



HOW TO APPLY



Applications without a portfolio will not be considered.



Put the word GOLDFISH at the top of your application so I know you have read the full job post.



Please send:



1. Your portfolio



Include links to short-form videos you personally worked on. Explain exactly what your role was for each video.



2. Proof of your AI video work



Send two or three examples where you personally generated the footage.



For each example, explain:



* Which AI tool you used

* What you generated

* Your prompting and iteration process

* What you did when the output was wrong



Showing a raw AI generation next to the finished edit is strongly preferred.



3. Your tools and experience



List the tools you use and approximately how long you have used each one.



4. Your availability



State how many hours per week you can consistently commit.



5. Your compensation choice



Confirm that you have read both compensation models and choose one:



* Option 1: $5 per hour without performance bonuses

* Option 2: $3 per hour plus performance bonuses



6. Answer these questions



* What is the most recent video you made that you are proud of, and why?

* When an AI video tool repeatedly gives you the wrong shot, what do you actually do?

* Have you ever created a video that measurably generated sales or leads? What were the results?

* Do you have experience with jewelry, fashion, beauty, or a similar visual industry?

* Why do you prefer your chosen compensation model?



HIRING PROCESS



1. Portfolio and application review

2. One short unpaid skills test: a single AI-generated shot requiring approximately 30 minutes

3. One paid trial project at your chosen hourly rate

4. Ongoing full-time role



I reply to everyone who carefully follows the application instructions.

Workflow

* Any required supporting files/assets



Skills We Value



We’re particularly looking for editors who can consistently deliver:



* Clean speech audio isolation and enhancement

* Natural, professional skin-tone colour grading

* Smooth and cinematic music transitions

* Strong storytelling and pacing

* Clean transitions and professional finishing

* Attention to detail and consistency



We also value clear communication, responsiveness, meeting deadlines, and taking ownership of your work.



Long-Term Opportunity



This is not intended to be a one-off project.



We’re looking to build long-term working relationships with reliable editors who are a good fit for our workflow.



Editors who consistently deliver good work, communicate well, and maintain quality can receive regular projects and ongoing work as our project volume grows.



Interested?
