title: Social Media & Content Coordinator
description:
# Social Media & Content Coordinator



**Location:**  online

**Employment Type:** Full-time – depending on the right candidate

**Reports to:** Founder

**Brands:** Food Voyageur + our growing portfolio of businesses



## About the Role



We are looking for a creative, highly organised and social-media-obsessed **Social Media & Content Coordinator** to take ownership of the day-to-day content across our portfolio of four growing businesses.



Currently, our Founder manages much of the social media personally. As our businesses continue to grow, we are looking for someone who can step in and **own the content calendar, creation, editing, scheduling, posting and community engagement across our brands.**



This is not a role where you'll be waiting for someone to tell you what to post each day.



We want someone who can look ahead, identify upcoming occasions and opportunities, plan content around them, repurpose the huge amount of content we already have, and keep our brands consistently active and growing.



You will have access to existing photos and videos as well as new footage captured by our team. Your job is to turn that content into engaging Reels, TikToks, Stories and posts.



## What You'll Be Responsible For



### Content Creation & Editing



* Edit short-form videos for Instagram Reels, TikTok and other social platforms

* Turn raw footage into engaging, fast-paced social content

* Repurpose existing videos and high-performing content into fresh posts

* Create graphics and social content using **Canva**

* Edit and enhance images using **Adobe Lightroom**

* Add captions, hooks, trending audio, text overlays and calls-to-action

* Create different versions of content suitable for each platform

* Write engaging captions, hooks and social copy

* Develop scripts and concepts for videos for the Founder and team to film



### Social Media Management



* Manage day-to-day social media activity across **four businesses**

* Publish content consistently across Instagram,
 and TikTok

* Upload Instagram Stories daily

* Schedule posts in advance

* Ensure every brand remains active and consistent

* Monitor comments, DMs and audience engagement

* Proactively engage with relevant accounts and communities

* Identify trends and opportunities our brands can participate in



### Content Calendar & Planning



* Own and maintain the social media content calendar

* Plan content weeks in advance rather than working day-to-day

* Identify upcoming occasions, events and seasonal opportunities

* Examples include Valentine's Day, Mother's Day, Father's Day, Easter, Christmas, weddings, graduations and other relevant events

* Coordinate campaigns around product launches, promotions and business milestones

* Ensure content is prepared and scheduled ahead of important dates

* Work with the Founder to turn business priorities into social campaigns



### Influencer & Creator Management



* Research influencers and content creators relevant to each brand

* Proactively reach out to potential influencers and collaborators

* Coordinate gifting and collaboration opportunities

* Maintain an influencer/contact database

* Follow up with creators and ensure agreed content is delivered

* Identify opportunities for UGC and creator partnerships



### Growth & Engagement



This role isn't just about posting content — **we want someone who wants to grow our brands.**



You will:



* Monitor social media performance and identify what is working

* Track follower growth, reach, engagement and content performance

* Test different hooks, formats, posting times and content styles

* Identify high-performing content that can be repurposed

* Look for opportunities to increase organic reach

* Help grow our Instagram and TikTok profiles

* Bring new ideas to the table rather than simply executing instructions



## What We're Looking For



You don't necessarily need years of agency experience.



We're more interested in someone who **understands social media, has a great creative eye and can show us what they can create.**



You should have:



* Strong video editing skills

* Strong knowledge of Instagram Reels and TikTok

* Canva experience

* Adobe Lightroom experience

* Excellent written communication and caption-writing skills

* Understanding of hooks, storytelling and short-form content

* Strong organisational and content-planning skills

* Ability to manage multiple brands simultaneously

* Understanding of social media trends

* Confidence reaching out to influencers and creators

* Ability to work independently and take ownership

* A proactive mindset — you see an opportunity and act on it



Experience with tools such as **CapCut, Adobe Premiere Pro or similar video editing software** is highly regarded.



## The Person We're Looking For



You'll probably love this role if you're the person who:



Sees a trend on TikTok and immediately thinks, *"We could do this for the brand."*



Has 30 videos sitting in a folder and sees **50 pieces of content**, not a pile of files.



Notices Mother's Day is approaching and has the campaign planned weeks before anyone needs to ask.



Can take a 60-second piece of raw footage and turn it into a Reel people actually want to watch.



And most importantly, you're comfortable **taking ownership**.



## What Success Looks Like



Within this role, we want to see:



* Consistent daily social media activity across our brands

* A content calendar planned ahead of time

* Stronger and more consistent brand presentation

* Increasing engagement and organic reach

* Growth across Instagram and TikTok

* Regular influencer and creator collaborations

* Existing content being effectively repurposed

* Less reliance on the Founder for day-to-day social media management



## How to Apply



Please send us:



1. Your CV

2. Examples of social media accounts or content you've worked on

3. **3–5 Reels/TikToks you have personally edited or created**

4. A short explanation of why you think you'd be a great fit for this role



**Bonus:** Send us an example of a brand you think is doing social media exceptionally well and tell us why.



We are looking for someone creative, hungry to learn and excited about helping build and grow multiple brands.



If you love creating content and understand that great social media is about **attention, storytelling, consistency and community — we'd love to hear from you.**

To Apply, please submit this form:

Data entry and file management in broker CRM platforms (Mercury, Salesforce, or equivalent)

Coordinating with lenders, vendors, dealers, and clients throughout the approval and settlement process

Managing discharge and payout requests, PPSR checks, and ASIC searches

Preparing funds-to-complete confirmations and settlement instructions

Post-settlement tasks — invoice reconciliation, asset registration follow-up, client retention





You Must Have

2–3 years of experience in Australian asset finance — broker-side, not lender operations

Asset finance product knowledge — equipment finance, chattel mortgage, novated lease, hire purchase, commercial hire purchase, finance lease, operating lease

 Lender portal experience — submitting and tracking applications with major AU asset finance lenders (e.g. Westpac, NAB, ANZ, Macquarie, Pepper Money, Angle Finance, Grow Finance, Shift, ScotPac, Liberty, Fifo Capital)

Income assessment — PAYG, self-employed, company, and trust financials for asset finance purposes

CRM proficiency — Mercury, Salesforce, or comparable broker CRM

Understanding of GST, ABN, and tax implications relevant to asset finance structures

AEST business hours — full-time, Monday to Friday

Excellent written and spoken English — direct communication with brokers, clients, and lenders



Minimum Requirements



Strong understanding of chattel mortgage and finance lease structures

Comfortable handling multiple files simultaneously with strict attention to detail and deadlines

Familiar with PPSR (Personal Property Securities Register) searches and registrations

Understanding of responsible lending obligations and privacy requirements under Australian law

Proficient in Microsoft Office — Word, Excel, Outlook

Fast internet connection and professional home office setup





Nice to Have



Experience with novated leasing or fleet finance

Exposure to construction equipment, yellow goods, or specialised asset classes

Familiarity with commercial property-backed asset finance

Experience using ApplyOnline, Loanapp, or Simpology for commercial submissions

Cert IV in Finance & Mortgage Broking or equivalent





Education

A bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, or a related field is preferred but not required. We value hands-on Australian asset finance experience above qualifications. Candidates without a degree but with 2+ years of direct broker support experience are strongly encouraged to apply.



What We Offer



Competitive base salary based on experience

HMO coverage

Leave credits

13th Month Pay

Career growth — we're building a 50+ person capability centre within 12 months





About the Role

This is a direct broker support role — you work for the broker, not a lender or bank. You are the engine behind the broker's business, managing their asset finance pipeline, keeping deals moving, and making sure nothing falls through the cracks between application and settlement.

You'll be part of Pierian Australia's dedicated back-office capability centre, supporting Australian asset finance brokers across commercial equipment, vehicles, technology, and other asset classes.

* Create promotional and seasonal content when it supports our current marketing goals.

* Keep the appearance, voice, and messaging of our accounts consistent with the K&N brand.



We want exactly 3 purposeful posts each week. Quality, consistency, and having a reason behind each post are more important to us than posting every day.



Content Planning & Marketing Alignment



Content planning is an important part of this position.



The Social Media VA will be expected to:



* Maintain a monthly content calendar.

* Plan upcoming posts rather than creating content at the last minute.

* Make sure weekly posts support K&N's current marketing priorities.

* Use the weekly meeting to understand which services, customer types, promotions, hiring needs, or company messages we currently want to emphasize.

* Develop a mix of educational, promotional, trust-building, employee/team, and service-related content.

* Keep track of previously published content so our pages do not become repetitive.

* Suggest new content ideas instead of relying entirely on management to provide them.

* Identify photos, videos, testimonials, or other materials needed from management in advance.

* Build and maintain an organized library of photos, videos, graphics, and reusable content.

* Think about the purpose of each post and what we want the audience to do or understand after seeing it.

* Adjust upcoming content when company marketing priorities change.



We want our social media to work together with the rest of our marketing, not operate as a completely separate activity.



Weekly Marketing Meeting



There will be a quick 15-minute meeting once per week with management.



The purpose of this meeting is to:



* Review the upcoming week's 3 posts.

* Discuss what K&N is currently trying to promote or accomplish.

* Identify services or customer types we want to focus on.

* Discuss upcoming holidays, promotions, hiring needs, or company updates.

* Determine what photos or information the VA needs from us.

* Review what is working and what should be adjusted.



The VA should come to this meeting prepared with ideas and a plan. We do not want the entire meeting spent telling the VA what to post.



Website Support



Occasionally, the VA will also help keep the K&N website current.



This may include:



* Updating photos.

* Updating basic service information.

* Adding or changing text.

* Updating contact or employment information.

* Adding customer reviews or testimonials.

* Making simple page updates when requested.

* Checking the website periodically for outdated information.



This position does not require advanced web development or coding.



Brand & Content Standards



We want our online presence to feel professional but still personal.



The person in this position should be able to learn K&N's brand and create content that feels like it actually belongs to our company rather than generic cleaning-company content.



We do not want every post to be an advertisement.



Our content should help potential customers understand who we are, see the quality of our work, get to know our team, understand the value of professional cleaning, and feel comfortable trusting K&N in their homes or businesses.



What We Are Looking For



The ideal candidate:



* Has previous experience managing
 and Instagram business pages.

* Has experience creating content in Canva.

* Understands basic marketing concepts, not just social media posting.

* Can plan content around a company's current marketing goals.

* Has strong written English.

* Can write captions that sound natural rather than robotic or overly promotional.

* Has a good eye for clean, professional design.

* Can work independently.

* Can follow an established brand style.

* Is creative and regularly brings new ideas to the table.

* Is organized and plans ahead.

* Pays attention to spelling, grammar, image quality, and small details.

* Can consistently meet a 3-post-per-week schedule.

* Comes prepared for weekly meetings.

* Can complete work without constant reminders.

* Is comfortable receiving feedback and making revisions.



Experience working with a cleaning company, home-service business, or other local service business is a plus but is not required.



Schedule & Compensation



Approximately 6 hours per week.



Starting Pay: $5.00 USD per hour.



The schedule is mostly flexible. Most work does not need to be completed during New York business hours as long as deadlines are met and communication is reliable.



The VA must be available for one scheduled 15-minute meeting each week with management.



There may be opportunities for additional hours and responsibilities as the company grows.



How to Apply



Please submit the following:



1. Your resume or a brief summary of your experience.



2. Links or screenshots showing social media pages, Canva designs, graphics, or other content you have previously created.



3. Tell us about your experience managing
 and Instagram business accounts.



4. Tell us about your experience planning social media content around a company's marketing goals.



5. Tell us about any experience you have updating websites.



6. Tell us what programs you currently use for creating, planning, and scheduling content.



7. Send a 60–90 second voice note introducing yourself and explaining why you think you would be a good fit for this position.



8. Create one sample social media post for a residential cleaning company. Include the graphic/image concept and the caption you would use.



9. Briefly tell us what 3 different types of posts you would create during your first week managing a residential cleaning company's social media and why you chose them.



Please include the words "K&N SOCIAL MEDIA VA" in your application so we know you read the entire job posting.



Applications that do not include the requested sample work and voice introduction will not be considered.

title: Bodycam & Public Records Researcher — True Crime YouTube
description:
ABOUT THE PROJECT



I am building a long-form YouTube documentary project focused on real police bodycam encounters, true crime, human behavior, and the escalation of high-stakes encounters.



The goal is NOT to simply summarize what happened or compile bodycam footage. Each story should explore how an encounter developed, the behavioral warning signs, the escalation, and the moment when the situation reached its breaking point.



YOUR ROLE



You will research compelling U.S. police/bodycam cases and create organized research packages that can be used directly by a professional scriptwriter and video editor.



You will be responsible for finding strong cases, locating relevant publicly accessible footage and source material, verifying the facts, and organizing everything the production team needs to tell the story.



Your research should include:



• Finding compelling cases with strong long-form storytelling potential

• Locating and organizing legally/publicly accessible bodycam, dashcam, police or other relevant footage

• Providing direct source links and identifying which footage is relevant

• Researching police reports, public records, court documents, and credible news sources when available

• Verifying important facts and building a chronological timeline

• Identifying important footage timestamps

• Identifying behavioral changes and warning signs

• Identifying escalation points and the potential “tipping point” of the encounter

• Separating observable behavior from speculation or diagnosis

• Organizing footage, sources, timestamps, notes, and findings into one clear research package



PSYCHOLOGICAL / BEHAVIORAL COMPONENT



A major part of this project is understanding human behavior under pressure.



You do NOT need to be a psychologist, but experience or strong interest in psychology, behavioral analysis, criminology, investigative research, or similar fields is highly valued.



We want research that helps the writer explain what changed in the person's behavior, what preceded the escalation, and what observable factors contributed to the encounter reaching its breaking point.



You should focus on observable behavior and evidence rather than attempting to diagnose individuals.



TEAMWORK IS REQUIRED



You will work as part of a production team with a scriptwriter and video editor.



Your research directly influences both the script and the edit. The writer needs to understand the story and behavioral progression, while the editor needs to know which footage and timestamps are important.



You should therefore be comfortable:



• Explaining your findings to the scriptwriter

• Identifying important footage for the editor

• Answering questions about your research

• Flagging new information that changes the story

• Making reasonable corrections when additional information is discovered



This is NOT a role where you simply send links and work independently.



PAY



$10–20 per completed research package, depending on case complexity and agreed scope.



This is a fixed-rate, project-based position.



The agreed rate covers the research package described above. Additional work outside the agreed scope must be approved beforehand.



We are looking for someone interested in becoming a reliable long-term member of the production team as the project grows.



TO APPLY



Please provide:



Your relevant research experience

Any experience researching police/bodycam or true-crime cases

Any experience with public records or FOIA research

Your experience or knowledge of psychology/behavioral analysis

Your expected fixed rate per research package

One example of a case you believe would make a compelling long-form documentary and briefly explain why

Any examples of previous research work, if available



Important: Please do not send generic research samples. Relevant investigative, documentary, true-crime, public-record, or bodycam research experience is strongly preferred.

title: Administrative Virtual Assistant
description:
Administrative Virtual Assistant



Company: K&N Cleaning Service LLC

Location: Remote 

Hours: 15–20 hours per week

Starting Pay: $5.00 USD per hour

Position Type: Part-Time



 About K&N Cleaning Service



K&N Cleaning Service is a growing cleaning company serving residential, Airbnb, and small commercial clients throughout New York's Hudson Valley.



We are looking for a highly organized, reliable, and proactive **Administrative Virtual Assistant** to help manage the behind-the-scenes administrative responsibilities of our company.



This position is heavily focused on **administrative support, hiring, bill and payment management, job advertising, and business outreach**.



This is not a social media position and is not primarily a customer service position.



We are looking for someone who can learn our systems, take ownership of recurring responsibilities, meet deadlines, and help keep the business organized without needing constant reminders.



 Primary Responsibilities

Administrative Support

Administrative support will be the largest part of this position.



Responsibilities will include:



* Maintain organized company files and Google Drive folders.

* Update spreadsheets, trackers, and internal records.

* Maintain accurate client, employee, and company information.

* Assist with invoicing and billing administration.

* Enter and organize receipts, expenses, and financial records.

* Maintain employee hours and administrative records.

* Prepare weekly reports for management.

* Update internal forms, documents, checklists, and trackers.

* Perform data entry accurately and consistently.

* Track important deadlines and recurring administrative tasks.

* Conduct online research as needed.

* Follow up on incomplete administrative items.

* Identify missing information or potential problems and bring them to management's attention.



 Bills & Payment Management



An important responsibility of this position will be helping ensure company bills are handled accurately and **paid on time**.



Responsibilities may include:



* Maintain a list of recurring company bills and due dates.

* Monitor upcoming payment deadlines.

* Pay approved company bills using established company procedures.

* Confirm payments have been successfully processed.

* Save receipts and payment confirmations.

* Maintain accurate payment records.

* Notify management of unusual charges, payment problems, or unexpected expenses.

* Track recurring subscriptions and services.

* Help prevent late fees, missed payments, and unnecessary duplicate charges.

* Provide management with visibility into upcoming bills and completed payments.



**The VA will be expected to follow company approval procedures and will not independently make unapproved purchases or financial decisions.**



Accuracy, confidentiality, and attention to detail are extremely important for this part of the position.



Hiring & Employee Support

Hiring support will be another major responsibility.

The VA will help keep K&N's hiring pipeline active and organized.



Responsibilities include:



* Create and post job advertisements using company-approved information.

* Regularly repost or refresh hiring advertisements when needed.

* Monitor incoming applications.

* Review applications and resumes for basic qualifications.

* Organize candidates by hiring stage.

* Conduct initial applicant screening.

* Communicate with applicants.

* Schedule interviews with management.

* Send interview reminders and confirmations.

* Follow up with candidates when instructed.

* Maintain an organized hiring tracker.

* Assist with new-hire paperwork and onboarding.

* Maintain employee documents and records.

* Track onboarding and training progress.

* Maintain a pipeline of potential candidates so K&N can hire quickly when staffing needs arise.



The goal is for management to spend its time interviewing strong candidates rather than sorting through applications and chasing applicants.



Cold
 & Business Outreach

The VA will also assist K&N with targeted business development.

This is primarily *
-based outreach**, not a full-time cold-calling sales position.



Responsibilities may include:



* Research potential local commercial clients and business opportunities.

* Identify appropriate decision-makers and contact information.

* Build and maintain prospect lists.

* Send company-approved cold outreach
s.

* Send scheduled follow-up
s.

* Keep accurate records of businesses contacted.

* Track responses and interested prospects.

* Forward qualified opportunities to management.

* Keep outreach lists clean, current, and organized.



Outreach should be professional and personalized. We are not looking for someone to simply send hundreds of low-quality spam
s.



Job Advertising



The VA will be responsible for helping K&N consistently attract applicants.



Responsibilities include:



* Post approved job advertisements on appropriate hiring platforms.

* Monitor which advertisements are active.

* Refresh or repost ads when necessary.

* Update postings when hiring needs change.

* Track where applicants are coming from.

* Remove outdated job advertisements.

* Help test different job titles and advertisements to improve applicant quality.



 Limited Client Communication



Client communication is **not a primary responsibility** of this position.



Occasionally, the VA may be asked to:



* Send routine appointment confirmations.

* Request missing information.

* Send review requests.

* Send basic administrative
s.

* Follow up on routine billing or scheduling matters.



Complaints, pricing decisions, estimates, service problems, cancellations, and sensitive client issues should be escalated to management.



What This Position Does NOT Include



This position is **not responsible for:**



* Managing K&N's social media.

* Creating daily
 or Instagram content.

* Handling major customer complaints.

* Making pricing decisions.

* Preparing cleaning estimates independently.

* Managing field employees without management direction.

* Making unapproved purchases or financial decisions.



 What We Are Looking For



The ideal candidate is:



* Highly organized and detail-oriented.

* Reliable and consistent.

* Comfortable managing deadlines.

* Proactive instead of waiting for every task to be assigned.

* Able to manage recurring responsibilities independently.

* Strong in written and spoken English.

* Comfortable communicating with job applicants and businesses.

* Comfortable working with spreadsheets and financial records.

* Able to handle confidential business information responsibly.

* Comfortable performing online research.

* Able to follow written procedures accurately.

* Willing to ask questions when something is unclear.

* Interested in a long-term position with a growing company.



Previous experience in **virtual assistance, administration, recruiting, bookkeeping support, hiring, or cold
 outreach** is preferred.



Software & Tools



Experience with the following is helpful:



* Google Workspace

* Gmail

* Google Drive

* Google Sheets

* Canva

* Online job boards

* Scheduling software

* Employee/time-tracking software

*
 marketing or outreach tools



Training will be provided on K&N's specific processes.



Technology Requirements



Applicants must have:



* Reliable computer.

* Reliable high-speed internet.

* Quiet workspace.

* Working microphone/headset.

* Reliable communication during scheduled working hours.

* Backup internet or power option whenever possible.



Schedule & Compensation



15–20 hours per week



Starting Pay: $5.00 USD per hour



Some overlap with New York business hours will be required, especially for hiring, applicant communication, and administrative responsibilities.



There is potential for additional hours and responsibilities as the company grows and the VA demonstrates reliability and strong performance.



What Success Looks Like



A successful VA will make the administrative side of K&N easier to manage.



We should be able to depend on this person to:



* Keep administrative records organized and current.

* Make sure approved bills are paid by their due dates.

* Keep the hiring pipeline moving.

* Keep job advertisements active when we are hiring.

* Consistently complete cold
 outreach and follow-ups.

* Complete recurring tasks without repeated reminders.

* Catch missing information or upcoming deadlines.

* Communicate problems before they become emergencies.

* Provide management with clear updates on what has been completed and what still needs attention.



We are looking for someone who will eventually know their recurring responsibilities well enough that management frequently hears:



**"I already took care of it."**



How to Apply



To be considered, please submit all of the following:



1. Resume– Include your previous VA, administrative, hiring, bookkeeping, or outreach experience.



2. Availability – Tell us how many hours per week you are available and what hours you can work.



3. Experience– Briefly describe your experience with:



   * Administrative work

   * Hiring/recruiting

   * Google Workspace

   * Paying or tracking business bills

   * Cold
 outreach

   * Posting job advertisements



4. Technology – Provide your computer specifications and internet speed.



5. Voice Introduction – REQUIRED



Send a 60–90 second voice note introducing yourself.



In your voice note, please tell us:



* Your name.

* Your previous VA or administrative experience.

* What type of work you are strongest at.

* Why you believe you would be a good fit for this position.



Applications without a voice introduction will not be considered.



Finally, include the words "K&N ADMIN VA" in your written application so we know you read the entire job posting.

title: Digital Marketing Assistant
description:
Join AEK Media, an award-winning digital marketing agency, and work remotely with a global team. You’ll help manage paid campaigns across Google, Meta, LinkedIn, Pinterest and more.



This role is ideal for someone who already has hands-on paid media experience, wants to take greater ownership of campaign performance, and is eager to develop into a well-rounded digital marketer.







Your Role



Manage Paid Advertising



Build, manage, monitor and optimise campaigns across Google Ads, Meta, LinkedIn, Pinterest and other platforms.



Own Campaign Performance



Regularly analyse results, identify opportunities and make optimisation decisions rather than simply following a checklist.



Client Setup & Tracking



Assist with client onboarding and ensure conversion tracking is implemented accurately across advertising platforms, GA4 and Google Tag Manager.



Reporting



Build and maintain clear reporting dashboards using Looker Studio and Google Sheets, turning campaign data into useful insights.



Strategy & Analysis



Develop campaigns around the customer journey, understand the role of different channels and use data to determine where budget should be allocated.



Commercial Thinking



Understand that campaign success goes beyond clicks and leads. Consider lead quality, conversion rates, acquisition costs, customer value and the commercial objectives of each client.



Collaboration



Work closely with strategists, creatives, developers and account managers to improve campaign performance and deliver strong client outcomes.



Website Updates



Make minor updates to client websites and landing pages, and coordinate larger changes with our development team.



About You



2+ years of hands-on experience managing paid advertising campaigns, ideally across multiple client accounts.



You should be comfortable independently working inside Google Ads and Meta Ads Manager, rather than having only reporting or account coordination experience.



You have experience with campaign setup, audience targeting, keyword research, bidding, budget management, creative testing and ongoing optimisation.



You can look at campaign data and explain what is happening, why it is happening and what you would do next.



You understand key performance metrics such as CPA, CPL, ROAS, conversion rate, CTR and CPC, and know when each metric matters.



You have working knowledge of GA4, Google Tag Manager and conversion tracking. Experience troubleshooting tracking issues is highly regarded.



You are comfortable working with Google Sheets or Excel and can confidently analyse campaign data.



You have strong attention to detail. You notice tracking discrepancies, incorrect URLs, budget issues, broken landing pages and other small problems before they become bigger ones.



You are proactive and comfortable taking ownership. If you see an issue, you investigate it and suggest a solution rather than waiting to be told what to do.



You can manage multiple client accounts and competing priorities in a fast-paced remote environment.



You communicate clearly in writing and can explain marketing performance to people who may not have a technical marketing background.



You are curious and want to understand why something works rather than simply replicating what you have seen elsewhere.



Highly Regarded



Experience managing campaigns across both lead generation and eCommerce accounts



Experience with LinkedIn Ads, Pinterest Ads or other paid media platforms



Looker Studio reporting experience



WordPress or Elementor experience



Landing page and CRO knowledge



Basic understanding of SEO



Experience working within an agency



Experience managing meaningful advertising budgets across multiple accounts



Why AEK Media?



Work remotely with a globally recognised, award-winning team.



Work across a diverse range of industries, campaign types and digital channels.



Develop your skills beyond simply managing ads, with exposure to strategy, analytics, CRO, creative, websites and broader digital marketing.



Take on greater responsibility as your skills develop, with genuine opportunities for career progression.



Join a culture that values transparency, merit and action.



Our Values



No Black Boxes – Transparency in all we do



Do Things Today, Not Tomorrow – Take action and keep things moving



Open Forum – Good ideas can come from anyone



Don’t Avoid the Details – The small things often make the biggest difference



Consider the Commercial – Marketing needs to deliver meaningful business outcomes



How to Apply



We welcome applications from people who may not meet every requirement. However, we are looking for candidates with genuine hands-on paid media experience who can demonstrate how they think about campaign performance.



Along with your CV, please include brief answers to the following:



1. Which advertising platforms have you personally managed?

2. What approximate monthly advertising budgets have you been responsible for?

3. Tell us about one campaign you improved. What was underperforming, what did you change and what happened?

4. What is your experience with GA4, Google Tag Manager and conversion tracking?

5. How many client accounts or campaigns have you managed simultaneously?

6. What is one optimisation you would investigate if a campaign’s CPA suddenly increased by 50%?

7. Which areas of digital marketing are you most interested in developing over the next two years?



We’re less interested in textbook answers than in understanding how you think, how much ownership you’ve had, and how you approach solving problems.

title: PERFORMANCE VIDEO EDITOR
description:
Performance Video Editor

Exchange Life · Fully Remote · Full-Time Contractor · ~40 hrs/week $10–20 USD/hour depending on experience + uncapped performance bonuses

About Exchange Life

Exchange Life is one of the fastest-growing e-commerce travel jewelry brands in the US. We sell collectible country charms for travelers, with new products launching soon. Our content machine has generated over a quarter billion views across TikTok and Instagram.

This role is video, end-to-end. You'll concept and cut short-form video ads for paid media across TikTok, Reels, and Meta placements, where every edit is judged on what it does to hook rate, retention, and spend. You're not making brand films or organic filler. You're making the creative we put budget behind.

We're looking for an editor who can own their output and be creative within proven marketing fundamentals, not just execute tasks. This is not a gig; it's a long-term partnership. Many of our editors have been with us 2+ years, and the people who now set our creative direction started as editors here.

You'll work closely with our Content Lead and Marketing team. We're a small, high-output team that moves fast, communicates daily, and invests in the people who show up.

Where You'll Be in Six Months

Senior Performance Video Editor.

That's the next title, and it's within reach inside your first six months if your work earns it. At that level you have full creative autonomy: you own video concepts end to end, you d
 which angles we test next instead of receiving briefs, your creatives are the ones we put real spend behind, and you start reviewing other editors' cuts and shaping how they work.

It's d
 by performance, not time served. Move faster if your work moves faster.

Compensation & Earning Potential

Base: $10–20 USD/hour depending on experience

Performance bonuses: Uncapped, paid per winning creative. Every video that hits our performance thresholds or scales on paid ads pays out.

Rate reviews: Revisited as you take on more, not on an annual calendar

Our top editors earn meaningfully more than their base because they produce winners consistently. That's the whole design: we'd rather pay a lot for creatives that work than a little for creatives that don't.

What Success Looks Like

After 3–6 months, a successful hire is consistently producing short-form video ads that scale on paid and perform organically, hitting 50%+ thumb-stop rates and 30%+ hold rates, and iterating on winning formats without needing direction from the marketing team. You'll be a trusted creative partner, not just an executor.

Core Responsibilities

Concept and edit short-form video ads for TikTok, Reels, and Meta, built around hook rate, retention, and watch time rather than aesthetics

Develop new video angles and hooks, then test them against our proven formats

Build AI-assisted video creative using current tools, and keep pace as those tools change

Review your past edits daily, identify what's working and what isn't, and improve without repeating mistakes

Work directly from paid performance data to d
 what to cut next

Turn around content quickly and communicate proactively every day, with no check-ins required

Stay on top of TikTok and Instagram trends and apply them where they'll actually convert

Must-Haves

A strong recent portfolio of short-form video edits, ideally including paid ad creative (20+ from the last few months)

You can watch a winning video ad and break down exactly what made it work

Hands-on experience across video formats: hook-led headline videos, talking heads, voiceovers, UGC-style edits, AI video

Ability to read metrics (hook rate, retention, watch time, spend) and know what to change in the next cut

Takes ownership, internalizes feedback, doesn't repeat the same mistake twice

Highly skilled in CapCut Pro or a comparable editing tool

Strong written and spoken English; able to work independently

Nice-to-Haves

Experience cutting video ads for e-commerce or DTC brands

Experience working directly against Meta or TikTok ad account data

A track record of creatives that scaled on paid

What You'll Learn Here

Most editing jobs teach you software. This one teaches you why video sells.

Direct access to paid performance data on real ad spend, so you see exactly which of your creatives print and which die

1-on-1 mentorship from our Content Lead

Paid courses and software, including the AI video tools you'll be working in

A portfolio backed by numbers, not vibes. "This cut did 4M views and scaled to $X/day" is a career asset that follows you.

Not a Fit If

Your portfolio is mostly long-form, YouTube, or event/wedding content

You can't point to a recent video ad and explain why it performed

You want to make beautiful videos more than videos that sell

You need a fixed schedule or close supervision to stay productive

You're looking for a short-term project or side gig

Working Style

Engagement: Independent contractor, paid in USD

Location: 100% remote

Hours: ~40 hrs/week, long-term role

Schedule: Fully flexible. Work whenever you want, as long as you turn work around quickly and communicate daily (async). No timezone overlap required.

Time off: Flexible PTO. Take the time you need, just coordinate with the team.

Tools: CapCut Pro (or comparable), AI video tools, TikTok/Meta analytics

Working style: No micromanagement

title: Admin Assistant (Full-Time, Remote)
description:
Moon Magnet Music is a Denver based company founded in 2013, operating three lines of business: a music school, a wedding DJ productions company, and a mixing & mastering recording studio. Recent recognition includes Westword's Best of Denver 2026 (Best Mobile Music Recording), back to back Best of Zola awards for our DJ team, and a 2026 CU Denver Outstanding Alumni Award for our founder.

Our core values, Be the Best Version of Yourself; Be 100% Engaged; Imagination & Creativity; Discover Everyone's Story; Communicate Consistently to Gain Trust; Build Community, shape how we work with students, clients, and each other.



*Position Summary*

The Admin Assistant is the written voice of Moon Magnet. Approximately 90% of the role is writing and administration (responding to leads, writing marketing content, and keeping our systems current) and approximately 10% is phone-based sales support with music school and event leads. The role works alongside our School Manager and directly with the owner, and is central to making sure every lead, student, family, and DJ client hears from us quickly, warmly, and consistently.



*Key Responsibilities*

 and text within established response time standards

2. Administration

 marketing platform as directed

*Schedule*

-This is a full-time role at 40 hours per week.

-Live window (required): 3:00–6:30pm US Mountain Time, five days per week (5:00–8:30am PH Time (roughly March through November) or 6:00–9:30am PH Time (roughly November through March). 



Which five days: 

-US Friday and Saturday are required (Saturday and Sunday mornings in the Philippines).

What the live window is used for:

-Saturday and Sunday PH mornings (US Fri–Sat): calling leads and getting back to text messages and
s that came in over the weekend.

-Monday through Friday PH mornings (US Sun–Thu, on your three chosen days): daily meetings with the business owner and calling leads



All other hours (the remaining ~30 hours per week) are flexible — work them whenever works best for you during your own daytime.



*Qualifications*



Required

-Excellent written English (near native) and a genuine enjoyment of writing

-Clear, natural sounding spoken English suitable for phone conversations with US clients

-Reliable computer and at home internet connection (verified by speed test)

-Ability to commit long term to the schedule above, including PH weekend mornings

-Openness to using AI tools within our workflow, applying your own judgment and voice. AI is used in all workflows



Preferred

-Social media content or caption writing experience

-CRM and
 marketing platform experience

-Experience working US timezone schedules



*Terms & Benefits*

-Independent contractor agreement with a 90-day paid trial period, including a formal Week-3 checkpoint with written goals shared before day one

-13th month pay

-Performance based raises every six months

-Paid via Wise

-Fully remote with on the job training



*Hiring Process*

Our process takes about 2.5 weeks, and we respond to every candidate within 3 days at every stage: 



pre-screen survey → 20 minute Zoom → live writing exercise → reference check → second Zoom with a practice sales call → small paid project (3–5 finalists) → paid final Zoom → offer. At least one interview is held during the actual live window (a PH Saturday morning) so you can experience the schedule before committing.



To apply, send a message and resume telling us why you'd be a good fit, along with your writing, sales, admin, or marketing experience.

title: Long-Form YouTube Video Editor — True Crime / Bodycam
description:
ABOUT THE PROJECT



I am building a long-form YouTube documentary project focused on real police bodycam encounters, true crime, human behavior, and the escalation of high-stakes encounters.



The goal is NOT to create a simple bodycam compilation. Each episode should take viewers through how an encounter develops, the behavioral changes and escalation, and ultimately the moment when the situation reaches its breaking point.



YOUR ROLE



You will be responsible for turning the approved script, research materials, bodycam footage, and other supporting assets into a polished long-form YouTube documentary.



Your responsibilities include:



• Editing bodycam, dashcam, police and supporting footage

• Producing the video's AI voiceover/narration from the approved script

• Syncing narration naturally with the footage

• Creating strong pacing and viewer retention throughout the video

• Cleaning and balancing audio

• Adding appropriate music and sound design

• Adding subtitles and on-screen text when useful

• Using B-roll, documents, screenshots, maps or other supporting visuals when appropriate

• Using strategic zooms, replays, freezes and other visual emphasis when they help explain an important moment

• Visually emphasizing behavioral changes and escalation

• Building toward the central “tipping point” of the encounter

• Maintaining a professional documentary style throughout



EDITING STYLE



The editing should feel cinematic, investigative, tense, and engaging without becoming overly flashy.



We want the footage and story to remain the focus. Effects should support the storytelling rather than distract from it.



Strong editing judgment is more important than using a large number of effects.



AI VOICEOVER



AI narration is part of the editing role.



You will be responsible for:



• Generating the narration from the approved script

• Selecting an appropriate natural-sounding AI voice

• Adjusting pacing and pronunciation when necessary

• Syncing narration with the edit

• Ensuring the final voiceover sounds natural and professional



Experience with ElevenLabs or similar AI voice tools is preferred.



TEAMWORK IS REQUIRED



You will work directly with the researcher and scriptwriter.



The researcher provides the evidence, footage and important timestamps. The scriptwriter turns that material into the narrative. Your responsibility is to turn the approved material into the final viewing experience.



You should be comfortable:



• Asking questions when footage or script instructions are unclear

• Flagging footage that does not match the script

• Suggesting visual solutions when appropriate

• Communicating issues that could affect the final video

• Making reasonable corrections based on feedback



This is NOT a role where you simply place footage underneath a voiceover.



PAY



$30–40 per completed video, depending on length and complexity.



This is a fixed-rate, project-based position.



Please state your expected fixed rate for a standard 15–20 minute video and your rate for a 20–30 minute video.



The agreed rate includes the editing, AI narration production, standard audio work, subtitles/text, and normal visual elements described above.



Additional work outside the agreed scope must be approved beforehand.



We are looking for someone interested in becoming a reliable long-term member of the production team as the project grows.



TO APPLY



Please provide:



2–3 examples of your strongest long-form YouTube edits

Experience with documentary, true crime, bodycam, investigative or similar content

The editing software you use

Any experience using AI voiceover tools such as ElevenLabs

Your expected fixed rate for a 15–30 minute video

Your typical turnaround time

Briefly explain how you would keep a 20+ minute documentary engaging without relying on excessive effects



Please include your strongest relevant portfolio examples.

title: Instagram Content Creator & Social Media Manager
description:
Turn ideas into scroll-stopping content for travel brands, expat families, and rising female coaches.



Location: Remote / Work From Home 

Schedule: Full-time contractor, flexible hours, weekly deadlines 

Pay: $300 to $600 USD/month (flexible based on experience)



WHO WE ARE

We help travel brands inspire unforgettable trips, support families relocating abroad, and empower female online coaches to build authority and scale their businesses. Now we need a dedicated content creator to bring these brands to life on Instagram, one reel, carousel, and story at a time.



IS THIS YOU?

You're not "just" a video editor. You're a storyteller who happens to be great with Premiere Pro. If this sounds like you, keep reading:

You feel the edit. You know how music, pacing, text, and timing turn a clip into something people can't scroll past.

You have sharp instincts. Photo dumps, reel text placement, picking the perfect three seconds; it's second nature to you.

You catch what others miss. Small details make or break great content, and you notice all of them.

You're rock solid reliable. Deadlines aren't a suggestion. You deliver, every time.

You're always leveling up. New trends, new AI tools, new techniques; you're first in line to try them.

You bring the energy. Creative, positive, and genuinely excited about the work.

You'll work directly with the CEO/Strategist and execute an already built content strategy. No client facing calls required.



WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

Editing scroll stopping Instagram Reels aligned to each brand's creative direction.

Designing eye catching Carousel posts that educate, entertain, and build authority.

Editing talking head and storytelling content across multiple brands.

Choosing trending audio and editing styles that boost engagement and retention.

Applying color grading, color correction, and audio balancing for a polished finish.

Sourcing natural looking B roll and supporting visuals.

Creating Instagram Stories with photos, videos, graphics, polls, and countdowns.

Writing captions that sound like each brand, not a template.

Posting to the content calendar and keeping every feed cohesive.

Using AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Kling AI, etc.) to work smarter and faster.

Reviewing analytics and recommending what to do next.

Revising based on feedback, and actually enjoying the process.

Staying plugged into Instagram trends before everyone else catches on.



WHAT YOU BRING

A strong portfolio of Instagram content: Reels, Stories, Captions, Carousels.

Proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro, Canva, and AI creative tools.

A real grasp of storytelling, pacing, color grading, music, and visual detail.

An eye for trends, without losing brand consistency.

Strong time management across multiple deadlines and accounts.

Openness to feedback and a genuine drive to improve.

Clear, proactive communication and an ownership mindset.



WHAT YOU GET

Systems, not chaos. SOPs, workflows, and project management tools already built for you.

Real creative collaboration. Direct access to the CEO/Strategist, with honest feedback.

Feedback that actually helps you grow: regular, specific, constructive.

Freedom with accountability. Manage your own schedule. We care about results, not clock watching.

Room to grow. Strong performers take on more client accounts as we scale.

This is a full time contractor role for an individual. We are not looking for an agency.



HOW TO APPLY

Ready to be the creative force behind multiple growing Instagram brands? Send us a Loom video introduction covering:

What do you find most rewarding about crafting captions?

How do you keep branding consistent across graphics and thumbnails?

Describe a strategy you've used to grow or engage an audience.

How do you stay updated on trends?

How do you balance content creation with admin tasks?

How do you maintain attention to detail when proofreading?



Along with your Loom, share your portfolio and resume, then tell us why you'd be excited to manage multiple Instagram accounts inside a fast-growing social media agency.



Application instructions: Include the word "Pink" right after your first and last name when you apply, and make sure "pink" is the very last word of your written application. We read closely; show us you do too.

We can't wait to see what you create.

title: Customer Success Manager

If you have hands-on experience processing equipment, vehicle, or commercial asset finance applications and understand the end-to-end broker workflow, we want to hear from you.

Education

A bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, or a related field is preferred but not required. We value hands-on Australian asset finance experience above qualifications. HMO coverage

Leave credits

13th Month Pay

This is a direct broker support role — you work for the broker, not a lender or bank. You are the engine behind the broker's business, managing their asset finance pipeline, keeping deals moving, and making sure nothing falls through the cracks between application and settlement.

You'll be part of Pierian Australia's dedicated back-office capability centre, supporting Australian asset finance brokers across commercial equipment, vehicles, technology, and other asset classes.
